Title: Senior Customer Success Manager (Transformation Advisor), Independent Software Vendor (ISV)
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Canada is looking for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) to join our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) team, a role at the intersection of technology strategy, business transformation, and customer partnership.  
  
You will own the success of a portfolio of Canadian ISVs navigating multi-year cloud, SaaS, and AI transformation journeys. Your job is to ensure these companies don't just adopt AWS; they build competitive advantage on it. That means helping them migrate critical workloads, accelerate AI and agentic capability adoption, and translate their technology investments into measurable business outcomes.  
  
In this role you are connecting ISV customers to the right AWS expertise, programs, and teams at the right time, and holding the thread across complex, multi-stakeholder environments.  
  
If you thrive where technical depth and business strategy intersect, and you want your work to have visible, lasting impact on how Canada's most innovative software companies grow, then this role is for you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Drive Customer Outcomes  

* Own the success of a portfolio of ISV accounts, working backwards from each customer's strategic milestones to define and execute a clear path to value realization
* Lead roadmap-to-outcome alignment sessions,
* Executive Briefing Sessions, and go-live milestones that accelerate each customer's cloud and AI journey
* Help ISVs build the governance, operating models, and data infrastructure needed to sustain long-term transformation, not just hit short-term milestones
* Support customers in adopting generative AI and agentic capabilities that are reshaping how software is built, delivered, and monetized

  
Orchestrate Across AWS  

* Serve as the connective tissue between ISV customers and AWS teams (Sales, Solutions Architecture, Support, Professional Services, and Partner teams) ensuring coordinated, high-quality engagement
* Contribute to account planning, translating strategic goals into executable actions with clear ownership and timelines
* Identify and remove systemic barriers that slow customer progress, escalating with precision and urgency when needed

  
Lead Strategic Engagements  

* Lead director-level engagements, co-innovation workshops, and strategic planning sessions with Product, Engineering, and Technology leadership within ISV accounts
* Help translate complex AI and cloud solutions into business cases for senior stakeholders, bridging the gap between technical teams and executive decision-makers
* Support customers through critical decision points: workload migration sequencing, AI adoption strategy, SaaS architecture evolution

  
Manage with Rigor  

* Maintain structured cadence through reporting, tracking, and health monitoring across your portfolio
* Apply structured delivery mechanisms and measurement frameworks to ensure customers realize the value of their AWS investment
* Proactively identify risks (technical, organizational, or commercial) and drive mitigation plans before they become escalations

  
Raise the Bar Internally  

* Challenge conventional thinking and take initiative on customer challenges, bringing new ideas, tools, and mechanisms to problems
* Bring the best of AWS and Amazon to customers, proactively solving problems by connecting them to emerging capabilities, programs, and expertise they may not know exist
* Contribute to repeatable mechanisms and internal enablement, sharing learnings from your customer engagements to help raise the bar for how AWS delivers customer success in Canada.

  
About the team  
You don't need to build cloud infrastructure, but you need to understand it well enough to earn the trust of the engineers who do.  
  
On any given day, you might help a VP/Director of Product at a Canadian SaaS company understand the business case for migrating their core platform to AWS, facilitate an alignment session between an ISV's engineering team and AWS Solutions Architecture, or work with your internal team to unblock a stalled migration that's at risk of missing its go-live milestone.  
  
You'll be working with some of Canada's most innovative software companies at a pivotal moment, when AI is fundamentally changing how software is built, delivered, and monetized. If you thrive in environments where technical depth and clear communication are equally valued, this role is for you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion
* Experience in customer-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies
* 5+ years of IT and/or Management Consulting experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Cloud Technology Certification, or AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud

Description:

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Customer Success team within Signature Success is looking for a driven and customer-focused Customer Success Manager (CSM) to serve as a primary contact point for Salesforce’s largest and highest-profile customers. You will have responsibility for partnering with a small number of assigned accounts, maintaining a continual focus on the customer’s business goals to improve their overall technical and operational health and realize the maximum value out of their Salesforce investment. The Customer Success Manager maintains awareness of the customer's key events, needs, potential risks, and value drivers.
  
  
As a trusted advisor, the CSM will build a track record in customer success through superb communication with partners and extensive knowledge of the Salesforce platform to translate their business needs to solutions. You will forge relationships with your customers and account teams, develop a deep technical understanding of their Salesforce implementation, share standard methodologies, and adoption of proactive services. These activities will enable you to proactively set the customer up for success through optimization of the platform, with special care during critically important peak events.
  
  
As a CSM, you will occasionally act as a point of contact for any major incidents, owning the customer’s expectations and communications through the resolution of such incidents. The CSM acts as the technical main interface on behalf of our customers and works closely across both internal and external collaborators, including partners and ISVs, as required to address the customer needs.
  
  
The ideal CSM has an extraordinary focus on the success of the customer, is an exceptional communicator, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, enjoys forming relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, and has the ability to learn new technologies quickly.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the orchestration of all Signature deliverables, experience, renewal, and expansion.
* Cultivate and maintain stakeholder relationships with the customer’s IT and business executive leadership, sponsors, and decision-makers within customer organizations that have purchased Signature.
* Help your customers achieve their business goals and outcomes on the Salesforce platform by:
* Coordinating the completion of the Signature Success catalog of services as required for your customer
* Providing timely, proactive Salesforce feature guidance based on the areas of interest for your customer
* Acting as an advisor to your customers for the adoption of new features of Salesforce’s annual release schedules and identifying potential challenges and risks to your customer's implementation
* Communicate the value of Signature Success. Be accountable for ensuring all collaborators understand this value so that customers continue to renew Signature Success.
* Act as an advocate for customers during the triage and resolution of high-severity cases to assist with the timely resolution of these issues.
* Proactive Support & Enhancement: Conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
* Internal Relationship Building: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
* The CSM may be required to occasionally be available for some after-hour or weekend coverage depending on the customer’s need.
* Evolution of Roles: Anticipate and adapt to role changes per evolving Salesforce needs.
  

**Required Qualifications**

* Experienced professional with 8+ years of relevant industry expertise in Technical Customer Success, SaaS platform use or project leadership, Technology Consulting, Technology Solutions Development, Technical and/or Solutions Architecture.
* Exceptional English & Arabic communication and presentation skills with demonstrated ability to communicate and influence effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level.
* Skills for analyzing technical concepts, translating them into business terms, and mapping business requirements into technical features.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts in business-friendly terms to customers, then explain customer needs to internal partners.
* Knowledge of software development process and design methodologies.
* Experience leading efforts of cross-functional teams to facilitate the resolution or disposition of customer needs or projects.
* **Fluency in both Arabic and English is essential**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* +2 years in the Salesforce Ecosystem.
* Salesforce product certifications are a plus ( **Administrator** , Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, **Service Cloud Consultant, Sales Cloud Consultant** ).
* Knowledge of Salesforce products and features, capabilities, best use, and how to deploy.
* Degree or equivalent experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the strengths you'll need for the role (e.g. demonstrated behaviors in previous jobs, that align to role needs such as extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. * Orchestrate release planning, rollout strategies, and delivery milestones that align product roadmaps with client commitments

* Champion the practical adoption of AI-enabled tools for planning, risk identification, and delivery insights

* Strong communication, governance, and risk management skills
* Comfort operating in complex, fast-paced environments with multiple priorities and competing stakeholder interests

* Experience in pension, benefits, health, financial services, or regulated delivery environments

Description:
We are seeking an experienced **Infrastructure Construction Manager** to lead and oversee all on-site execution activities for large-scale civil and utility infrastructure projects. The successful candidate will manage site teams, subcontractors, equipment, and daily operations to ensure works—such as earthworks, roads, drainage, and wet/dry utilities—are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in strict compliance with quality and regulatory standards.Key Responsibilities

* **Site Execution & Leadership:** Direct and coordinate daily site construction operations across multiple work fronts, managing site engineers, superintendents, foremen, and subcontractors.
* **Schedule & Progress Control:** Translate master project schedules into short-term look-ahead plans, track daily productivity, identify bottlenecks, and implement recovery plans to meet key milestones.
* **Health, Safety & Environment (HSE):** Enforce strict site HSE policies, conduct safety walks, ensure Permit-to-Work (PTW) compliance, and promote a zero-incident culture across all site personnel.
* **Quality Assurance & Control (QA/QC):** Ensure all construction activities adhere to approved method statements, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), project specifications, and engineering drawings.
* **Subcontractor & Resource Management:** Supervise subcontractor performance, optimize labor and heavy machinery allocation, and coordinate timely material deliveries to prevent site downtime.
* **Design & Technical Resolution:** Collaborate closely with engineering and technical teams to resolve field clashes, review shop drawings, and manage Requests for Information (RFIs).
* **Authority & Utility Coordination:** Coordinate on-site inspections, utility diversions, tie-ins, and statutory approvals with local authorities and service providers.
* **Testing, Commissioning & Handover:** Oversee pre-commissioning, hydrostatic/pressure testing, snagging rectification, and final site handover to the client or operations team.

Qualifications & Requirements

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related engineering field.
* **Experience:** Minimum of 10–15 years of proven site management experience on major infrastructure projects (roads, highways, bridges, sewerage, stormwater, potable water, and power/telecom networks).
* **Certifications:** PMP, NEBOSH/IOSH, or relevant local engineering registration/society membership is preferred.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Strong ability to read and interpret complex civil/utility drawings, familiarity with Primavera P6/MS Project schedules, and solid knowledge of construction methodologies.
* **Regulatory Knowledge:** Deep familiarity with local authority codes, utility standards, and traffic management/diversion protocols.
* **Core Competencies:** Decisive field leadership, strong conflict resolution, crisis management, and clear communication across technical and non-technical teams.

Title: Critical Environment Technician Manager
Description:
**Overview**

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a **Data Center Critical Environment Technician Manager.**

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I CE Technician Manager, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

In this environment, you may be asked to go on business travel to support other metros periodically, 0-25% of the time and have the ability to work 12-hour shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends and/or holidays.

Microsoft is unable to sponsor a work visa for this role due to the nature of the role's job duties.

 **Responsibilities**  

* ### **Critical Environment Culture**

  + Occasional climbing of ladders. Frequent climbing of stairs and/or ramps. Prolonged standing. Occasional lifting up to 25lbs / 11kg without assistance. Occasional lifting 25-50lbs / 11-22.5kg with lift assistance. Occasional push or pull 50-75 lbs / 22.5-34kg with assistive device. Normal visual acuity (near, far and peripheral with correction), defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria. Normal color vision for electrical work, defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria.
  + Working for extended periods under elevated levels of ambient noise, heat, and light due to necessary equipment and ventilation systems.
  + May travel up to 25%, typically domestically for training and/or supporting another site. May work 12-hour shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours such as evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays.
  + Understands, follows, and ensures safety and security requirements (e.g., job hazard assessments [JHAs], toolbox talks), and business processes and procedures are met, to properly perform work in a safe, quality, and reliable manner in accordance to applicable Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) regulations, and Microsoft requirements. Recognizes safe versus unsafe working conditions and responds accordingly (e.g., stop/pause tasks, stand down vendors where necessary). Escalates immediately when unsafe working conditions are observed and promotes a safe working culture to empower less experienced team members. Participates in required meetings, trainings, and necessary handoffs. Assesses and identifies appropriate resources and equipment necessary to fully support environmental health and safety (EHS) objectives. Actively maintains safe working conditions at all times. Proactively ensures safety and security requirements are followed and met for the work of themselves and others.

  ### **Equipment and Systems Maintenance**

  + Prepares and submits highly complex reports as assigned following preexisting scripts and templates, or using ad hoc methods required to support trending and analysis (e.g., Root Cause Analysis [RCA] reports) and may review prior reports delivered by less experienced team members. Develops methods of operating procedure (MOPs), standard operating procedures (SOPs), and/or digital methods of operating procedures (DMOPs) for highly complex and/or interdependent equipment and disciplines to ensure safe and reliable execution. Reviews completed work using approved tools and procedural templates from less experienced technicians for accuracy and completeness. Provides assignment and completion oversight of team members for mandatory, technical, and procedural training material. Assigns and oversees procedure development and reporting to team members. Analyzes findings from reports and documents observations.
  + Guides, oversees, and performs various types of maintenance (e.g., planned, predictive, corrective) and repairs for multiple disciplines and multiple equipment types of increasing complexity with no supervision, while serving as a subject matter expert for one discipline - in consideration of Task Hazard Analysis (THA), Method Statement of Work (MSOW), or varying permit requirements. Communicates and/or escalates maintenance activities per established process and procedure. Prioritizes maintenance activities as required and/or appropriate. Documents tasks or issues during maintenance activities within appropriate systems per process and procedure as needed. Provides consultation to colleagues on maintenance and repairs through deep understanding of equipment, systems and their interrelations. Follows recommended maintenance schedules. Oversees everyday, complex, large-scale tasks for a single discipline or equipment across disciplines. Ensures follow up action items are addressed in a timely manner. Masters the maintenance of all systems and equipment in a safe and professional manner and understands levels of risk (LORs) associated with varying types of maintenance across all disciplines and supports team members with subject matter expertise. Plans, coordinates, and presents maintenance items for review and approval in their area of responsibility.
  + Provides and/or assigns team members to provide necessary escort to third-party contractors, sub-contractors, vendors, and service providers on site for all procedure levels of risk (LOR). May take part in getting third-party work underway (e.g., making sure systems are properly energized/deenergized), ensuring the work is started and completed in a safe manner in accordance with standard practices, procedures, and Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) regulations. Ensures work performed by suppliers/vendors is performed to scope, all documentation is performed correctly, and escalates as appropriate. Engages to address and resolve circumstances when supplier/vendor work has been stopped to address potential and/or identified concerns. Coordinates and/or assigns team members to coordinate across all LOR applicable to preventative and/or corrective maintenance. Identifies and recommends procedure corrections if/when errors are detected or when appropriate. Coordinates and schedules supplier/vendor on-site activities. Coordinates with vendor to schedule maintenance and determines availability of equipment/parts, as directed. Resolves or escalates observed vendor quality issues. Reviews and approves vendor supplier field service reports, invoices, and work orders.
  + Processes method statement of work (MSOW) documents. Leads and provides guidance on coordinating activities and establishing associated schedules with contractors. Performs inspections of equipment in a facility. Participates in testing and commissioning activities. Advises engineer partners or project management colleagues on project scope process or execution methodology. Presents for review and approval MSOW in their area of responsibility.
  + Acts as a subject matter expert, performing troubleshooting independently for multiple equipment, systems, subsystems, and component types. Documents issues found in troubleshooting process within appropriate systems per process and procedure as needed. Ensures equipment and system settings are consistent with established parameters and designs. Determines when troubleshooting efforts are deemed adequate and communicates or escalates to suppliers, engineers, or more experienced colleagues as needed. Has a hands-on understanding of how equipment in all disciplines work and how to troubleshoot to subsystem level. Provides consultation to less experienced colleagues with troubleshooting systems and problems. Ensures troubleshooting completion paths are escalated appropriately and successfully by their team members. Oversees and advises their team members on troubleshooting systems and/or investigates root causes.

  ### **Equipment and Systems Operations**

  + Takes part in, and oversees team in the inspection and supervision of critical environment-related facility equipment (e.g., controls, heating, ventilation, and air conditioning [HVAC], mechanical systems), building, and grounds regularly for unsafe or abnormal conditions to develop and analyze trends. Understands critical system alarms for multiple discipline(s) of equipment, their meanings, and engages with appropriate escalation processes or procedures. Recognizes circumstances where execution would be considered safe to proceed. Performs various inspections and validations of equipment performance. Monitors the performance from central monitoring locations (i.e., Facility Operations Centers) of maintenance and operations of equipment (e.g., electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety) and understands risks or impacts to other subsystems across the data center. Escalates per applicable policies and standards. Utilizes telemetry, control systems, and other platforms to monitor site status, analyze past and current events, as well as other processes, and can identify all alarms. Uses technical expertise, prior experience, and device analytics to recognize trends with equipment behavior and checks potential issues as they arise. Advises less experienced colleagues on issues found while monitoring applicable CE systems. Ensures all monitoring equipment repair, replacement, and maintenance work meets or exceeds Microsoft Service Level Agreement (SLA) requirements. Uses data trends to develop or produce predictive analyses of equipment performance.
  + Works on complex, advanced tasks (e.g., stabilization, resolution, recovery) independently. Serves as an operations specialist in a major area of operations (e.g., electrical, mechanical, controls, generators) and provides oversight and training/mentorship to team members on tasks regarding these subsystems. Demonstrates an understanding of and operates equipment and systems across all disciplines (e.g., electrical, mechanical, controls) with knowledge of the interactions between them and overall operation of a data center. Operates all systems and equipment in a safe and professional manner.
  + Safely and quickly responds to and leads an onsite incident response team for all abnormal conditions that impact operations, and coordinates with other critical facilities professionals to perform corrective repairs, without supervision. Gathers necessary information and creates incident timelines/data, root-cause analyses, and/or action items following an abnormal condition as required. Identifies and contacts/engages appropriate parties to mitigate incidents as they occur, and collects or provides appropriate escalation details or context to support incident management requirements. Develops new or follows preexisting emergency operating procedures (EOPs), methods of procedure (MOPs), standard operating procedures (SOPs), and digital methods of operating procedures (DMOPs) in relation to incidents. Directly provides and leads and coordinates emergency monitoring response plans for irregular or malfunctioning conditions. Oversees team during emergency incident management, assigning tasks for corrective repair as appropriate. Communicates directly to leadership, advises the business on the current conditions, safety concerns, and next steps for incident mitigation and/or resolution. Oversees incident detection, analysis, and containment efforts. Serves as technical expert in ensuring emergency operating procedures (EOPs) are consistent with proper incident response.
  + Utilizes internal computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) to track all equipment assets and to complete work order requests for maintenance work. Tracks utilization and time tracking results for team members, within applicable task management systems. Reviews and validates added required data, documents, changes logged, and procedures upkeep details (related to building management systems and reports) conducted by team members. Guides and coaches team in CMMS usage best practices. Audits and reviews team's data to ensure performance adherence to assigned work tasks. Generates reporting from CMMS for outstanding and ongoing work orders. Generates ad hoc or custom CMMS reports as needed for management. Reviews spare equipment and parts, updates stock, and signal stock replenishment with suppliers and/or coordination with Materials Handling partners.

  ### **People Management**

  + Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring. Model: Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles. Coach: Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn. Care: Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.

### **Required/minimum qualifications**

* 5+ years mission critical services work/applied learning experience (e.g., high availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or related fields) OR equivalent experience.

You will leverage your broad experience to work closely with sales leadership to plan and ensure successful launch and operations of AWS's largest application workloads. * Develop and maintain reporting, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide visibility into travel spend, booking behavior, online booking adoption, service performance, policy compliance, and traveler experience

* Improve data quality and reporting discipline to strengthen business decisions and program governance
  

  

Global Collaboration & Change Leadership

* Partner across Corporate Security, Finance, Procurement, HR, Events, Legal, Technology, and regional teams to deliver a cohesive global travel experience

Title: Senior Security Manager, Assistance
Location: Dubai, Dubai, United Arab Emirates | Dubai, DU, United Arab Emirates
Description:
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic
**Senior Security Manager, Assistance**
to lead our regional Security Assistance team, based in Dubai.
  
  
This is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing the delivery of frontline security assistance services across Mashreq, Iran, East and Southern Africa. The successful candidate will provide strategic and operational leadership, ensuring the delivery of high-quality security advice, case management, incident response, crisis support and preventative security services to our clients and members.
  
  
Working closely with the Global Security Director, Assistance, Regional Operations Directors and wider global security network, you will drive operational excellence, strengthen regional capabilities and ensure consistent service delivery in line with International SOS standards and client expectations.
  
  
You will also play an important role in developing regional security talent, supporting business growth, strengthening client relationships and maintaining operational readiness in an evolving security environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Management and Leadership**

* Provide leadership, direction and oversight to Security Managers, Security Specialists and associated security personnel across the region.
* Lead, coach and develop regional security teams, promoting professional growth, engagement and high performance.
* Oversee performance management, objective setting, succession planning and workforce development.
* Ensure effective resource planning and allocation to meet operational demands and client requirements.
* Drive a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, operational excellence and customer focus.
* Lead the Security Case Lead function in coordination with Security Managers.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, training and retention of regional security personnel.
* Act as deputy to the Global Security Director, Assistance, in the Middle East region.

**Core Client & Internal Support**

* Oversee the delivery of regional security assistance services, ensuring timely, effective and customer-focused outcomes.
* Provide expert security guidance and support to clients, travellers, expatriates and internal stakeholders.
* Maintain oversight of security case management and ensure consistent service quality and operational standards.
* Act as a senior escalation point for complex security cases, incidents and operational challenges.
* Coordinate security responses to emergencies, critical incidents and crisis situations.
* Monitor regional security developments and ensure operational responses reflect current threat assessments and intelligence.
* Provide senior-level review and quality assurance of security advice, assessments and recommendations.
* Maintain regional operational preparedness plans, procedures and response protocols.
* Oversee regional security provider networks, partnerships and the Secure Hotel Programme.
* Support Incident Management Teams and Crisis Management Teams during major incidents and events.
* Promote effective collaboration across Medical, Operations, Travel, Aviation, Network Services and Intelligence & Analysis teams.

**Consulting Delivery & Sales, Marketing Support**

* Deliver high-quality security consulting services in line with client requirements.
* Contribute to the development and delivery of security risk assessments, country assessments, travel security programmes and tailored client solutions.
* Participate in client meetings, presentations, workshops and business development engagements.
* Deliver security briefings, webinars, training programmes and awareness sessions.
* Support the preparation of proposals, tenders and commercial opportunities.
* Contribute to client retention through expert advice and excellent service delivery.
* Identify opportunities to enhance existing services and develop new client value propositions.
* Represent International SOS at relevant industry events, conferences and stakeholder meetings.
* Support regional commercial objectives through security expertise and operational insight

**Required Experience & Skills**

* At least 8 years of experience in security operations and planning, including operational deployment in hostile and/or challenging environments.
* Experience gained within private security companies, military, NGOs, government or relevant private-sector organisations, ideally within the Middle East.
* Proven experience in leading and managing security teams, including remote or hybrid teams.
* Strong experience in planning and managing security assistance operations.
* Extensive knowledge of security risk management principles and best practices across diverse risk environments.
* Strong understanding of the political, security and threat landscape across the Middle East and wider region.
* Experience in conducting security risk assessments and developing practical risk mitigation strategies.
* Ability to analyse complex security, logistical and threat-related information and translate findings into clear recommendations and action plans.
* Experience preparing reports and providing advice to senior management and decision-makers.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and cross-cultural collaboration skills.
* Strong IT proficiency, including Microsoft Office applications.

**Desirable Experience**

* Crisis management and emergency response experience.
* Security consulting and training delivery.
* Client-facing presentations, public speaking and media engagement.
* Business development and commercial support.
* Quality management and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Qualifications & Education**

* Degree-level education in Security Studies, Conflict Studies, International Politics, International Relations or a related discipline, or equivalent professional training and experience.
* Accreditation or membership with a recognised regional security or risk management professional body is desirable.

**Languages**

* Excellent written and spoken English is essential.
* Arabic, French or another European language would be an advantage.

**Why Join International SOS?**
Join a global organisation where your expertise can make a meaningful difference in protecting people and supporting organisations operating in complex environments.
  
  
At International SOS, you will work alongside experienced professionals across a global network, contribute to critical security operations and help deliver services that protect the health, safety and security of people worldwide.
  
  
**If you are an experienced security leader looking for an opportunity to make an impact on a regional and global scale, we would like to hear from you.**

Headquartered in Toronto, the Canada Infrastructure Bank (CIB) is responsible for investing in new infrastructure projects. The CIB’s mission is to work with provincial, territorial, municipal, federal, Indigenous and private sector investor partners to transform the way infrastructure is planned, financed and delivered in Canada.

The Senior Manager, IT Operations, is responsible for leading the day-to-day operations of the CIB’s IT function. Reporting to the VP, IT, this role ensures reliable service delivery, effective vendor and managed service partner performance, disciplined ITSM practices, and strong operational controls across infrastructure, service desk, cybersecurity operations, disaster recovery, and business continuity. The role manages approximately two internal team members and works closely with business stakeholders, application management, project delivery teams, and external partners.

**Your responsibilities include:**

* Lead day-to-day IT operations, including service desk, infrastructure, incident management, cybersecurity operations, and managed service partner delivery
* Develop, maintain, and improve ITSM processes, procedures, and operating standards that support reliable, secure, and efficient technology services
* Define, monitor, and report on service-level objectives, operational metrics, risks, and recurring issues
* Manage IT operating expenses, vendor performance, contracts, renewals, and service improvement plans within approved budgets
* Support the ongoing development and execution of the IT roadmap by identifying operational improvements, risks, dependencies, and resource requirements
* Maintain and improve cybersecurity controls and operational security practices, including oversight of vulnerability management, penetration testing, awareness training, and remediation tracking
* Maintain the IT Disaster Recovery Plan and lead regular business continuity and disaster recovery exercises to validate plans, procedures, and readiness
* Support internal and external audit activities by providing evidence, coordinating responses, and tracking remediation actions
* Develop and deliver clear IT communications, end-user guidance, and organization-wide training where required
* Work with Application Management and Project Management teams to ensure technology initiatives are operationally ready, delivered to specification, and transitioned effectively into support
* Occasional travel to CIB offices in Calgary and Montréal may be required

**Your ideal profile:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
* 10+ years of progressive experience in IT operations, infrastructure, service delivery, or related technology roles
* Experience leading IT operations in a structured, risk-conscious environment, preferably in financial services, investments, asset management, or a comparable sector
* Strong working knowledge of ITSM practices, service desk operations, incident management, Azure administration, Microsoft 365, networking, and cloud-first or hybrid environments
* 5+ years of cybersecurity-related experience; CISSP, CISM, or equivalent certification is an asset
* Experience managing vendors, managed service providers, budgets, contracts, service levels, and operational performance
* Experience supporting audits, risk management, disaster recovery, business continuity, and operational control activities
* Experience working in a growing or transforming organization, including process improvement, technology change, or operational maturity initiatives
* Project delivery experience; PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification is an asset
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, Dynamics 365 Business Central, Artificial Intelligence, or Machine Learning is an asset
* Strong judgment, discretion, and professionalism when handling confidential or sensitive matters
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical matters for business stakeholders
* Strong organization, planning, collaboration, and problem-solving skills

Title: Information Technology Project Manager
Industry: Software Development, IT System Training and Support, and IT System Design Services
Description:
The IT Project Manager delivers IT projects across the group and oversees business applications, cloud platforms, infrastructure coordination, vendors and IT governance. The role bridges business stakeholders, IT teams and technology partners, ensuring solutions meet business needs, are delivered on time and within approved scope and budget, and are transitioned smoothly into operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. IT Project Management & Delivery**

* Lead IT projects end-to-end: initiation, requirements, planning, execution, testing, go-live, handover and closure.
* Build and maintain project plans, milestones, budgets, resource plans, RAID logs and dependency maps.
* Coordinate business stakeholders, internal IT teams, vendors and consultants to deliver agreed scope on time and within budget.
* Run project governance: steering committee and status reporting, action tracking, change control and escalation.
* Manage UAT, cutover, deployment and stabilization, and hand over cleanly to business and IT operations.
* Complete lessons learned, closure reports and knowledge transfer for every project.
* Provide or coordinate L1/L2 application support during the post-go-live stabilization period.

**2. Business Applications Management**

* Own the day-to-day management of core applications, including Microsoft Dynamics 365, Ramco HCM, Focus, Sage and other enterprise systems.
* Coordinate with application vendors and implementation partners on support, incident resolution, enhancements, integrations, upgrades and patches.
* Work with business departments to understand processes and pain points, and translate requirements into functional and technical solutions.
* Maintain application roadmaps, enhancement backlogs and release plans, including testing and deployment.
* Keep application documentation, support procedures, access controls and vendor contacts current.
* Coordinate integrations across Microsoft 365, Azure, GCP and ERP, HR, property, finance and other systems.

**3. Microsoft 365 & Licensing**

* Manage Microsoft 365 subscriptions, license allocation, renewals, utilization and cost optimization.
* Work with Microsoft partners on licensing, technical issues and service changes.
* Oversee identity, access, administrative roles, security controls and compliance for Microsoft 365, together with the infrastructure and security teams.

**4. Cloud & Infrastructure**

* Coordinate the group's Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform environments with providers, vendors and internal technical teams.
* Support cloud migration, modernization, integration and disaster recovery initiatives.
* Track cloud usage and cost, and act on optimization opportunities.
* Ensure cloud environments follow approved architecture, security, access, backup and governance standards.

**5. Network, Server & Cybersecurity Coordination**

* Coordinate support of networks, servers, firewalls, VPN, backup and endpoint services with the IT technical team.
* Coordinate cybersecurity tooling, including Trend Micro XDR and other security technologies.
* Drive vulnerability remediation, security updates, monitoring, access control, backup and DR improvements.
* Ensure infrastructure and security issues affecting business applications are escalated, tracked and resolved.

**6. Business Relationship & Solution Management**

* Act as the primary IT contact for business stakeholders across the group.
* Run workshops and requirement-gathering sessions with users and process owners.
* Prepare business cases, solution comparisons and vendor evaluations for management approval.
* Coordinate demonstrations, proofs of concept and technical assessments.

**7. IT Governance, Policies & Controls**

* Establish and maintain IT project governance standards, templates, reporting and controls.
* Develop, review and implement IT policies, procedures and operating guidelines.
* Ensure projects and IT services comply with policies, security requirements and internal controls.
* Maintain documentation for management, audit and compliance; support IT audits and close findings.
* Ensure approval, change, access and vendor management processes are followed.

**8. Vendor & Contract Management**

* Manage relationships with IT vendors, system integrators, software providers, cloud providers and managed service providers.
* Monitor vendor performance against SLAs, deliverables and milestones; lead service reviews and improvement plans.
* Support procurement: RFP/RFQ preparation, technical and commercial evaluation, negotiation, renewals and contract review.
* Identify opportunities to reduce vendor dependency and optimize IT spend.

**9. IT Service Management & Operational Support**

* Coordinate incidents, service requests, problems and escalations that need project or application management involvement.
* Ensure projects transition into operations with documentation, SLAs, support models and knowledge transfer.
* Analyze recurring incidents and drive permanent fixes, automation and process improvement.
* Coordinate business continuity, disaster recovery, backup and service restoration for critical IT services.

**10. Team & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate application, infrastructure, network, system administration and service desk (L1/L2) resources as required.
* Prioritize work by business criticality, project commitments, risk and available capacity.
* Provide direction and escalation support to technical teams and external providers.
* Promote collaboration between IT, business departments, vendors and senior management.

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or a related field.
* Proven end-to-end delivery of enterprise IT projects.
* Mandatory: hands-on or strong functional/project experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365.
* Experience managing enterprise business applications, including support, enhancements, integrations and rollouts.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 administration/licensing and Azure and/or GCP.
* Sound understanding of network, server, firewall, backup, endpoint and cybersecurity environments.
* Experience managing IT vendors, implementation partners, SLAs, contracts and technology evaluations.
* Experience in IT governance, policies, change management, risk management and project reporting.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, problem-solving and analytical skills.

**Preferred Certifications**

* PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management certification.
* ITIL certification.

**Technology Scope :**

**Business Applications**

Microsoft Dynamics 365, Ramco HCM, Focus, Sage and other enterprise applications

**Cloud Platforms**

Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

**Productivity & Collaboration**

Microsoft 365

**Infrastructure**

Network, servers, firewalls, backup, connectivity, endpoint services

**Cybersecurity**

Trend Micro XDR and other security technologies

**Governance & Service**

ITSM, project governance, change, risk and vendor management, policies and controls

**Qualifications:**

Title: Platform Lead
Description:
**Company Description**

We are a premier media brand with a proven history of delivering impactful content and trusted journalism. Our commitment to excellence and creativity sets us apart in the industry as we continue to grow and evolve to meet current market needs.

**Our Commitment To Diversity:** We strive to be a leader in building and cultivating an employee community framed around fairness, support and opportunity. We believe that what makes us different, makes a difference. And as a team, the diversity of our backgrounds, interests and experiences is what enriches our work, and our workplaces. We welcome all, and we strive for an inclusive culture that allows individual growth and shared success.

 **Job Description**

The **Platform Lead** is a senior technology leader responsible for the architecture, evolution, reliability, and operational performance of Torstar’s shared digital platform capabilities. This role partners closely with the Mobile lead to translate the organization’s technology strategy into scalable, secure, and well-governed platform services that enable mobile and web product teams to deliver effectively.

The Platform Lead provides deep expertise across backend systems, cloud infrastructure, developer tooling, integrations, data and analytics infrastructure, content-management capabilities, identity, subscriptions, payments, email platforms, and operational engineering practices. The role leads the platform engineering team and acts as a trusted technical partner to the Mobile lead, with responsibility for platform execution and domain-level technical decisions.

While this role has significant technical and people leadership responsibility, the Chief Product Officer retains overall accountability for organization-wide technology strategy, senior leadership engagement, and the full digital technology portfolio.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead the strategy, architecture, implementation, and ongoing evolution of Torstar’s shared digital platform services and infrastructure.
* Own the reliability, scalability, security, maintainability, and performance of platform capabilities that support mobile, web, data, editorial, subscription, advertising, and other digital products.
* Lead and develop platform engineering, DevOps, QA, and related technical team members as assigned.
* Partner with the Chief Product Officer on enterprise technology strategy, architecture, investment priorities, and delivery planning.
* Establish and maintain platform engineering standards for APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, security, resilience, and incident management.
* Ensure that platform roadmaps enable product teams—particularly the mobile team—to deliver customer value quickly, reliably, and safely.
* Translate product and business requirements into scalable technical solutions, architectural guidance, and implementation plans.
* Lead the technical assessment, selection, integration, and management of platform technologies, vendors, and external delivery partners.
* Improve engineering productivity through strong developer tooling, automation, documentation, deployment practices, and operational processes.
* Monitor platform health and production-quality metrics; identify risks, lead root-cause analysis, and implement preventive improvements.
* Support technology governance by documenting architectural decisions, managing technical debt, and maintaining a clear view of platform dependencies and risks.
* Collaborate with Product, Data, Editorial, Revenue, Security, and other stakeholders to ensure technology solutions meet organizational needs.
* Keep current with developments in cloud platforms, AI, data infrastructure, backend systems, security, and software delivery practices.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field — or equivalent demonstrated experience delivering at this level of technical scope and complexity.
* 7+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including experience leading technical teams or major platform initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating scalable backend systems, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and shared technology services.
* Strong knowledge of modern cloud computing, CI/CD, DevOps, observability, security, system reliability, and software architecture.
* Experience supporting large-scale, consumer-facing digital products or high-availability digital platforms.
* Proven ability to lead and mentor engineers while driving complex, cross-functional technical initiatives.
* Experience with platform domains such as content management, identity and access management, subscriptions, payments, data and analytics, email platforms, or enterprise integrations is strongly preferred.
* Strong problem-solving skills, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to partner with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* A practical, collaborative approach to balancing platform health, technical debt, delivery needs, and long-term scalability.

  
**Additional Information**

**Success in this role**

Success will mean providing a stable and extensible platform foundation that enables product teams to move quickly, reduces operational risk, improves engineering efficiency, and gives the Chief Product Officer a strong technical partner for organization-wide planning and execution.

Ensure the respective technologies have optimum capacity and availability to meet the existing and future needs of the business. Manage and minimize risks within the respective technologies.

* Define KPI’s for the teams in line with departmental goals and objectives. Consistently meet or exceed agreed KPI’s. Ensure all communications, reports and updates are accurate and consistently delivered in a timely manner.

Title: IT Project Manager
Description:
**Job Description**
The IT Project Manager will lead and coordinate the planning, execution, and delivery of critical technology initiatives. The role requires strong leadership and communication skills, along with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams and manage project milestones. The individual will be responsible for ensuring high-quality project outcomes are delivered on schedule, within scope, and within budget.
  
  
The role will primarily focus on cybersecurity projects; therefore, prior experience in managing and delivering cybersecurity initiatives will be considered a strong advantage.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Project Planning & Initiation
* Collaborate with stakeholders to define project scope, goals, and deliverables.
* Develop comprehensive project plans, including timelines, resource allocation, and budget estimation.
* Identify project dependencies and manage potential risks and constraints.
* Execution & Monitoring
* Coordinate and lead cross-functional teams, ensuring clear communication of tasks and responsibilities.
* Track project performance against established objectives, milestones, and deliverables.
* Implement change management processes to accommodate shifting requirements.
* Risk Management
* Proactively identify, analyze, and resolve project-related risks and issues.
* Develop contingency plans and communicate risk mitigation strategies to stakeholders.
* Escalate critical issues to senior management as necessary.
* Cybersecurity Project Delivery
* Lead the delivery of cybersecurity initiatives such as security operations, identity and access management, vulnerability and patch management, security tooling rollouts, and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) workstreams.
* Coordinate with security architects, SOC and infrastructure teams, and specialist vendors to ensure project deliverables align with the organization’s security architecture and control framework.
* Track security risks, audit findings, and remediation actions through to closure, ensuring documentation and supporting evidence are maintained for internal and regulatory reviews.
* Ensure deliverables comply with applicable security standards and policies (e.g., ISO/IEC 27001, NIST, and Qatar’s National Information Assurance Policy).
* Stakeholder Communication & Reporting
* Serve as the primary point of contact between business stakeholders and the project team.
* Prepare and present regular status reports, progress updates, and project dashboards.
* Facilitate project meetings, document outcomes, and track action items for follow-up.
* Communicate confidently and effectively in Arabic with regional and local stakeholders, ensuring project requirements are clearly understood.
* Resource Coordination
* Allocate internal and external resources effectively to optimize productivity.
* Manage third-party vendors and contractors, ensuring they meet project standards and deadlines.
* Review and approve project-related expenses while adhering to budget constraints.
* Quality Assurance
* Define and monitor quality metrics throughout project lifecycles.
* Oversee testing and validation processes to ensure project deliverables meet requirements.
* Lead post-project reviews to capture lessons learned and drive continuous improvement.
* Process Improvement
* Implement best practices in project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid).
* Advocate continuous improvement to optimize project processes and workflows.
* Encourage collaboration and knowledge-sharing to enhance team effectiveness.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field. A Master’s degree is an advantage.
* Experience:

+ 5+ years of experience managing medium to large IT projects.
+ Proven track record of successfully delivering projects within scope, on time, and within budget.
+ Hands-on experience with project management tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, Jira, Trello, or similar).
+ Experience managing cybersecurity projects (e.g., SOC, IAM, GRC, network, endpoint, or data security) is a strong advantage.
+ Working knowledge of security frameworks and controls (e.g., ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, or equivalent) is an advantage.

* Language:

+ Fluency in both Arabic and English (written and spoken) is mandatory.

* Certifications (preferred but not required):

+ PMP (Project Management Professional).
+ PRINCE2 (Projects IN Controlled Environments).
+ Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or similar Agile certifications.
+ Cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, or CompTIA Security+ are an advantage.

**Skills & Competencies -**

* Project Management
* Strong understanding of both Agile and traditional project management principles and practices.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Technical Acumen
* Familiarity with system integrations, software development processes, and IT infrastructure.
* Ability to translate business needs into technical requirements.
* Cybersecurity Acumen
* Working understanding of core security domains, including threat and vulnerability management, identity and access management, network and endpoint security, and incident response.
* Ability to interpret audit findings, risk registers, and remediation plans and translate them into clear project tasks, owners, and deadlines.
* Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and maintain strict confidentiality.
* Communication & Leadership
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Arabic and English to effectively liaise with stakeholders at all levels.
* Ability to inspire and motivate cross-functional project teams, fostering a collaborative environment.
* Analytical & Problem-Solving
* Skilled in risk analysis, contingency planning, and problem resolution.
* Adept at understanding complex business and technical issues and implementing pragmatic solutions.
* Stakeholder Management
* Proven ability to build rapport with clients, vendors, and team members.
* Effective negotiation skills to address conflicting requirements and manage expectations.
* Attention to Detail
* Meticulous tracking of project documentation, ensuring consistency and accuracy.
* Strong attention to timelines, resources, and quality standards.

Title: IT Engineering Manager — Endpoint, SaaS
Industry: Software Development and IT Services and IT Consulting
Description:
**A Little Bit About Talabat**
talabat is the leading online food and groceries ordering platform in MENA, operating in 9 countries
  
  
across the region. Founded in 2004 by a small group of entrepreneurs in Kuwait, talabat’s success
  
  
expanded to the rest of the GCC region, Egypt & Jordan, making it the largest and most popular food
  
  
ordering app. With over 2,000+ employees and millions of users, we deliver hundreds of thousands
  
  
of orders every day.We are part of the Delivery Hero network building the next generation of online delivery platforms across the globe. Our network is truly international with engineering teams in 13 countries and
  
  
operations in 40+ countries.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
We are hiring a hands-on IT Engineering Manager to own the Enterprise Applications domain — the devices, collaboration tools, and identity/access that talabat employees rely on every day — and to lead the small engineering team behind it, coordinating across our markets.
  
  
This is a working manager role: roughly 70–80% technical execution and standard-setting, and 20–30% people and delivery leadership. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, staying close to the work while building the automation, documentation, and standards that let the function scale consistently across markets. It is a build role — you set the technical bar by doing, then make that excellence repeatable so it outlives any one person.
  
  
Your domain sits alongside other IT engineering domains, and your success depends as much on clean collaboration across those boundaries as on the depth of your own work. You will define and defend clear ownership of your systems while partnering openly with adjacent teams who depend on them. You will cultivate strong vendor relationships and drive strategic partnerships that enhance application functionality and support — a single quote is a starting point, not a decision.
  
  
Scope boundary: This role owns corporate and employee-facing IT (the digital workplace), including identity and endpoint end-to-end, which adjacent IT teams consume. It does not own product, ordering, or operational (rider/vendor-facing) systems, which sit with separate engineering functions. Where core platforms are provided centrally by Delivery Hero, this role owns the local instances and acts as talabat's engineering interface to those central teams.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
Endpoint & Device Management
  
  
Own endpoint fleet strategy across macOS and Windows — MDM (Jamf, Intune, Jump Cloud), security baselines, patching, encryption, inventory, and the full device lifecycle from procurement and provisioning through to offboarding and asset recovery. Maintain endpoint posture in partnership with Security.
  
  
SaaS Administration
  
  
Own day-to-day administration of the core SaaS stack — Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and similar — including configuration, license management, integrations, cost optimization, and strategic licensing negotiations with vendors. Evaluate and onboard new business tools, retire redundant ones, and operate the local instances of centrally provided platforms. Drive Power User Community deployment and management across entities where applicable.
  
  
Identity & Access
  
  
Administer SSO, MFA, and identity providers (Okta, Entra, Google or similar), operating local instances and interfacing with the central identity platform. Own the Joiner-Mover-Leaver lifecycle — provisioning, deprovisioning, role-based access, least-privilege, and periodic access reviews — automated wherever possible.
  
  
Automation & AI (a core expectation, not a future investment)
  
  
Engineer away repetitive work: if a task is done the same way more than twice, automate it. Scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell) and AI tooling are current expectations of this role. Use automation and AI to create team capacity without growing headcount, and lead the team's adoption of these tools.
  
  
Incident Response & Reliability
  
  
Own incident response and the on-call rotation for your domain. Act as escalation point during peak and out-of-hours periods, run proactive incident communication, and drive root-cause resolution rather than recurring workarounds. Participate in cross-domain incident coordination where issues span into adjacent IT teams. Build reliability and security in by design — every system has a clear answer to "what happens when this fails?"
  
  
Service, Compliance & Standards
  
  
Define and track IT service standards, SLAs, and operational metrics, and run ticketing/ITSM workflows that reduce friction for employees. Ensure a consistent support model across locations and time zones, adhering to agreed service levels. Champion change management practices to ensure seamless application delivery and effective transitions. Contribute to compliance and audit readiness (e.g. SOC 2 / ISO 27001 IT controls, access reviews, evidence) in partnership with Security and central teams. Standardize before scaling — build solutions that work across all markets on a shared foundation, allowing local flavor without fragmenting the stack.
  
  
Leadership, People & Vendors
  
  
Lead, coach, and raise the technical bar of a small IT engineering team, with a mandate to grow both its capability and its headcount. Set the standard hands-on, develop your engineers, and manage performance fairly and decisively — investing genuinely in growth, and making the hard call when the bar cannot be met. Provide mentorship to team members, promote knowledge sharing and professional growth. Create and maintain runbooks, training materials, and self-service resources so knowledge is never trapped in one person's head. Manage vendors, procurement, and renewals — actively challenge cost and drive strategic partnerships rather than transactional relationships.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**What You'll Bring**

* 5–7+ years in IT operations, IT engineering, or corporate IT, with hands-on depth across endpoint, SaaS, and identity — including organisations with 5,000+ users.
* Hands-on expertise with MDM (Jamf / Intune / jumpcloud), identity providers (Okta / Entra), and SaaS administration (Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian).
* Demonstrated scripting and automation ability, and daily use of AI tooling in real work — with concrete examples of what you have built or adopted.
* Proven expertise in business process analysis, requirements gathering, solution design, and vendor management — including cost-effective licensing negotiation.
* A track record of leading or mentoring a small team and raising its operating standard. People-leadership appetite is required; formal management experience is welcome.
* Strong project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex projects on time and within budget across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Proven ability to operate autonomously with limited managerial oversight — self-directed on priorities, delivery, and standard-setting.
* A track record of defining and defending clear domain ownership while collaborating openly with adjacent teams.
* A strong customer-focus mindset toward employees — you treat how IT feels to use as the measure of success, speak in plain language, and never say no to the person without offering an alternative.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships and influence without authority across teams and senior stakeholders.
* A documentation-first working style and comfort operating where a central platform team owns core systems and you own the local layer and the interface.
* Deep understanding of enterprise application security best practices.

Description:

GreenShield is a proudly Canadian, national non-profit health care and insurance organization, driven by our mission of Better Health for All. We believe health care is a right, not a privilege, and we are committed to improving health outcomes, advancing health equity, and building a future where every Canadian can reach their full health and well-being potential.

Through our unique integrated payer-provider ("payvider") model, we offer insurance, administer benefits, and pay claims as a ‘payer’ while offering health care services such as mental health, pharmacy, telemedicine, and chronic disease management as a ‘provider’. As a non-profit social enterprise without shareholders, we reinvest our excess earnings to directly support underserved communities. Through GreenShield Cares, we positively impacted the health and well-being of over one million Canadians between 2020 and 2025. What’s driving us now is the commitment to measurably impact an additional three million Canadians by 2030 – across mental health, essential medicines, and chronic disease management – through scalable initiatives that deliver meaningful change in pursuit of our mission of Better Health for All.  
  
At GreenShield, our culture is where purpose meets passion and performance. Our teams work as one to deliver meaningful, measurable impact for the people and communities we serve.

GreenShield is seeking a customer-focused and experienced Manager, Customer Technology Implementations to lead the delivery of customer-facing technology implementations across the organization.

Reporting to the Director, Technology Project Management Office, this role will oversee a team of technology project managers responsible for coordinating complex implementations for new and existing customers and partners. The Manager will provide clear leadership and accountability across the full implementation lifecycle, from early intake, discovery, requirements definition, and planning through build, testing, launch, stabilization, and transition to operations. The role will work closely with customers and with internal Sales, Client Services, Product, Engineering, Security, Operations, and business teams to ensure commitments are well understood, delivery risks are addressed early, and customers receive a coordinated and professional implementation experience.

This is a highly visible, externally facing leadership role. The successful candidate will have significant experience working directly with customers, will communicate with confidence and credibility, and will be comfortable representing GreenShield in complex or sensitive implementation discussions. They will bring the judgment, executive presence, and delivery discipline required to balance customer expectations with technology capacity, solution constraints, contractual commitments, and organizational priorities.

**Key responsibilities include:**

* Lead GreenShield’s delivery of customer-facing technology implementations, including Third Party Administration solutions, GS+ white labelling, new customer onboarding, SSO, API integrations, and other partner technology solutions.

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of technology project managers, providing day-to-day people leadership, performance management, ensuring consistent standards for customer engagement, delivery planning, risk management, communication, and execution.

* Serve as the senior Technology PMO representative with customers and partners, building trusted relationships and leading key governance, status, decision, and escalation discussions.

* Provide end-to-end oversight from intake and discovery through requirements, planning, build, testing, launch, stabilization, and transition to operations.

Title: Cyber Services Manager - Deputy BISO
Description:
Are you passionate about technology and interested in joining a community of collaborative colleagues who respectfully and courageously seek to challenge the status quo? If so, read on to learn about an opportunity with Deloitte Technology US (DT-US).

The Deputy BISO is the ES BISO's senior delegate and second-in-command for the Enterprise Solutions security portfolio. In partnership with the ES BISO, you will translate security strategy into operating priorities, lead day-to-day portfolio execution, and represent the BISO function with senior business, technology, Cyber, risk, and compliance stakeholders.

You will lead through others-setting direction, strengthening risk visibility, and ensuring decisions and remediation move to closure.  
  
As manager, you are expected to own outcomes end to end, exercise sound judgment with minimal oversight, and influence across teams without relying on direct authority. You will partner with business leaders to enable cloud, AI, and technology adoption securely and at pace.  
  
Portfolio Leadership and Risk Visibility  

* Own the operating rhythm for portfolio-level cyber risk visibility, including executive dashboards, metrics, briefings, recommendations, and decisions required.
* Direct risk assessments across applications, infrastructure, cloud services, data, identity, and third parties; prioritize issues based on business impact and risk.
* Oversee exception governance, vulnerability management, remediation prioritization, and escalation; hold owners accountable for agreed actions and closure.
* Represent the ES BISO in governance forums and lead complex escalations within delegated authority, bringing decisions requiring BISO or other leadership approval forward with clear options and recommendations.

  
Application, Cloud, and AI Security  

* Set priorities to advance application security maturity across critical business applications, working with technical owners and security specialists to drive measurable improvement.
* Provide portfolio-level guidance across cloud, AI, identity, data, infrastructure, and third-party risk; engage subject-matter experts where deeper technical assessment is needed.
* Oversee security reviews of AI and GenAI use cases-from intake through approval and monitoring-including copilots, LLM-based tools, automation, and third-party AI services. Ensure risks such as data leakage, prompt injection, insecure integrations, excessive agent permissions, and unapproved ("shadow") AI are assessed and addressed.
* Guide cloud security assessments across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS environments, including Azure and AWS, covering identity, network, encryption, logging, and data protection against applicable standards and control expectations.
* Partner with cyber engineering, critical infrastructure, and privacy teams to align their priorities with the Enterprise Solutions risk portfolio.

  
Audit, Compliance, and GRC  

* Own coordination of BISO responses to audits, control assessments, internal reviews, and compliance activities; align evidence and remediation with the appropriate control owners.
* Maintain portfolio risk registers, action logs, and issue trackers as decision and accountability tools-not just status records-and ensure timely follow-up and escalation.
* Lead BISO-side coordination for incidents affecting Enterprise Solutions, including stakeholder alignment, impact tracking, communications, escalation, and lessons learned, in partnership with incident-response teams.

  
Business Partnership and Team Leadership  

* Serve as a trusted senior partner to directors and other leaders; anticipate emerging needs and bring clear recommendations, trade-offs, and decisions, not just status.
* Translate technical findings into business impact and actionable choices; help leaders balance risk and business objectives through practical mitigations.
* Lead the distributed Enterprise Solutions BISO team across the US and USI. Set priorities and expectations, review work early, coach team members, resolve delivery barriers, and hold workstreams accountable for quality and outcomes.
* Establish and reinforce secure-by-design practices and security awareness across Enterprise Solutions, in partnership with business and technology leaders.

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

* Applications

* Strategic Financial Management

* Minimum 1 year of people and/or process management experience.

**About Allocore and the role**
-------------------------------

Allocore runs a unified cloud platform for government loan, grant, and fraud-prevention programs. Agencies use it to deliver critical funds to the people and businesses that need them, at high volume and with strong security controls.

Program Managers sit at the center of that delivery. You connect client commitments to what Product, Domain, Engineering, Data, and Integration teams actually build, and you make sure the two stay aligned. Our values are Urgency, Collaboration, and Commitment. In this role, that means moving fast on decisions, working openly across teams, and following through on what we promised the client.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

**Delivery outcomes**

* Own the delivery plan, milestones, and commitments for your program, and answer for the results
* Sequence requirements, configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and operational readiness so nothing blocks downstream work
* Lead cutovers from legacy systems to production, including readiness reviews and go/no-go decisions
* Spot slippage early and drive corrective action before the client feels it

**Client relationships**

* Be a trusted day-to-day partner to client program leads, and at the senior level to client executives
* Run status reviews and governance forums, and translate technical detail into clear decisions and next steps
* Set expectations honestly, and escalate with context, impact, and a recommendation
