* Align Product, Domain, Engineering, Data, and Integration teams around one plan, and resolve conflicts between requirements, technical design, and timelines
* Manage dependencies owned by other teams, vendors, and client organizations
* Keep decisions, owners, and next steps documented and followed through

**Risk and issue management**

* Surface risks before they affect milestones, and drive blockers to resolution
* Report program health clearly and consistently to internal leaders and clients

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

**Core requirements**

* Proven delivery of complex technology programs, including enterprise implementations, system integrations, or platform rollouts
* Experience leading cross-functional teams across product, engineering, data, QA, and business or domain groups
* Confidence working directly with clients, and the judgment to give them straight answers
* Strong plans and trackers: milestones, dependencies, risks, and decisions that people actually use
* Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical audiences
* Comfort in a fast-moving environment with evolving requirements
* **U.S. citizenship and eligibility to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance** (we will guide you through the process)

**Strongly preferred**

* Experience in lending, grants, credit, or other financial services programs
* Experience with financial systems or payment platforms, such as reconciliation or disbursement
* Experience leading a cutover from a legacy system to production
* Experience managing delivery that depends on external vendors or client-owned teams
* Government or other regulated-industry program experience

**Helpful**

* Agile delivery experience and tools such as Jira
* Data migration and high-growth or scaling technology environments

**Additional for senior-level scope**

* Accountable delivery lead across 3 or more teams for a major program
* Regular engagement with client executives at the Director level or above

**Why Allocore**
----------------

* **Real scope and authority.** You own program outcomes, not just the plan, and you work directly with client leaders.
* **Work that matters.** Your programs put loans and grants in the hands of people and businesses that depend on them.
* **Complex, high-volume delivery.** Large government programs, legacy cutovers, and financial integrations that will stretch your skills.
* **Growth with startup energy.** A growing team where strong delivery leaders shape how programs are run, and move up as scope grows.

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
* Choice of health plans, with free dental and free vision
* Flexible work hours and hybrid work options
* Unlimited PTO and company holidays
* A collaborative, inclusive team

**How hiring works**
--------------------

* **Apply.** It takes a few minutes. We review every application.
* **Recruiter conversation.** A short call about your experience, the role, and what you are looking for.
* **Interviews.** Meet the team, discuss real delivery situations from your experience, and ask us anything. Most candidates complete this stage within a week.
* **Decision.** We decide quickly and make an offer if there is a mutual fit.

Offers are conditional on a background check. A criminal conviction does not automatically disqualify a candidate; results are evaluated according to applicable law and relevance to the job.

Title: Project Manager - Program Management (St Louis)
Description:
**Description**

Burns & McDonnell is proud to be the market leader in providing program management services to the electric utility industry. As our clients focus on their capital investment in the energy delivery market, Burns & McDonnell brings a seasoned team to assist them across a variety of operational roles to ensure the needed grid improvements are executed on time and on budget. The ideal candidate will have a safety-first mindset, be dedicated to making their clients and teams successful, and take an entrepreneurial approach to their job. As programs are an extension of our clients day-to-day operations, roles within the program management track allow for frequent, often daily, client interaction. Engineers on the program management track leverage their technical expertise and education to make informed decisions in the execution of projects on behalf of our clients.

Project managers at Burns & McDonnell are a key part of our informal leadership structure. They will be expected to mentor junior staff and lead multi-disciplinary teams in the execution of our most complex projects. In the program management organization, project managers will be relied on to support the overall development of project management capabilities through the functional leadership of day-to-day task execution. Project managers may lead specific functional areas within a larger program or lead the entirety of a smaller program working directly with our clients to provide a premier client experience.

Generally, project managers in program management will pursue job responsibilities in the following areas:

**Project Management**

* Lead a cross-functional team to execute substation, transmission line, and telecommunication projects from inception through design and construction to closeout.
* Oversee 5-20 projects concurrently of varying sizes ($100k-$50M ) and voltages (4kV-765kV).
* Manage projects for schedule adherence identifying risks and requirements to successfully achieve a project’s in-service date.
* Navigate projects through client gate approval processes including presentations to senior and executive management as required by each client.
* Manage projects for financial adherence maintaining an accurate cost forecast reflecting committed and uncommitted costs for an estimate-at-completion.
* Coordinate craft labor resources with client approved vendors for construction, testing and other field activities.
* Provide regular status updates on projects by maintaining project data and routine reporting as well as meeting updates for clients.
* Lead project meetings with cost, schedule, real estate, environmental, construction and engineering resources to facilitate project execution.

**Portfolio Management**

* Develop a multi-year capital expenditure plan to support client’s replacement and betterment of electric transmission and distribution assets.
* Regular interface and coordination with project sponsor organizations to determine details of proposed plans and business justification.
* Ensure synergies across projects are incorporated into the portfolio of work to prevent scope from being duplicated or performed inefficiently.
* Monitor composition of client’s capital investment allocation to align with stated subsidiary investment targets for optimal rate of return.
* Engage with project sponsors to evaluate need-by date for realistic schedules and budgets.
* Assist with creation and compilation of rate filing support for federal and state filings.
* Review tabletop engineering estimates for accuracy and scope.
* Review project change requests (scope, In-service date, etc.) and reconcile with the existing and long-range portfolio of work.
* Interface with client’s accounting group to establish financial setup for projects.
* Create analyses & reports to assist the client in tracking, coordination, and execution of projects.
* Build baseline scopes, schedules, and budgets to be released to multiple client’s stakeholders.

**Outage/Construction Sequencing**

* Responsible for development of substation and transmission project construction lifecycles with focus on outage efficiency and constructability.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting specified deliverable dates and expectations.
* Analyze scoping and project documents to determine boundaries of required construction within substation and within electric grid.
* Conduct site walkdowns and project calls with project team as necessary to establish an achievable construction sequence with attainable outages.
* Analyze needed outages against adjacent outages scheduled in the area.
* Create initial outage sequence to communicate proposed construction lifecycle to project team.
* Coordinate with drafting resources to create engineering-caliber drawings that document the evolution of a project from present conditions to final state, and all needed incremental steps.
* As part of the Burns & McDonnell team we are looking for team members that foster a culture based on our MacCulture Principles, quality, diversity, and inclusion to enhance team cohesion and camaraderie. Individuals who want to tackle new and novel challenges within the utility industry to help our clients improve the execution of capital investment work can find entrepreneurial opportunities to assist in the pursuit and expansion of our program management offerings.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor Degree in engineering, construction management or related degree from accredited program required.
* Minimum of seven years of experience in engineering design, project management or a relevant role required.
* Completion of P.E., PMP, MBA or comparable advanced degree strongly preferred.
* Excellent facilitation, collaboration, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to thoughtfully and positively influence, lead and manage.
* Strong planning and analytical skills.
* E.I.T. or PE license strongly preferred.
* Must demonstrate superb oral and written communication skills, strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to clearly and effectively present complex information to all levels of employees, management, and clients.
* Demonstrated success in project management which includes proposal development, contract negotiations, project planning, team leadership, budgeting, schedule management, and client coordination.
* Proven ability to develop business and establish relationships with clients.
* Travel 15-25% depending on project assignment and client needs.

This job posting will remain open a minimum of 72 hours and on an ongoing basis until filled.

Title: Head of Information Technology
Description:
Welcome to
**MultiBank Group**
, a global financial pioneer established in 2005 in California and now proudly headquartered in Dubai, UAE. We specialize in delivering cutting-edge trading technology, unparalleled liquidity, and exceptional customer service. Our extensive range of financial products includes Forex, Metals, Shares, Indices, Commodities, and Cryptocurrency CFDs.

Join our thriving community of over 2 million clients across 100 countries, contributing to a daily trading volume exceeding US$ 35 billion. As a heavily regulated institution with oversight from 18+ financial regulators across 5 continents, and recipient of over 80 financial awards, MultiBank Group is devoted to innovation, excellence, and empowering our clients to achieve their financial goals.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Head of IT to lead our global IT function within MultiBank Group. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role with accountability for infrastructure, cloud, networks, corporate systems, AI applications, IT service management, business continuity and IT audits across all our offices worldwide.

You will lead the Support, Network and Systems Engineering teams and the Jira team, drive IT projects from start to finish, and build the IT foundation for every new office we open. The ideal candidate is technically strong, structured, security-minded and comfortable leading people in a fast-paced, regulated environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**IT Leadership & Engineering Teams**

* Lead, mentor and develop the Support Engineering, Network Engineering, Systems Engineering and Jira teams.
* Oversee systems used by the engineering organisation and ensure Jira supports delivery teams effectively.
* Define the IT roadmap and align it with business and regulatory priorities.

**Infrastructure, Cloud & Network**

* Own the in-house cloud servers and hosting environment, including capacity, availability and cost.
* Oversee network engineering across all global offices, including connectivity, performance and monitoring.
* Manage Azure and Cloudflare services, including DNS, WAF and Zero Trust.
* Manage internal corporate domains.
* Run telephony systems such as 3CX.

**Corporate Systems, SaaS & Microsoft 365**

* Take responsibility for the company's SaaS portfolio, covering selection, onboarding, licensing, renewals and offboarding.
* Administer Microsoft 365, including tenant security, licensing and governance.
* Own SSO and user registration and provisioning processes, working closely with Security and HR.
* Understand and oversee API integrations between internal and third-party systems.

**IT Service Management (ITSM)**

* Own the ITSM framework: incident, request, change and problem management, with clear SLAs and reporting.
* Ensure the support desk delivers consistent service to every office and time zone.

**Projects & Global Offices**

* Manage IT projects end to end, from scoping and business case through delivery and review.
* Be responsible for IT in all global offices.
* Lead the IT setup for new offices opened across the globe, including network, devices, access, telephony and local compliance needs.

**Security, Business Continuity & Audits**

* Apply security best practice across the IT estate, working with the Security team to protect systems, data and endpoints.
* Own Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery plans, including regular testing.
* Be responsible for global and internal IT audits, including evidence preparation, auditor coordination and closing findings.

**Required Knowledge & Experience**

* At least 10 years of experience in IT, including 5 years in a senior leadership role managing multiple technical teams.
* Proven experience running IT across multiple countries or offices, ideally in financial services, fintech or another regulated industry.
* Track record of setting up new offices from an IT standpoint.
* Strong hands-on experience with:
* Microsoft 365 administration and Azure
* Cloudflare, DNS and domain management
* Enterprise networking (LAN/WAN, VPN, firewalls)
* Private or in-house cloud and server infrastructure
* Telephony platforms
* ITSM tools and frameworks (ITIL or equivalent) and Jira administration
* SSO, identity management and user registration and provisioning flows
* Good understanding of APIs and system integrations.
* Practical security experience across infrastructure, endpoints, access control and data protection.
* Experience designing and testing Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery plans.
* Experience leading internal and external IT audits, for example ISO 27001, SOC 2 or regulator-driven reviews.
* Familiarity with enterprise AI tools and the governance they require.
* Experience writing and enforcing IT policies and procedures.
* Experience with IT budgeting, vendor negotiation and cost control.
* Strong project management skills across the full project lifecycle.

**Desirable Knowledge & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field (Master's preferred).
* Certifications such as ITIL, CISSP, CISM, PMP or PRINCE2, Azure Administrator or Azure Solutions Architect, or equivalent.
* Experience in brokerage, trading or exchange environments with high-availability requirements.
* Experience introducing and governing AI tools across an enterprise.
* Exposure to multi-jurisdiction regulatory requirements affecting IT and data.
* Fluency in Arabic or another language relevant to our regions.

**Why Join Us?**

* Work with an industry-leading global financial institution.
* Competitive salary and comprehensive employee benefits.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Collaborative, inclusive, and dynamic work environment.
* Commitment to innovation and professional excellence.

*Become part of our international community at MultiBank Group, dedicated to excellence, innovation, and shaping the future of finance.*

Title: General Manager
Description:
Hiring : GM, Customer Engagement (CPaas)

**Reports to:**
CEO

**Scope:**
Customer Engagement /
**CX Pod P&L Owner.**

**About The role :**

U2opia is looking for a hands-on commercial leader to grow its Customer Engagement business across messaging and adjacent channels, including SMS, WhatsApp, RCS and Voice AI.

You will own the pod’s revenue and contribution margin, lead its team, and turn existing products and capabilities into a substantially larger business. You will work through U2opia’s Wholesale, Enterprise and Self Serve teams, using their customer relationships, distribution and market access to find and close opportunities.

This is a business-building role for someone who has grown a CPaaS or messaging business before. You should be comfortable selling, setting priorities, improving unit economics and managing a lean team.

**What you will own**

* **Growth:**
  Build and execute a plan to grow revenue across existing customers, new enterprise accounts, partners and self-serve customers.
* **Commercial performance:**
  Own pricing, gross margin, retention, expansion and the pod’s contribution to company profitability. Maintain a clear view of revenue and margin by product, customer and channel.
* **Go-to-market:**
  Identify where Wholesale, Enterprise and Self-Serve can sell or distribute CX products, then make those opportunities repeatable through clear offers, sales support and follow-through.
* **Customer value:**
  Work with customers to understand their communication needs and shape solutions that deliver measurable value. Personally lead important deals and strategic accounts.
* **Product priorities:**
  Use customer demand and commercial evidence to decide which capabilities to improve, package, launch or stop pursuing. Work closely with product, technology and operations on execution.
* **Team leadership:**
  Set targets and accountability for the pod, coach the team and make effective use of shared resources across U2opia.
* **Operating rhythm:**
  Run a disciplined pipeline and business review covering revenue, margin, conversion, customer health, delivery issues and decisions needed.

**What we are looking for**

* Experience in CPaaS, business messaging or a closely related telecom software business.
* Demonstrated ownership of revenue and margin, with specific examples of a business, product line or region you grew. We will want to understand your starting point, actions and results.
* Experience selling through more than one route to market, such as enterprise sales, channel partners, wholesale relationships or self-serve.
* Strong commercial judgment on pricing, packaging, customer acquisition and account expansion.
* Enough technical fluency to work credibly with product and engineering teams on messaging channels, APIs, integrations and delivery constraints.
* A practical manager who can lead a small team and deliver results without building a large organisation first.

**What success looks like**

In your first 90 days, you will establish the pod’s revenue and margin baseline, identify the highest-potential growth opportunities, and agree on a focused plan with clear owners and targets. Over the following year, success will be measured by
**material revenue growth, healthy contribution margin, stronger customer retention and a repeatable sales motion**
across U2opia’s existing channels.

Title: Engineering Manager
Description:
**Job Purpose:**

Lead team of software engineers within the Engineering & E-commerce function. Own the delivery, quality and production reliability of the systems within the assigned domain, such as ordering, menu serving, payments, loyalty, aggregator integration, in-store technology or customer platforms. Turn approved priorities into working, reliable software, delivered on time and at a controlled cost. This enables the company to serve customers and locations across markets and grow digital sales.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the assigned domain end to end - Own the architecture, roadmap execution, quality and production reliability of the domain’s systems and APIs. The scope of the domain will be assigned in writing by the line manager.
* Deliver the approved roadmap predictably - Define scope, estimate, sequence, manage risks and dependencies, and report status and trade-offs early, in line with the department’s software development lifecycle, so that commitments to the business are met.
* Own the system design and architecture of the domain - Propose designs and architecture changes and make technical trade-offs related to performance, resilience, data consistency, security, cost and time to market. Decisions must remain within the architecture principles and engineering standards established by the Director of Engineering & E-commerce and the engineering leadership.
* Own the reliability of the domain systems - Define and meet service-level objectives. Run on-call support, incident response and root-cause analysis. Monitor systems using the reliability tools provided by Platform Engineering and keep systems fast and efficient under peak loads.
* Use AI by default and advocate its use - Use AI for software development and the automation of other tasks, in line with the department’s AI usage standards. Maintain engineering quality through automated testing, code reviews, continuous integration and deployment, secure coding and controlled releases, including feature flags, progressive rollouts and rollback plans.
* Act as custodian of the domain’s spend - Track cloud consumption, licences and contractor time. Identify and remove waste and raise cost risks early with the line manager. Commercial and budget decisions remain with the line manager and must follow company processes.
* Build, lead and grow a team of software engineers - Coach team members, provide regular feedback, manage performance and support career development. Contribute to hiring through the company’s recruitment process. Direct the day-to-day work of external developers, contractors or vendors when assigned to the domain.
* Align with peers and stakeholders before acting - Agree on interfaces, dependencies and priorities with other Engineering Managers, Product, Operations and business teams. Escalate disagreements to the line manager with clear options. Do not make unilateral decisions that change another team’s work, cost or risk.

**Leadership Requirements:**

* Ownership: Takes full accountability for the domain, its production systems and its people.
* Hands-on credibility: Designs systems and understands the code sufficiently to make sound technical decisions and coach engineers.
* AI-first mindset: Uses AI by default and leads the team to do the same.
* Delivery discipline: Plans realistically, commits carefully and keeps commitments.
* Calm under pressure: Leads clearly during incidents and peak periods.
* Decides through alignment: Works across team boundaries through agreement rather than authority.
* Financial responsibility: Treats company money responsibly in every technical decision.
* People development: Develops software engineers and builds a culture of engineering excellence.

**Major Challenges**

* Deliver new features while maintaining production stability.
* Manage dependencies on other teams and vendors that the role does not directly control.
* Reduce technical debt and modernize legacy systems while keeping the systems operational.
* Maintain delivery quality across a team comprising employees and external developers working in different locations.
* Migrate existing systems to the department’s standard programming language, Golang, while continuing ongoing delivery.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field
* Cloud or architecture certification is an advantage

**Experience:**

Title: Business Development Manager - Saudi National

* Balance client needs, delivery credibility and commercial outcomes when closing opportunities.

* Work alongside the Business Development and Advisory teams to shape government, energy, defence and space propositions, bringing client insight and helping validate market need and competitor positioning.
* Contribute to joint propositions and commercial models, including local partnerships and strategic supplier relationships, that showcase end-to-end solutions.

* Pitch Serco's capabilities and deliver value propositions against client requirements through high-quality presentations and proposals.
* Represent Serco at industry conferences, trade shows and networking events in KSA.
* Work with colleagues to share operational good practice, exploit synergies and promote cross-selling across sectors and business units.

**Team Contribution, Reporting and Compliance**

* Support and guide junior sales and business development colleagues, and contribute to the development of local talent in line with Saudization and capability-building objectives.
* Act as sales sponsor on assigned accounts, working with Operations to ensure quality, client satisfaction and measurable outcomes.
* Maintain accurate records of sales activity and provide regular updates to the Sales Director and senior management.
* Ensure compliance with local laws, regulations and cultural considerations in KSA, and contribute to Serco-wide corporate governance and good practice.

* 10 to 15 years of relevant experience and an established network across Saudi government, semi government organisations, PIF companies and major infrastructure operators.
* Demonstrable experience working with government entities, ministries, giga-projects, sovereign-backed organisations and/or PIF-related environments.
* Experience in the energy sector (oil and gas, power and utilities, renewables or energy services), with a network among key energy-sector stakeholders.
* Exposure to the defence and space sectors, including engagement with defence and space entities, programmes and partners.
* Proven track record of originating and closing complex opportunities and delivering significant annual revenue in government services, consulting or related sectors.
* Experience contributing to commercial negotiations, including strategic partnerships, JVs and multi-stakeholder opportunities.
* Bidding and commercial experience on large, complex business opportunities.
* Good understanding of the Saudi business and government landscape, Vision 2030 priorities, and national transformation programmes and investment themes.
* Experience navigating public procurement and relationship-led market development.
* Familiarity with PIF ecosystem dynamics, giga-project stakeholder structures and local partnership models.
* Appreciation of localization, Saudization and in-Kingdom value creation expectations, with high cultural awareness.

**Join Us**

At Serco, we believe there is a place here for everyone. A place where you can bring your authentic self to work every day. Our workplace culture is one that embraces diversity and fosters equity, respect, and belonging for every individual. We are committed to equal employment opportunities and creating an inclusive environment that proudly celebrates the perspectives and backgrounds that each of our employees bring to work every day.

Join Serco and be part of a values-driven organization that invests in the development and well-being of its employees and offers a rewarding and fulfilling career.

Serco is committed to Equal Employment Opportunities and is committed to ensuring the safety of all of its employees through its Zero Harm initiative. Please visit **careers.serco.com** for more information.

Title: Gestionnaire, plateformes technologiques d’ingénierie
Description:
**Job Description**
**Et si vous pouviez redéfinir ce qui est possible? Avec nous, vous le pouvez.**
Avec nous, vous le pouvez. Vous recherchez un travail qui a du sens. Des possibilités de croissance. Des occasions de vous dépasser. Des gens qui vous comprennent.
  
  
Nous sommes le foyer de personnes ambitieuses, passionnées et innovantes qui façonnent le monde de demain.
  
  
Grâce à une expertise inégalée en ingénierie, en services-conseils et en sciences, nos équipes à travers le monde unissent leurs forces pour créer des solutions adaptées aux réalités locales.
  
  
Nous ouvrons la voie et générons un impact.
  
  
Nous sommes des visionnaires.
  
  
Nous sommes WSP.
  
  
**L’opportunité**
Prenez les commandes de la stratégie, de la livraison, de la gouvernance et de l’excellence opérationnelle des plateformes technologiques qui soutiennent les applications d’ingénierie de WSP à l’échelle mondiale. Dans ce rôle de leadership, vous contribuerez à créer des environnements sécuritaires, évolutifs, résilients et rentables couvrant notamment l’hébergement d’applications, les plateformes infonuagiques et hébergées par des fournisseurs, l’infrastructure de bureau virtuel (VDI), la gouvernance des données, l’automatisation et les technologies d’ingénierie de nouvelle génération.
  
  
En collaborant avec les équipes Client Delivery Solutions (CDS), Infrastructure, Sécurité, Architecture, Données et IA ainsi qu’avec les équipes d’ingénierie, vous contribuerez à créer les conditions permettant à nos équipes de projets et à nos professionnels de l’ingénierie de donner le meilleur d’eux-mêmes, tout en préparant WSP aux technologies et aux méthodes de travail de demain.
  
  
**Votre impact**

* Façonner la stratégie et les opérations des plateformes d’ingénierie : Définir et gouverner la stratégie technologique des plateformes soutenant les applications d’ingénierie mondiales. Assurer la préparation opérationnelle, la disponibilité, la performance, la résilience et l’évolutivité des environnements technologiques d’ingénierie. Établir les normes de plateforme, les cadres de gouvernance technique et les procédures d’exploitation des services, tout en dirigeant la planification du cycle de vie et les initiatives de modernisation.
* Faire évoluer l’infrastructure de bureau virtuel et les environnements informatiques d’ingénierie : Définir la stratégie et la feuille de route relatives aux environnements VDI et aux solutions informatiques à distance pour l’ingénierie. Collaborer avec les équipes Infrastructure afin d’optimiser la performance, l’expérience utilisateur, l’accélération graphique et les charges de travail d’ingénierie. Définir les normes relatives aux postes de travail d’ingénierie, aux postes infonuagiques et aux modèles de prestation hybrides, tout en évaluant les technologies et les nouvelles approches de déploiement.
* Gouverner la demande, la livraison et les ressources : Superviser l’admission, la priorisation et la réalisation des initiatives technologiques d’ingénierie. Gérer l’affectation des ressources, la planification de la capacité des équipes et les priorités de livraison. Collaborer avec le CDS Front Door, le PMO, l’Architecture et les parties prenantes d’affaires afin d’assurer la bonne exécution des initiatives de plateforme, tout en surveillant la performance de livraison, les risques, les dépendances et la réalisation de la valeur.
* Renforcer la gouvernance des données et la gestion du cycle de vie de l’information : Définir les pratiques de gouvernance et de gestion du cycle de vie des données provenant des applications d’ingénierie. Élaborer des stratégies de conservation, d’archivage, de récupération, de conformité et d’accessibilité à long terme. Gouverner les environnements applicatifs hébergés par des fournisseurs ainsi que ceux hébergés dans l’environnement infonuagique de WSP. Collaborer avec les équipes Gouvernance des données, Sécurité, Juridique et Conformité afin de respecter les normes de l’entreprise et soutenir les stratégies favorisant l’analytique, l’IA et la livraison numérique.
* Accélérer l’innovation et l’adoption de technologies d’avenir : Évaluer les technologies émergentes, les services infonuagiques, les plateformes d’ingénierie alimentées par l’IA et les possibilités d’automatisation. Élaborer des feuilles de route technologiques adaptées à l’évolution des modèles de prestation en ingénierie. Cerner les possibilités d’amélioration de la productivité, de l’évolutivité, de la durabilité et de l’expérience utilisateur, et diriger des preuves de concept, projets pilotes d’innovation et programmes de modernisation technologique.
* Diriger la gouvernance des plateformes et la collaboration interfonctionnelle : Collaborer avec les équipes Infrastructure, Cybersécurité, Architecture d’entreprise et Opérations afin d’assurer l’alignement des plateformes. Définir les normes techniques, les pratiques de gestion du changement et les processus de gouvernance opérationnelle. Veiller à ce que les changements apportés aux plateformes d’ingénierie soient testés, documentés et soutenus sur le plan opérationnel, tout en assurant un leadership lors d’escalades techniques complexes et d’initiatives de plateforme à l’échelle de l’entreprise.
* Assurer la gestion financière et le leadership auprès de la haute direction : Gérer les budgets des plateformes, les prévisions, la planification des investissements et les initiatives d’optimisation. Élaborer des analyses de rentabilité et des recommandations d’investissement technologique. Favoriser l’optimisation des coûts liés à l’infonuagique, à l’infrastructure, à l’hébergement et aux services opérationnels, et produire des rapports destinés à la direction, des tableaux de bord, des présentations et des mises à jour de gouvernance.
* Développer l’équipe mondiale et le modèle opérationnel : Diriger et développer une équipe mondiale de spécialistes des plateformes et des technologies d’ingénierie. Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des modèles évolutifs de prestation et de soutien. Diriger la planification de la main-d’œuvre, le développement des capacités, le perfectionnement des compétences et la planification de la relève. Établir des structures de gouvernance et des modèles d’engagement pour les parties prenantes d’affaires et les équipes TI interfonctionnelles, tout en favorisant une culture de responsabilisation, d’innovation, de collaboration et d’amélioration continue.

**Les compétences qui vous distinguent**

* Formation et leadership des plateformes d’entreprise : Baccalauréat en technologies de l’information, informatique, ingénierie ou dans une discipline connexe, ainsi qu’une expérience significative dans la gestion de plateformes d’entreprise, de services d’infrastructure, de technologies infonuagiques ou d’environnements d’applications d’ingénierie.
* Expertise des environnements informatiques d’ingénierie : Expérience des environnements VDI, de l’informatique d’ingénierie, des plateformes d’hébergement infonuagique et de la prestation d’applications à l’échelle de l’entreprise. Une expérience des écosystèmes d’applications liés à l’ingénierie, au BIM, aux SIG/GIS, à la livraison numérique, à la simulation ou à la conception constitue un atout.
* Expertise en gouvernance des données : Solide compréhension des pratiques de gouvernance, de conservation, d’archivage et de gestion du cycle de vie des données, combinée à une connaissance des cadres d’architecture d’entreprise, de cybersécurité et de gouvernance des données.
* Leadership dans la réalisation d’initiatives complexes : Expérience de la gestion de portefeuilles de livraison technique et d’initiatives interfonctionnelles complexes. Expérience avec ITIL, Agile, SAFe ou des méthodologies de livraison comparables.
* Leadership mondial et modèles opérationnels : Expérience de la direction d’équipes techniques mondiales et de la transformation de modèles opérationnels.
* Gestion financière et investissements technologiques : Solide expérience de la gestion financière et des investissements technologiques, notamment en matière de budgets, de prévisions, de dossiers d’affaires, d’investissements et d’optimisation des coûts.
* Transformation infonuagique et modernisation : Expérience avec Microsoft Azure, les architectures cloud natives, les plateformes DaaS/VDI ainsi que les initiatives de modernisation de l’infrastructure. Expérience dans la direction de transformations infonuagiques et d’initiatives de modernisation des plateformes.
* Influence auprès des parties prenantes et de la haute direction : Excellentes aptitudes en gestion des parties prenantes, en communication avec la haute direction et en présentation. Excellente maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

Title: Manager, Technology Audit
Description:
Job Description:

Referral Level: Level 1

Location: Toronto/Winnipeg

**Mackenzie Investments**

IGM Financial Inc. is a leading wealth and asset management company in Canada, managing approximately $310 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025. It offers financial planning and investment services to over two million Canadians through IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments.

Mackenzie Investments, founded in 1967, is a key part of IGM's business model, serving as a comprehensive asset-management partner for Canadian financial advisors and their clients.

**At Mackenzie Investments, we believe being invested starts with our people.** We are proud to be recognized as one of Canada’s Top 100 Employers for the fourth consecutive year and one of Canada’s Best Diversity Employers. Our vision and strategy aim to innovate the industry and support Canadians in achieving their financial goals.

Join our team to engage in continuous learning and skill development in a supportive environment. Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work environment, where you spend three days a week in the office, connecting, collaborating, and enjoying quality time with your amazing colleagues! Our Values: Be better; we strive for improvement in everything we do. Be accountable; we foster clarity and are empowered to act responsibly. Be a team; we are united to drive collective impact to achieve our goals.

**Role Overview**  
The Manager, IT Audit reports to the Director, IT Audit and is responsible for planning and executing risk-based technology audit and advisory engagements. This role focuses on assessing risks and controls across cloud environments, DevSecOps practices, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, and enterprise technology platforms. The successful candidate will work closely with technology and business stakeholders to provide practical, risk-based recommendations that strengthen governance, risk management, and control processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Leverage AI and analytics tools to improve audit efficiency, risk assessment, testing methodologies, and reporting processes.
* Assess governance and controls over AI and machine learning solutions, including model development, validation, monitoring, explainability, accountability, bias management, and data governance.
* Develop and execute data-enabled audit approaches using analytics, visualization, automation, and continuous auditing techniques.
* Assess risks associated with generative AI technologies, large language models, agentic systems, and third-party AI services.
* Lead and execute technology audit engagements from planning through reporting.
* Perform audits of cloud environments, including governance, security, identity and access management, resilience, and third-party risk controls.
* Assess DevSecOps processes, CI/CD pipelines, secure software development practices, and deployment controls.
* Evaluate governance, risk management, security, privacy, and regulatory considerations associated with AI solutions and emerging technologies.
* Assess IT general controls, automated controls, application controls, and cybersecurity controls.
* Participate in audits of major technology transformation initiatives, cloud migrations, and digital programs.
* Support integrated audits by identifying technology risks that may impact business processes.
* Develop clear and concise audit findings and recommendations.
* Build effective relationships with technology, cybersecurity, risk management, and business stakeholders.
* Monitor emerging risks and industry trends related to cloud computing, AI, cyber security, and software engineering.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across audit methodologies, quality assurance processes, audit technology, and reporting practices.
* Act as a trusted advisor to technology leadership on risk, governance, and control matters.
* Provide guidance and coaching to junior auditors and co-op students where applicable.

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong understanding of technology risk management and control frameworks including NIST, COBIT, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
* Hands-on experience auditing cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Experience reviewing DevSecOps environments, Agile delivery practices, CI/CD pipelines, and software development lifecycle controls.

* Experience using data analytics and visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Diligent/ ACL, Python, SQL, Databricks, or equivalent tools.
* Understanding AI governance, AI model risks, data quality, privacy, explainability, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience with scripting, automation, or audit technology solutions to improve assurance effectiveness.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity concepts including identity and access management, vulnerability management, logging and monitoring, and incident response.

**Professional Experience**  

* 5-8 years of experience in IT audit, technology risk, cybersecurity, data analytics, or related assurance functions, with demonstrated experience leading complex audit engagements.
* Experience in financial services, asset management, wealth management, or other regulated industries is preferred.
* Experience working with cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, and AI-related risks is required.

**Education and Certifications**

**Mandatory Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or related field.
* CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) or CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control)

**Preferred / Optional Certifications**  

* CPA (Certified Professional Accountant) or CIA (Certified Internal Auditor)

* CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) certification.
* CISM (Certified Information Security Manager).  
  + CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional).
  + Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert or Azure Security Engineer Associate.
  + ISACA Advanced in AI Audit (AAIA) or equivalent AI audit certification.

**Leadership and Competencies**  

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Strong stakeholder relationship management skills.
* High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.

**Additional Information**  

* Hybrid work model (3 days in office per week).
* Occasional travel may be required.

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $86,000 - $123,000 which is determined based on skills, knowledge and experience and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for annual short-term incentive, health and well-being benefits, retirement and savings plan, paid time off and career development.

**Benefits*****:***

* **COMPETITIVE COMPENSATION & RECOGNITION:** competitive base salary, performance-weighted bonus, education/career support, option to join Employee Share Purchase Plan with employer matching component.
* **EMPLOYEE BENEFITS & INSURANCE:** competitive health and dental coverage, flexible plan for you and your family and short-term & long-term disability plans.
* **RETIREMENT SAVINGS PROGRAMS:** voluntary Group RRSP enrolment with employer matching component.

* **INCLUSIVE CULTURE AND DIVERSITY:** living our core values: Be a Team, Be Accountable, Be Better, engaging with community through Business Resource Groups (BRG communities are volunteer employee-led groups formed around a common interest, identity, or background).

The Director, Provider Network Strategy and Contracting leads Aetna’s provider network strategy and contracting agenda for a geographic area of Florida “Market(s)”. Our teams and brands serve passionate communities around the world—and we’re looking for equally passionate people to help us grow.

  

**Website:** https://www.collectivusholdings.com/  
**Global Locations:** Aarhus - Dallas - Delhi - Lisbon - Nashville - Remote Worldwide

**Job Title:** Head of Digital Experiences

**Reporting Line:** CEO

  

Collectivus Holdings is seeking a strategic and execution-focused Head of Digital Experiences to lead the vision, strategy, performance, and the ongoing evolution of our external-facing digital platforms across our portfolio of businesses.

This leader will oversee the digital product strategy and roadmap for our Learning Management System (LMS), Sorted app, and other customer-, retailer-, and partner-facing digital experiences.

The role is responsible for ensuring our digital products deliver meaningful value to users, support business objectives, and create a connected, intuitive experience across the Collectivus ecosystem.

Working closely with business leaders, Technology, Product, Sales, and Operations, this individual will translate business needs into clear digital priorities, partner on scalable software delivery and support processes, and drive measurable results.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Digital Strategy & Leadership**

* Develop and own the enterprise-wide strategy for external-facing digital products and experiences.
* Establish a cohesive digital vision across Collectivus businesses while addressing the unique needs of each brand and customer segment.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer engagement, retailer adoption, operational efficiency, and revenue through digital solutions.
* Build and manage a prioritized digital roadmap aligned with business objectives, available resources, and expected returns.
* Evaluate new digital opportunities, partnerships, and capabilities that support long-term business growth.

### **Digital Product Ownership**

Provide strategic direction and product leadership for key digital platforms, including:

* **Learning Management System (LMS):** Guide platform development, user experience, educational content delivery capabilities, community engagement, and adoption.
* **Sorted App:** Own the product vision, user experience, feature prioritization, and ongoing evolution of the platform.
* **Additional Digital Experiences:** Provide oversight and strategic alignment for other external-facing websites, applications, portals, and digital tools across the organization.
* Ensure each platform has a defined product strategy, roadmap, ownership structure, and measurable performance expectations.

### **Customer & Partner Experience**

* Champion a customer-first approach to digital product development.
* Ensure digital experiences are intuitive, reliable, accessible, and aligned with customer and partner needs.
* Use customer feedback, usage analytics, and market insights to inform product enhancements.
* Identify opportunities to create more connected experiences across platforms and business units.
* Partner with commercial teams to improve digital adoption, engagement, and customer retention.

### **Execution & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Product Engineering to translate product requirements into scalable, secure, reliable solutions, with clear accountability for product priorities, engineering execution, and business acceptance.
* Work with business leaders to understand priorities, evaluate requests, and establish clear product requirements.
* Lead product prioritization and make recommendations on resource allocation and investment.
* Establish clear product milestones, acceptance criteria, launch readiness expectations, and accountability for digital initiatives in partnership with delivery teams.
* Coordinate internal teams and external vendors to ensure successful product development and launches.
* Identify and resolve competing priorities, dependencies, and execution risks.
* Ensure new functionality is supported by appropriate launch, training, and adoption plans.
* Ensure each product has appropriate production-readiness criteria, monitoring, service expectations, documentation, and support arrangements before launch.
* Help establish a scalable keep-the-lights-on (KTLO) operating model for digital products, including service ownership, support processes, incident escalation, and ongoing enhancements.
* Define clear decision rights and handoffs among product, engineering, project delivery, and operations teams, including ownership of requirements, technical delivery, business acceptance, and production support.

### **Business Performance & Accountability**

* Establish KPIs for each digital platform, including revenue and monetization where applicable, user adoption, engagement, retention, customer satisfaction, and financial performance.
* Own digital product operating budgets and develop business cases for new digital investments, including anticipated benefits, costs, and ROI.
* Monitor product performance and use data to guide prioritization and continuous improvement.
* Provide regular updates to executive leadership on roadmap progress, performance, risks, and investment needs.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of existing platforms and recommend where to invest, improve, consolidate, or discontinue functionality.

### **Team & Vendor Leadership**

* Build and lead a high-performing digital product function as business needs evolve.
* Establish clear roles, responsibilities, and decision-making processes across digital initiatives.
* Manage relationships with external development partners, technology vendors, and service providers.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and measurable outcomes.

  

**Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Digital Product Management, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in digital product management, digital strategy, or platform leadership.
* Demonstrated experience leading multiple customer-facing digital products or platforms.
* Strong understanding of product development, user experience, platform integrations, and digital ecosystems.
* Experience with SaaS platforms, mobile applications, LMS platforms, or retailer-facing technology strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to develop digital roadmaps and translate business objectives into actionable product priorities.
* Experience managing cross-functional teams, technical resources, and external development partners.
* Strong commercial acumen, including experience evaluating product investments, business cases, and ROI.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and customer insights to improve digital performance.
* Experience operating across multiple businesses, brands, or international markets preferred.

**Leadership Competencies**
---------------------------

* **Strategic Thinking:** Connects digital capabilities to broader business priorities and long-term growth opportunities.
* **Execution & Accountability:** Translates strategy into measurable outcomes, clear ownership, and consistent delivery.
* **Customer Focus:** Understands the needs of retailers, partners, and end users and uses those insights to guide decisions.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Evaluates digital investments based on business value, adoption, cost, and return.
* **Cross-Functional Influence:** Builds alignment across business and technical teams without relying solely on direct reporting authority.
* **Pragmatic Problem-Solving:** Balances innovation with business realities, prioritizing solutions that deliver meaningful results.

**Measures of Success**
-----------------------

Success in this role will be evaluated through:

* Delivery against an approved, prioritized digital product roadmap.
* Increased adoption and engagement across LMS, Sorted, and other digital platforms.
* Improved customer and partner experience, measured through feedback and product performance.
* Achievement of agreed commercial and operational KPIs for each platform.
* On-time delivery of key digital initiatives within approved budgets.
* Clear product ownership, prioritization, and accountability across the organization.
* Demonstrated business value and return on digital investments.

Title: Manager - Cybersecurity
Location: Sharjah, Sharjah Emirate, United Arab Emirates
Description:
**Job Purpose**
The Manager of Cyber Security is responsible for leading the enterprise cyber security strategy, operations, and governance across on-premises and cloud environments. This role oversees a dedicated cyber security team responsible for protecting infrastructure (Windows/Linux servers, cloud platforms: Oracle, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes clusters, enterprise networking, and databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, MSSQL, MySQL, CouchDB). The Manager ensures compliance with industry regulations, reduces cyber risks, and implements proactive security measures to safeguard critical business systems and data.
  
  
Key Result Responsibilities
  
  
**Strategic & Governance**

* Develop and implement the organization’s cyber security roadmap aligned with business and regulatory requirements.
* Establish security policies, standards, and procedures across infrastructure, cloud, and application environments.
* Collaborate with the Manager of Cloud & Infrastructure Services or Technology Infrastructure Manager to embed security into system and network architecture.
* Manage security budgets, vendor relationships, and third-party risk assessments.
* Ensure compliance with standards such as ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, HIPAA, or local regulatory requirements.

**Operational Security**

* Oversee Security Operations Centre (SOC) activities, including monitoring, threat detection, and incident response.
* Manage vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and remediation plans.
* Implement and maintain security controls for servers, networks, cloud services, Kubernetes, and databases.
* Lead incident response and forensic investigations, ensuring timely resolution and root cause analysis.
* Ensure strong identity and access management (IAM), privilege escalation control, and zero-trust practices.

Key Result Responsibilities-Continued
  
  
**Risk Management & Assurance**

* Conduct regular risk assessments and security audits across IT infrastructure and applications.
* Manage enterprise endpoint protection, intrusion detection/prevention (IDS/IPS), and SIEM platforms.
* Drive awareness and training programs to promote a strong cyber security culture across the organization.
* Oversee data protection measures, encryption standards, and backup/recovery procedures.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor a dedicated cyber security team including analysts, engineers, and incident responders.
* Define KPIs and success metrics for cyber defence and resilience.
* Provide continuous skill development to stay ahead of evolving threats and technologies.

**People Management**

* Provides direction, coaching and guidance to team members for their career and professional development.
* Creates a conducive working environment to build and sustain a performance driven, engaged, and committed team.
* Ensures people management responsibilities are handled effectively in line with company procedures.

**Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)**

* Bachelor’s degree in cyber security, Information Technology, or related field (master’s preferred).
* CISSP, CISM, CISA, CEH, CCSP, or equivalent industry certifications.
* Cloud security certifications (AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, Oracle Security).
* Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS) is a plus.
* Fluent in English Language
* Strong background securing Windows/Linux servers, cloud (AWS, Azure, Oracle), and enterprise networks.
* Knowledge of enterprise databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MSSQL, MySQL, CouchDB) and their security best practices.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

Work Experience
  
  

* With 8+ years of IT security experience, with at least 3+ years in a managerial role.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes security, container hardening, and cloud-native security tools.
* Proven track record in leading incident response and crisis management.

Title: General Manager – PRO Services, Government Relations & Business Development
Description:

* Knowledge of MOHRE, ICP, GDRFA, Amer, Tasheel and other UAE government departments.

* Maintain professional relationships with government departments and relevant service providers.

* Manage the complete day-to-day operations of the company.
* Supervise and control employees, departments and work performance.
* Establish operational procedures and improve service delivery.
* Monitor staff productivity, attendance and customer service.
* Handle operational issues and ensure smooth business functioning.

**3. Business Development & Revenue Generation**

* Bring new corporate clients and business opportunities.
* Develop relationships with companies, business owners, PRO agencies and corporate clients.
* Generate revenue through PRO services, document clearing, company formation and government transactions.
* Develop new business channels and partnerships.
* Achieve monthly sales and revenue targets.

**4. Financial & Administrative Control**

* Monitor business expenses, operational costs and profitability.
* Prepare monthly business performance reports.
* Monitor quotations, client payments and outstanding balances.
* Ensure effective use of company resources.

Requirements

* Minimum 5–8 years of UAE experience in PRO, Government Relations, Typing Centre or Business Setup.
* Strong practical knowledge of DET and UAE government procedures.
* Proven ability to manage employees and business operations.
* Demonstrated ability to bring corporate clients and generate business.
* Strong leadership, negotiation and communication skills.
* Knowledge of UAE government portals and service procedures.
* Must be target-oriented, responsible and capable of working independently.

Important

We are looking for someone who can **manage the business, control the team and bring business**, not just someone who processes government transactions.

Candidates with an established corporate client network and a proven business development track record will be given preference.

**Interested candidates may apply with their updated CV.**

Pay: AED8,000.00 - AED10,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: IT Technical Programme Manager
Description:
**Location:**
Doha, Qatar (Onsite) |
**Practice Area:**
Technology; Digital Engineering |
**Type:**
Permanent
  
  
**The Role**
At Capco, we are looking for an experienced
**IT Technical Programme Manager**
with strong expertise in smart building technologies and modern workplace infrastructure to lead the technology delivery of a major relocation programme in Doha, Qatar.
  
  
The role requires a combination of technical depth and programme delivery experience, with particular emphasis on smart building systems, IoT, intelligent building controls, Digital Twin technologies and AI-enabled solutions, alongside a strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure and connectivity.
  
  
Working closely with technology teams, facilities, construction partners, specialist vendors and senior stakeholders stakeholders, you will ensure that technical workstreams are delivered in line with programme milestones, enterprise standards and regulatory requirements.
  
  
This is an opportunity to take ownership of a complex, high-profile technology programme, ensuring a seamless transition to a modern, secure and fully operational workplace environment.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* End-to-end technology delivery: You will own the programme from planning and design through infrastructure deployment, testing, migration, go-live and operational handover, ensuring alignment with business objectives and delivery milestones.
* Critical IT infrastructure and connectivity: You will coordinate enterprise networking, telecommunications, structured cabling, IDF/MDF facilities, workplace technologies and infrastructure resilience to deliver a secure, connected and reliable office environment.
* Smart building and digital workplace integration: You will oversee the delivery and integration of intelligent building management and control systems, IoT platforms, connected infrastructure, Digital Twin capabilities and AI-enabled building technologies, ensuring interoperability across building and enterprise IT systems.
* Programme governance: You will manage integrated plans, budgets, vendors, contractors, risks, issues and dependencies while providing clear executive reporting and coordinating technology requirements across construction, facilities and business teams.
* Security, operational readiness and business continuity: You will coordinate and oversee physical security and cybersecurity requirements, testing, commissioning, disaster recovery validation, technical documentation, change control and service transition activities to ensure a secure and smooth relocation with minimal business disruption.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Extensive technical programme delivery experience: At least 7 years of experience managing complex technology programmes, ideally including modern corporate office fit-outs, smart building deployments, workplace transformations or greenfield technology implementations.
* Smart Building, IoT & Emerging Digital Technologies: Recent, demonstrable experience delivering and integrating smart building technologies, including Building Management Systems (BMS), intelligent control systems, IoT platforms and connected infrastructure, with exposure to emerging technologies such as Digital Twins, digital avatars and AI-enabled building solutions.
* Enterprise IT infrastructure expertise: Strong technical understanding of enterprise networking, telecommunications, structured cabling, IDF/MDF environments, data centre dependencies and infrastructure resilience, including integration with modern building systems.
* Security and workplace technology understanding: Experience coordinating physical security and cybersecurity requirements, ccess control, CCTV, end-user computing, meeting room technologies, collaboration platforms and associated operational support services.
* Programme management and governance: Demonstrated experience managing multiple technical workstreams, delivery partners, budgets, risks and dependencies, including coordinating technology delivery with construction and facilities teams, and overseeing business continuity and operational readiness.
* Stakeholder engagement and communication: Ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders, technical specialists, construction teams and external vendors.

**Bonus Points For**

* PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, ITIL or other recognised project and programme management certifications.
* Experience delivering technology programmes within Financial Services, Government or other highly regulated environments.
* Hands-on experience implementing Digital Twin platforms, digital avatars or AI-enabled building management and automation solutions.

**Why Join Capco**

* Deliver high-impact solutions for leading organisations.
* Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture.
* Access continuous learning, training, and industry certifications.
* Work alongside multidisciplinary teams on complex transformation initiatives.
* Help shape the future of business and technology transformation across the region.

**Benefits**
We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package designed to support every aspect of your life.
  
  
**Inclusion at Capco**
We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know – we’ll be happy to help. We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration – a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

Title: Senior Manager - Product Management
Description:
Qiddiya Digital is seeking experienced Senior Manager - Product Management to take end-to-end product ownership of critical digital capabilities across Qiddiya’s ecosystem.

The role will work in close partnership with the Lead Software Engineer assigned to the same domain. Together, they will form the core product and engineering leadership for the domain, ensuring that business objectives, customer needs, technical quality, and operational requirements are considered throughout the product lifecycle.

The Senior Technical Product Manager will be accountable for product roadmap, priorities, requirements, stakeholder alignment, and measurable business outcomes. The role will also oversee vendor product and delivery teams, ensuring that Qiddiya retains ownership of its roadmap, product decisions, requirements, and domain knowledge.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the product roadmap, and priorities for the assigned digital domain.
* Translate business objectives and customer needs into clear product capabilities, requirements, and measurable outcomes.
* Partner closely with the Lead Software Engineer to align product priorities with architecture, technical feasibility, platform health, and engineering capacity.
* Maintain and prioritise the product backlog based on customer value, business impact, risk, dependencies, and technical considerations.
* Define clear business requirements, user journeys, acceptance criteria, success measures, and non-functional expectations.
* Ensure product capabilities are designed for reuse across Qiddiya’s assets, brands, channels, and customer journeys.
* Lead discovery activities, including stakeholder workshops, customer research, journey analysis, process mapping, and solution validation.
* Work closely with Experience Design, Engineering, Architecture, Data, Operations, Cybersecurity, Commercial, and other business teams.
* Coordinate dependencies and integration requirements across internal platforms, external partners, and related product domains.
* Provide product direction and oversight to vendor delivery teams, ensuring delivery remains aligned with Qiddiya’s priorities and standards.
* Ensure that product decisions, requirements, documentation, and platform knowledge are retained within Qiddiya.
* Define product KPIs and use data, customer insights, operational feedback, and platform performance to guide prioritisation.
* Monitor adoption, conversion, customer experience, operational performance, and business outcomes after release.
* Support incident management by assessing customer and business impact, coordinating stakeholder communication, and prioritising remediation.
* Balance the delivery of new capabilities with technical debt, resilience, compliance, operational improvement, and platform sustainability.
* Maintain clear communication on roadmap progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and expected outcomes.

  
**Requirements**  

* 7+ Years of product-management experience within complex digital, technology, or customer-facing environments.
* Proven experience owning digital products from discovery through delivery, launch, operation, and continuous improvement.
* Strong technical understanding of APIs, integrations, digital platforms, data flows, cloud services, and modern software-delivery practices.
* Experience managing products within areas such as commerce, checkout, loyalty, customer accounts, mobile experiences, ticketing, payments, or digital platforms.
* Strong experience defining product strategies, roadmaps, business requirements, user journeys, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.
* Proven ability to work closely with engineering teams and make informed product and technical trade-offs.
* Experience overseeing vendors, system integrators, or outsourced product and delivery teams.
* Strong analytical skills and experience using product, customer, operational, and commercial data to guide decisions.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, cross-domain dependencies, and complex delivery environments.
* Strong communication, facilitation, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to influence teams and stakeholders without relying on direct line-management authority.

Title: Senior Manager, Technology Sourcing
Description:
Requisition ID: 279434
  
  
Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

  

Join Scotiabank at a pivotal time of transformation, where Procurement is driving strategic value and innovation. As the Bank accelerates its adoption of AI and digital capabilities, you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of sourcing within a global organization.

  

**The Role**

  

Shape the future of Technology Sourcing at Scotiabank

  

Scotiabank's Procurement function is at a pivotal moment — driving strategic value, commercial discipline, and innovation as the Bank accelerates its digital and AI transformation. As Senior Manager, Technology Sourcing, you'll lead high-impact sourcing strategies across some of the Bank's most complex and fastest-evolving technology categories.

  

You'll partner with Technology, Risk, Legal, Finance, and senior business leaders to unlock enterprise value across SaaS, cloud & hyperscalers, infrastructure, software, IT labour, networks, and emerging tech. This is a role for a commercially sharp procurement leader who thrives on solving complex problems, influencing spend decisions, and delivering measurable outcomes beyond savings.

  

**Is this role right for you? In this role you will:**

  

* Lead end-to-end sourcing for enterprise technology categories from opportunity assessment and market intelligence through negotiation, contracting, and benefits realization.
* Build category strategies across SaaS, cloud, software licensing, IT professional services, infrastructure, and telecom anchored in spend analysis, supplier capability, and market trends.
* Design and run competitive events (RFI/RFP/RFQ), including evaluation frameworks, shortlisting, negotiation strategy, and award recommendations.
* Negotiate commercially strong agreements balancing TCO, consumption vs. subscription models, service levels, flexibility, exit rights, and long-term business needs.
* Optimize the existing portfolio: identify renewal, consolidation, license rationalization, and vendor rationalization opportunities.
* Partner with Third-Party Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Finance to ensure alignment with policy, regulatory expectations, and the Bank's risk appetite.
* Manage strategic supplier relationships — performance, escalations, executive engagement, and continuous improvement.
* Track and report pipeline, benefits, milestones, and commitments with discipline and transparency.
* Act as a trusted advisor to Technology stakeholders and an escalation point on commercial and supplier matters with enterprise impact.
* Understand how the Bank’s risk appetite, risk culture and risk policies & processes should be considered/adhered to in day-to-day activities and decisions.
* Create an environment in which his/her team pursues effective and efficient operations of his/her respective areas, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day-to-day business controls to meet obligations with respect to operational risk, regulatory compliance risk, AML/ATF risk and conduct risk, including but not limited to responsibilities under the Operational Risk Management Framework, Regulatory Compliance Risk Management Framework, AML/ATF Global Handbook and the Guidelines for Business Conduct.
* Build a high-performance environment and implements a people strategy that attracts, retains, develops and motivates their team by fostering an inclusive work environment and using a coaching mindset and behaviors; communicating vison/values/business strategy; and, managing succession and development planning for the team.

  

**Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related; CPSM, CIPS, or equivalent is preferred.
* 5–10+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, category management, or supplier management — with meaningful exposure to technology categories.
* Deep familiarity with SaaS pricing models, cloud consumption economics, software licensing (perpetual, subscription, token-based), IT labour rate cards, and MSA/SOW constructs.
* Strong commercial acumen and negotiation capability, backed by data-driven recommendations.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders (VP/SVP) and lead cross-functional teams through ambiguity.
* Hands-on with spend analytics, supplier segmentation, TCO modelling, and benchmarking .
* Understanding of third-party risk and regulatory expectations in financial services (or another regulated environment) is an asset.
* Familiarity with e-sourcing, CLM, and supplier management platforms.

  

**What’s in it for you?**

  

* A rewarding career path with diverse opportunities for professional development
* An organization committed to making a difference in our communities – for you and our customers.
* A competitive rewards program includes annual bonus, flexible vacation, personal and sick days, and comprehensive benefits that start on your first day.
* Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employees to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
* Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences every individual brings to the Bank and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.

Title: Senior Delivery & Engagement Manager
Description:
We are looking for Senior Delivery & Engagement Manager in Tampa FL

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Delivery & Engagement Manager to serve as the cornerstone of our client relationships and the owner of delivery excellence. This role is critical to achieving our strategic vision, moving beyond staffing to become a trusted advisor who delivers high-value transformation programs. Title: Senior Program Delivery Manager
Description:
Applause is seeking an experienced delivery leader to oversee a complex portfolio of digital quality services for a strategic enterprise customer. This person will serve as the senior connection point between customer stakeholders and Applause’s delivery organization, ensuring that testing programs are well governed, properly resourced, measurable, and aligned with agreed business outcomes.
  
  
The
**Senior Program Delivery Manager**
will provide unified oversight across testing workstreams, lead a team of Localization Quality Account Managers (LQAMs), and partner with Testing Services, Account Management, Community Operations, Product, and other internal teams. Customer-side decisions—including internal strategy, policy, prioritization, organizational alignment, and program ownership—remain with the customer. * Accurate, decision-ready reporting and reliable executive-review preparation.

**Qualifications**
