Title: Program Management Manager
Description:
**Job Description**
**Program Manager - Operations Manager – Oracle Health Cloud Infrastructure & Disaster Recovery**
**Position Overview**
We are seeking an experienced, highly motivated
**Operations Manager**
to lead a team responsible for cloud infrastructure operations, client disaster recovery environments, operational project delivery, and enterprise healthcare technology solutions.
  
  
This position combines
**people leadership, cloud operations, project management, and client relationship management**
. The successful candidate will oversee a team of operations associates while actively participating in the coordination, provisioning, maintenance, and support of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments, CareAware cloud solutions, and infrastructure supporting Oracle Health applications.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on operational leader who can manage multiple competing priorities, coordinate complex infrastructure projects, communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, and ensure the successful delivery of cloud services to healthcare clients.
  
  
**Candidates with experience supporting Cerner Millennium Electronic Health Record (EHR) environments are strongly preferred.**
Familiarity with Millennium infrastructure, healthcare application dependencies, client upgrades, and the operational requirements of mission-critical healthcare systems will be particularly valuable.
  
  
This role requires someone comfortable balancing managerial responsibilities with operational execution, including cloud resource provisioning, network configuration requests, disaster recovery coordination, infrastructure troubleshooting, and healthcare application support coordination.
  
  
***This role will be based in Nashville TN - we do offer relocation assistance***
**Responsibilities**
**People Management & Team Leadership**

* Provide direct management, coaching, mentoring, and professional development for a team of approximately 8 operations associates.
* Manage day-to-day team operations, including workload distribution, project assignments, support responsibilities, and resource planning.
* Establish, maintain, and coordinate on-call rotations to ensure appropriate coverage for production environments, critical infrastructure, and client support needs.
* Monitor team capacity and priorities to ensure project commitments and operational support obligations are met.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance evaluations, development discussions, and team meetings.
* Provide guidance, training, and mentorship to project managers and operations associates.
* Promote accountability, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement across the team.
* Coordinate escalations, remove operational blockers, and ensure critical issues receive appropriate attention and resolution.

**Disaster Recovery Operations & Client Project Management**

* Lead and coordinate client disaster recovery (DR) infrastructure projects from initial planning through implementation, validation, and ongoing operational support.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders regarding disaster recovery environments, project timelines, infrastructure requirements, and operational readiness.
* Facilitate recurring weekly client meetings to review DR environment health, project progress, outstanding issues, upcoming changes, and operational priorities.
* Provide regular status reports, project updates, risk assessments, and action-item tracking for client disaster recovery environments.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, networking, virtualization, and application teams to ensure disaster recovery environments meet established operational requirements.
* Oversee infrastructure provisioning, configuration requests, maintenance activities, and environment readiness.
* Track project milestones, dependencies, infrastructure issues, and deliverables using Jira and other project management tools.
* Coordinate disaster recovery testing and validation activities with appropriate operations teams and client stakeholders.
* Identify risks and escalate issues that could impact client recovery capabilities, service availability, or project timelines.
* Maintain accurate documentation of DR environments, infrastructure configurations, client requirements, and operational procedures.
* Coordinate disaster recovery planning and operational readiness activities for environments supporting healthcare applications, including Cerner Millennium and related Oracle Health solutions, where applicable.

**Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Administration & Operations**

* Utilize the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Console and associated tools to support provisioning, configuration, and maintenance of cloud infrastructure resources.
* Provision and manage OCI compute instances, including virtual machine creation, configuration, and deployment activities.
* Coordinate and implement network Access Control List (ACL) and Network Security Group (NSG) requests in accordance with established security and change management procedures.
* Support virtual cloud network (VCN) configurations, subnet assignments, and network connectivity requirements.
* Perform basic network troubleshooting within the OCI Console, including reviewing security rules, routing configurations, subnet settings, and connectivity-related issues.
* Collaborate with networking, virtualization, DevOps, and infrastructure operations teams to investigate and resolve cloud infrastructure issues.
* Assist with infrastructure upgrades, migrations, resource changes, and environment maintenance activities.
* Ensure cloud infrastructure changes are appropriately documented, tracked, and communicated to affected stakeholders.
* Support operational best practices for infrastructure reliability, security, availability, and disaster recovery readiness.

**Oracle Health & Cerner Millennium EHR Operations**

* Support the coordination and operational management of infrastructure and cloud environments associated with Oracle Health applications, including Cerner Millennium EHR and CareAware solutions.
* Work with Oracle Health application teams, infrastructure operations, networking, and client stakeholders to coordinate environment provisioning, upgrades, migrations, and operational support activities.
* Apply knowledge of Cerner Millennium environments and healthcare application dependencies to identify potential infrastructure risks and coordinate appropriate resolution.
* Assist in planning and coordinating infrastructure changes that may affect Millennium-connected applications, integrations, or supporting healthcare services.
* Collaborate with application owners and operations teams to support availability, reliability, and continuity of mission-critical healthcare systems.
* Coordinate client communications, project timelines, and operational readiness activities for infrastructure initiatives involving Millennium and related Oracle Health solutions.
* Demonstrate an understanding of the importance of minimizing service disruptions in healthcare environments and maintaining appropriate operational controls during infrastructure changes.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to investigate infrastructure-related issues affecting healthcare applications and coordinate escalations through resolution.

**Operational Project & Service Delivery Management**

* Oversee multiple concurrent operational initiatives involving cloud infrastructure, application migrations, client upgrades, disaster recovery, and service improvements.
* Assign and prioritize project work and support Jira tickets based on business needs, operational complexity, resource availability, and client commitments.
* Coordinate across product engineering, networking, virtualization, DevOps, consulting, and client-facing teams to ensure successful project execution.
* Lead infrastructure modernization and migration initiatives, including operating system upgrades and legacy server replacement.
* Work with client stakeholders to establish migration timelines, resolve dependencies, and encourage timely adoption of supported infrastructure platforms.
* Identify opportunities to reduce infrastructure costs, third-party licensing expenses, operational overhead, and infrastructure-related risks.
* Maintain project schedules, action items, risks, dependencies, and status communications.
* Support both planned project activities and unplanned operational escalations while maintaining clear priorities and accountability.
* Coordinate infrastructure and application modernization efforts within healthcare environments while considering operational dependencies and client service continuity.

**Process Improvement, Jira Management & Documentation**

* Develop, maintain, and improve Jira workflows, issue templates, project templates, and operational tracking processes.
* Create standardized project and support request templates to improve consistency, visibility, and execution efficiency.
* Establish repeatable procedures for client onboarding, cloud provisioning, infrastructure requests, disaster recovery support, and project delivery.
* Improve coordination between account managers, project managers, operations associates, and engineering teams.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive administrative or operational tasks.
* Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation, operational runbooks, escalation procedures, and project records.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase team productivity, reduce manual effort, and improve client service delivery.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience in IT operations, infrastructure management, cloud services, service delivery, or a related operational leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience leading, supervising, or mentoring operations professionals.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent infrastructure and operational initiatives.
* Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure concepts, including virtual machines, compute resources, networking, and infrastructure provisioning.
* Experience working with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) or a comparable enterprise cloud platform.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals, including IP addressing, subnets, routing, ACLs, security groups, and basic connectivity troubleshooting.
* Experience coordinating client-facing operational projects and communicating with diverse stakeholders.

Title: Project Manager
Description:
**About Cat5 Resources LLC**

**Cat5 Resources is a certified Woman-Owned Business providing technical and operational services to critical infrastructure across the Southern US, Puerto Rico, and the US Virgin Islands.**

We are committed to powering and protecting the infrastructure that keeps businesses and communities running—whether during daily operations or times of disaster.

**Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Fueling for Data Center**
================================================================================

**Cat5 Resources**

**Position summary**
--------------------

The Project Manager leads Cat5’s preventive maintenance and fueling program for a national wireless infrastructure client, with a fleet made up mostly of portable generators. The role coordinates scheduled maintenance, routine and emergency fuel deliveries, portable unit deployment and recovery, field personnel and vendors, safety, client communications, and complete service and fuel-delivery documentation.

**Department**

Operations – Generator Services

  

**Reports to**

Director of Operations

  

**Location**

Mostly on-site in North Texas, with travel to vendor shops and field sites

  

**Type**

Full-time, exempt

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Program and client management**

* Serve as the client’s main point of contact; run regular status meetings and escalations.

* Build and manage the program plan, budget, staffing and subcontractor mix (in-house vs. third party).

* Get all subcontractors through the client’s qualification process before they access any site.

* Track and report performance against contract SLAs: preventive maintenance completion, on-time fueling, emergency response, fuel-delivery accuracy and work-order closeout.

* Protect client confidential information.

* Turn around client quote requests and purchase orders quickly, within contract response times.

* Track every scheduled maintenance visit and fueling commitment; flag at-risk work orders early and communicate revised completion dates.

**Preventive maintenance and fueling operations**

* Oversee scheduled preventive maintenance inspections and servicing of portable generators and, where applicable, installed generators and automatic transfer switches (ATS).

* Review maintenance findings, identify deficiencies and coordinate escalation of repair needs to the appropriate repair team for client approval.

* Plan recurring generator fueling, fuel-level checks and emergency refueling based on client requirements, site access and generator operating needs.

* Coordinate routine portable generator checks, operational testing and follow-up on deficiencies identified during preventive maintenance, including ATS checks where applicable.

* Enforce quality standards through maintenance checklists, fuel-delivery tickets, meter readings, photographs and complete site-level work-order records.

* Investigate missed services, fueling discrepancies, fuel shortages and repeat service issues; document corrective actions.

* Ensure preventive maintenance and fueling activities follow applicable safety, spill-prevention, environmental and fuel-handling requirements.

* Ensure technicians record generator condition, alarms, fluid levels, battery checks, fuel levels and test results during service visits.

* Obtain required client approvals for nonroutine fueling, emergency deliveries and out-of-scope maintenance before proceeding.

* Maintain complete preventive maintenance and fueling history for each serviced asset and site.

* Track portable generator inventory, location, deployment, transport and return, recording unit ID, run hours and condition at each move.

* Coordinate qualified maintenance subcontractors, fuel suppliers and delivery partners when work cannot be self-performed.

* Escalate generator faults, fuel-system concerns, suspected leaks and repair needs with supporting site documentation.

**Fuel, parts and materials management**

* Maintain availability of preventive maintenance supplies, filters, fluids and approved fueling resources.

* Forecast maintenance supplies and fuel-delivery demand based on schedules, site consumption and seasonal or emergency needs.

* Publish reports on fuel deliveries, consumption, maintenance supplies, missed visits and service delays.

* Coordinate approved fuel suppliers and maintenance-material vendors, including delivery coverage and service expectations.

* Record maintenance materials, delivered fuel quantities, delivery confirmations and associated costs in designated systems.

* Use maintenance schedules, historical fuel usage and generator run time to plan service materials and fueling requirements.

* Review fuel-supply capacity, delivery lead times and critical maintenance materials with the client.

* Support client audits of maintenance records, fuel tickets, invoices and vendor compliance.

**Field operations and technician coordination**

* Assign preventive maintenance routes, fueling dispatches and portable generator deployments based on geography, site priority and personnel qualifications.

* Monitor technician and fuel-vendor productivity, service quality, safety compliance and work-order completion.

* Coordinate follow-up maintenance visits, missed fuel deliveries and client communication for incomplete work.

**Scheduling, dispatch and work-order management**

* Manage multi-site preventive maintenance schedules, fueling routes, dispatch priorities and travel logistics.

* Complete scheduled preventive maintenance and fuel deliveries within contractual service windows.

* Escalate missed appointments, access issues, low-fuel conditions and delivery delays; keep the client informed.

* Track maintenance and fueling work orders, assigned personnel, delivery dates, gallons delivered and outstanding actions.

* Close out each work order with service details, fuel quantities, delivery tickets, photographs and client-required documentation.

* Investigate recurring service exceptions, fuel discrepancies, incomplete deliveries and quality concerns.

* Ensure proper handling of fuels and service waste, including spill response and reporting under applicable procedures.

**Site services**

* Plan preventive maintenance visits, routine fueling, emergency refueling and portable generator deployment at tower and other remote sites with client operations teams.

* Make sure field technicians hold the required electrical and mechanical certifications and follow site safety rules.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of project or program management in field services, maintenance, fuel logistics or telecom infrastructure.

* 3+ years working with portable and standby diesel or natural gas generators; automatic transfer switch (ATS) experience is a plus.

* Working knowledge of Generac, Kohler and other portable generator platforms and their controllers.

* Experience managing generator preventive maintenance and fueling programs with field documentation and quality controls.

* Experience with fuel logistics, delivery verification, vendor coordination and maintenance-material planning.

* Experience managing subcontractors and vendors, including qualification, scheduling and performance.

* Comfortable working from contract terms: POs, work orders, SLAs, fueling requirements and service scopes.

* Strong Excel skills and experience with field service, maintenance management or work-order systems.

* Clear written reporting to an enterprise client on a daily, weekly and monthly cadence.

* Able to work independently and remotely, and to manage on-site work from a distance.

* Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* EGSA Generator Technician certification, or prior hands-on generator technician experience.

* Experience with tower or cell-site backup power programs for a national carrier or tower company.

* Experience with generator fueling, emergency fuel delivery, fuel monitoring and remote field service.

* Knowledge of applicable environmental and safety requirements for fuel, fluids, batteries and field maintenance.

* Familiarity with OSHA 10/30 and site-access qualification for subcontractors.

* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Working conditions**
----------------------

* Based primarily at our Power Solutions location in North Texas, with coordination of remote field operations.

* Travel to fuel vendors, maintenance partners and field sites, up to 40% of the time.

* Availability outside normal hours for emergency fueling, portable generator deployment, generator outages and storm response.

* Field visits involve tower-site conditions, heat, noise, outdoor weather and required PPE.

* Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs and walk uneven ground at sites.

**Success measures**
--------------------

* On-time preventive maintenance completion, fueling delivery and work-order closeout.

* Fueling dispatch, emergency delivery and maintenance response within contract requirements.

* Every maintenance visit and fuel delivery documented with required readings, quantities and asset identification.

* Daily, weekly and monthly client reports delivered complete and on time.

* Improved generator readiness, fewer low-fuel incidents and timely resolution of maintenance deficiencies.

* Accurate fuel reconciliation, strong safety performance and zero unauthorized work.

* Invoices submitted promptly after work is accepted.

**Equal opportunity**
---------------------

Cat5 Resources is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected status. Employment may be contingent on a background check and drug screen.

Title: Director, Technology, Campana Systems
Description:
**We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this** **link** **directly.**

Campana Systems, a Gemini Group company within Aquila, develops specialized software solutions for AAA and CAA auto clubs across North America. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Waterloo, Ontario, Campana has built long-standing relationships with organizations that rely on its technology to manage their operations and deliver services to their members.

Our AXIS platform brings together membership management, customer relationship management, emergency roadside assistance, travel services, and business intelligence in an integrated suite of solutions. Looking ahead, we are focused on evolving our technology, strengthening our platform capabilities, and finding new ways to help our customers work more efficiently and deliver better member experiences.

**Who we need**

Reporting to the General Manager, we are hiring a Director, Technology to lead the evolution of Campana Systems’ technology strategy, architecture, infrastructure, and AXIS platform. In this newly created role, you will own the technology roadmap from strategy through execution, with accountability for modernization priorities, investment decisions, platform reliability, and measurable business outcomes. You will lead the Architecture and Infrastructure & Security teams, partner with the Director, Development, and establish the technical direction and capabilities needed to deliver on our product vision while supporting the customers who depend on our technology.

*This is a fully remote role open to candidates across Canada, with working hours of 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Eastern Time.*

**What’s in it for you**

*Shape a meaningful transformation.* You will have the autonomy to challenge established approaches, make consequential technology decisions, and guide the evolution of a business-critical software platform. You will see the impact of your work in stronger platform capabilities, improved delivery, and better customer experiences.

*Build what comes next.* You will lead experienced teams while shaping the standards, capabilities, and ways of working needed for the future. From strengthening engineering practices to developing technical leaders, you will have the opportunity to build a more effective technology organization and see the results of your leadership.

*Grow your executive influence.* You will work directly with the General Manager and contribute to decisions that connect technology investments with customer needs and business growth. Backed by Aquila and the broader Constellation Software network, you will have opportunities to expand your leadership experience and pursue broader responsibilities over time.

**As our new Director, Technology, you will**

* **Own the technology roadmap.** You will turn the product vision into a multi-year strategy with clear priorities, investments, milestones, and measurable outcomes. You will balance modernization, technical debt, customer commitments, and platform stability, taking accountability for delivery and results. You will establish architectural standards, technology governance, and engineering priorities. Partnering with the Director, Development, you will strengthen technical decision-making, CI/CD, automation, and delivery practices across Canadian and offshore teams.
* **Lead platform modernization.** You will define a phased approach to evolving AXIS, including its legacy Rocket UniVerse architecture. You will determine what to retain, integrate, replace, or modernize, guiding decisions on APIs, application architecture, CRM, data capabilities, and cloud or hybrid environments while protecting the reliability customers depend on.
* **Turn innovation into impact.** You will identify opportunities to improve CRM capabilities, business intelligence, reporting, and operational efficiency through AI, automation, and better use of data. You will evaluate feasibility and business value, establish priorities, and work with technical teams to turn promising initiatives into measurable results.
* **Strengthen security and reliability.** You will oversee infrastructure, hosting, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, and platform resilience. You will reduce technology risk, strengthen operational controls, and advance security and compliance readiness, including SOC 2-related requirements.
* **Build and grow technical capabilities.** You will lead the Architecture and Infrastructure & Security teams, develop talent, strengthen accountability, and identify capability gaps. You will improve collaboration with Development and Product to ensure teams have the direction and support needed to execute the roadmap.
* **Connect technology to business priorities.** You will partner with the General Manager on technology investments, budgets, resources, and strategic decisions. You will communicate risks and trade-offs, measure progress, and contribute technical leadership to customer conversations when needed.

**You bring**

* **The senior technology leadership.** You have led technology strategy, architecture, and technical teams within an enterprise software business, with accountability for investment decisions, organizational performance, and business outcomes. You bring the judgment to set direction, establish priorities, and deliver results through technical leaders and cross-functional teams.
* **The platform modernization expertise.** You have led the evolution of complex, business-critical software, navigating legacy architecture, technical debt, and customer dependencies. You know how to assess what to retain, replace, or integrate, develop a phased modernization roadmap, and introduce new capabilities without compromising reliability.
* **The technical depth.** You bring strong expertise in enterprise architecture, APIs, integrations, data platforms, and cloud or hybrid environments, along with an understanding of infrastructure, cybersecurity, and disaster recovery. You can establish technical standards, evaluate emerging technologies, and guide decisions that strengthen platform performance, security, and scalability.
* **The experience driving innovation.** You have improved engineering practices and delivery performance across distributed teams, including those outside your direct reporting structure. You understand CI/CD, automation, and modern development practices, and can identify practical opportunities for AI, analytics, and business intelligence that deliver measurable value.
* **The business acumen.** You connect technology decisions to customer needs, financial priorities, and long-term business growth. You can evaluate investments, communicate complex trade-offs, and align senior leaders while staying close enough to the technology to challenge assumptions and guide execution.
* **The influence.** You develop strong technical leaders, establish accountability, and build cross-functional, cross-location collaboration. You are comfortable making difficult decisions, navigating competing priorities, and owning outcomes in an environment where you have the autonomy to shape what comes next.

**Why join?**

Axis Campana and Aquila are part of Constellation Software Inc., one of Canada's largest and most successful software companies and its most successful technology stock over the last 10 years [TSE: CSU].

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. This is a place where high performance and hard work are rewarded, where leaders are grown, and where the best ideas win. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

We spend our days asking questions and challenging the status quo, manipulating our structure, roles, and internal operations in order to stay ahead in a competitive landscape.

If you share our growth mindset, relationship-focused approach, and high moral fibre, you will thrive at Aquila.

**Compensation**

At Campana and Aquila, we believe compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of both experience and impact. The salary range for this role is CAD $150,000 to $200,000 plus bonus.

Compensation is determined based on skills, experience, and the scope and complexity of the role. We value open conversations about compensation and are happy to discuss our approach at any stage of the hiring process.

**Apply now.**

Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have most of the qualifications we are seeking, and want to play an integral role in our success, apply to express your interest.

* A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining the company and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
* An interview with the General Manager to discuss your technology leadership experience, approach to platform modernization, architectural decision-making, and ability to connect technology strategy to business outcomes.

We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. As a Technical Operations Center (TOC) Manager, you will be one of three global managers operating in a "Follow the Sun" model, ensuring continuous 24/7 coverage and operational excellence across our technical infrastructure. This role is accountable for more than ticket throughput. It turns operational signals into measurable reliability outcomes by strengthening service ownership, leading disciplined incident response, reducing repeat failure and toil, and moving the organization toward proactive, increasingly automated operations. Your leadership will be crucial in facilitating seamless handoffs between shifts, maintaining high performance, and upholding and improving they systems and processes that create operational drag.
  
  
**Job Functions**
Service Reliability & Operational Leadership
  
  

* Lead day-to-day operations for the Technical Operations Center, ensuring critical infrastructure and services are operated safely, reliably and consistently.
* Establish and maintain a service-centric operating rhythm covering service ownership, criticality, dependencies, SLOs/SLIs, incident trends, capacity, risk and operational readiness.
* Partner with service owners, engineering, cybersecurity, business technology teams and vendors to identify reliability risks before they become business-impacting incidents.
* Use observability, telemetry and service health data to improve detection, prioritization and decision-making.
* Maintain a regular operating review and publish a concise scorecard focused on outcomes rather than activity.

Major Incident Management & Swarming
  
  

* Lead or sponsor response to major incidents, acting as Incident Commander or ensuring the appropriate command structure is in place.
* Establish clear incident roles, escalation triggers, communication standards and decision rights for high-severity events.

Title: Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Repairs
Description:
**About Cat5 Resources LLC**

Cat5 Resources is a diversified supplier of technical and operational services across the Southern US, Puerto Rico, and the US Virgin Islands.

In 2004, when Hurricane Charley devastated Florida, our CEO, Cindy Perez, received an out-of-the-blue call from a long-term telecom client in urgent need of help. Their other vendors could not deliver, so they turned to Cindy for assistance. She responded without hesitation, mobilizing a fleet of generators and emergency fuel to ensure the client’s critical infrastructure remained operational throughout the event.

In 2013, Cindy founded Cat5 Resources with a mission to provide reliable and innovative solutions for critical infrastructure resiliency. Since then, the Cat5 Resources team has consistently delivered exceptional customer service to clients nationwide. Over the years, Cat5 Resources has expanded its offerings to include Disaster Recovery Services, Operations and Maintenance, Civil, Electrical, and Construction, as well as Transportation and Logistics.

As a certified Woman-Owned Business, Cat5 Resources serves the entire Southern United States. In 2016, we extended our services into Puerto Rico with the launch of Cat5 Caribbean, focusing on critical infrastructure support in disaster-prone regions. Further expanding our capabilities, in 2024, we introduced Cat5 Power Solutions, our Portable Power Sales and Rentals Division, delivering versatile power solutions to businesses and communities across the Southern US.

**Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Repairs**
================================================================

**Cat5 Resources**

**Position summary**
--------------------

The Project Manager runs Cat5’s nationwide generator preventive maintenance and repair program for a national wireless infrastructure client with thousands of backup power units in service across the U.S. The role owns the full asset lifecycle: receiving decommissioned generators and ATS units, deciding repair vs. dispose, overseeing refurbishment and testing, managing stored inventory, and fulfilling orders to sites on time.

**Department**

Operations – Generator Services

**Reports to**

Director of Operations

**Location**

Remote with travel to field sites or client location if needed

**Type**

Full-time, exempt

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Program and client management**

* Serve as the client’s main point of contact; run regular status meetings and escalations.
* Build and manage the program plan, budget, staffing and subcontractor mix (in-house vs. third party).
* Get all subcontractors through the client’s qualification process before they access any site.
* Maintain and update Cat5’s hours and company information in Avetta so qualification and compliance status stay current.
* Track and report performance against contract SLAs: preventive maintenance completion, repair response times, first-time fix rates, equipment uptime and work-order closeout.
* Protect client confidential information.
* Turn around client quote requests and purchase orders quickly, within contract response times.
* Track every scheduled service and repair commitment; flag at-risk work orders early and communicate revised completion dates.

**Preventive maintenance and corrective repairs**

* Oversee preventive maintenance inspections and service of installed diesel and natural gas generators and ATS units.
* Review inspection findings, diagnose reported failures, and provide written repair recommendations and estimates for client approval.
* Schedule and oversee corrective repairs to controllers, alternators, starting systems, fuel systems, cooling systems, breakers, batteries, fuel tanks and enclosures.
* Coordinate ATS inspections, testing, troubleshooting and repairs, including contactors, controls, relays and communication components.
* Enforce QA through service checklists, operational testing, inspection reports, photographs and complete asset-level work-order records.
* Manage repair warranties, repeat-failure investigations and complete service documentation.
* Ensure maintenance and repairs comply with applicable safety, environmental and waste-handling requirements, including oils, coolant, batteries and fuel.
* Ensure technicians document generator operating conditions, alarms, fluid levels, battery condition and test results during site visits.
* Submit repair quotes for client approval and do not perform work requiring authorization before written approval is received.
* Maintain complete preventive maintenance and repair history for each client-owned asset.
* Coordinate qualified subcontractors and specialty repair vendors when work cannot be self-performed.
* Escalate generators requiring major repair or replacement recommendations with supporting diagnostics and cost estimates.

**Parts and materials management**

* Maintain availability of service parts, filters, fluids, batteries and critical repair components.
* Monitor critical parts stock and forecast material requirements based on scheduled maintenance and repair trends.
* Publish reports on parts usage, open repairs, backorders and material-related service delays.
* Source OEM-approved or client-authorized replacement parts through approved vendors.
* Record parts consumption and purchasing in designated systems and provide required client reporting.
* Use maintenance schedules and historical consumption to plan recurring service materials.
* Review critical spare-parts levels and lead times with the client.
* Support client audits of maintenance records, work orders and subcontractor compliance.

**Field operations and technician coordination**

* Assign preventive maintenance routes and repair dispatches based on technician qualifications, geography and priority.
* Monitor technician productivity, service quality, safety compliance and work-order completion.
* Coordinate follow-up visits, parts availability and client communication for incomplete repairs.

**Scheduling, dispatch and work-order management**

* Manage multi-site maintenance schedules, dispatch priorities and travel logistics across assigned territories.
* Complete scheduled preventive maintenance and corrective repairs within contractual service windows.
* Escalate missed appointments, access issues, outages and repair delays; keep the client informed.
* Track work-order status, technician assignments, service dates and outstanding actions.
* Close out each work order with labor, parts, test results, photographs and client-required documentation.
* Investigate repeat service calls, incomplete repairs and workmanship concerns.
* Ensure proper handling and disposal of used oil, filters, coolant, batteries and other service waste.

**Site services**

* Plan preventive maintenance visits, troubleshooting, load testing and repairs at tower and other remote sites with client operations teams.
* Make sure field technicians hold the required electrical and mechanical certifications and follow site safety rules.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of project or program management in field services, equipment repair, logistics or telecom infrastructure.
* 3+ years working with diesel or natural gas standby generators and automatic transfer switches (ATS).
* Working knowledge of Generac and Kohler generator platforms and their controllers.
* Experience managing field preventive maintenance and generator repair programs with testing and QA documentation.
* Parts and materials management experience: serialized asset tracking, cycle counts, stock levels and demand planning.
* Experience managing subcontractors and vendors, including qualification, scheduling and performance.
* Comfortable working from contract terms: POs, work orders, SLAs, service scopes and warranties.
* Strong Excel skills and experience with field service, maintenance management or work-order systems.
* Clear written reporting to an enterprise client on a daily, weekly and monthly cadence.
* Able to work independently and remotely, and to manage on-site work from a distance.
* Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* EGSA Generator Technician certification, or prior hands-on generator technician experience.
* Experience with tower or cell-site backup power programs for a national carrier or tower company.
* Experience with preventive maintenance programs, generator diagnostics, emergency repairs and remote field service.
* Knowledge of applicable environmental and safety requirements for fuel, fluids, batteries and field maintenance.
* Familiarity with OSHA 10/30 and site-access qualification for subcontractors.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Working conditions**
----------------------

* Based primarily at our Power Solutions location in Jasper, TX, with coordination of remote field operations.
* Travel to repair vendors and field sites, up to 40% of the time.
* Availability outside normal hours for generator outages, emergency repairs and storm response.
* Field visits involve tower-site conditions, heat, noise, outdoor weather and required PPE.
* Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs and walk uneven ground at sites.

**Success measures**
--------------------

* On-time preventive maintenance completion and work-order closeout.
* Repair quote, dispatch and service response within contract requirements.
* Every service visit documented with required inspections, test results and asset identification.
* Daily, weekly and monthly client reports delivered complete and on time.
* Improved generator uptime, reduced repeat failures and timely resolution of deficiencies.
* Low repeat-repair rates, strong safety performance and zero unauthorized work.
* Invoices submitted promptly after work is accepted.

**Equal opportunity**
---------------------

Cat5 Resources is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected status. Employment may be contingent on a background check and drug screen.

Title: Project Manager- Generator Refurbishment

* Fulfill orders for refurbished and replacement units and parts to designated sites within agreed lead times.
* Run the escalation process for delays and keep the client informed.
* Track title and risk-of-loss transfer points on every shipment.
* Close out each order in our system with tracking and serial numbers sent to the client.
* Process dead-on-arrival returns and freight damage claims with proper documentation.
* Handle hazardous materials and disposal correctly, with disposal reporting to the client.

**Site services**

* Plan generator removal and replacement at tower sites with the client’s operations and construction teams.
* Make sure field technicians hold the required electrical and mechanical certifications and follow site safety rules.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of project or program management in field services, equipment repair, logistics or telecom infrastructure.
* 3+ years working with diesel or natural gas standby generators and automatic transfer switches (ATS).
* Working knowledge of Generac and Kohler generator platforms and their controllers.
* Experience managing a repair, refurbishment or reverse-logistics operation with testing and QA documentation.
* Inventory management experience: serialized asset tracking, cycle counts, stock levels and demand planning.
* Experience managing subcontractors and vendors, including qualification, scheduling and performance.
* Comfortable working from contract terms: POs, work orders, SLAs, warranties, title and risk of loss.
* Strong Excel skills and experience with an inventory, ERP or work order system.
* Clear written reporting to an enterprise client on a daily, weekly and monthly cadence.
* Able to work independently and remotely, and to manage on-site work from a distance.
* Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* EGSA Generator Technician certification, or prior hands-on generator technician experience.
* Experience with tower or cell-site backup power programs for a national carrier or tower company.
* Background in aftermarket parts, remanufacturing or consignment and resale programs.
* Knowledge of EPA and DOT rules for fluids, batteries, hazardous materials and freight.

Title: Regional Director
Description:
****ABOUT US****
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
BGIS is a leading provider of customized facility management and real estate services. With a combined team of over 10,000 professionals worldwide, we relentlessly focus on enabling innovation through the services we deliver. We actively seek new opportunities that drive innovation for our clients’ businesses. Globally, we manager over 320 million square feet of client portfolios across 30,000+ locations in North America, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia. For further information, visit www.bgis.com .

**Regional Director**

**Account Management**

**Client Relationship Management**

* Position level of client representatives with whom this position typically interacts with include those at the senior management level
* Acts as the focal point of escalation for issues pertaining to facilities within assigned region(s)

**Region/Portfolio Budget Development & Management**
  
  

* Assume financial responsibility for facility operations, including budget management.
* In partnership with finance, responsible for the development of budgets (O&M, Transaction, capital projects and rent), and be able to support and explain approach to the client and the account team.
* Using financial reports, perform monthly budget, analyze and re-forecast allocations as necessary.
* Meet annual targets as per contractual performance and client financial targets / indicators.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities and develop strategies to maximize financial resources.
* Track and report on budget positive or negative trends performance regularly
* Participates in, provides recommendations, and contributes to continuous improvement projects to achieve efficiency gains and cost savings

**Portfolio Management**
  
  

* Accountable for operations management for the portfolio of facilities within the assigned region(s)
* Leads the operations and maintenance activities of a portfolio of facilities along with the execution of the portfolio’s programs
* Oversees the completion and submission of capital plans
* Creates and implements short to mid-term plans for the assigned region(s)
* Provides input into strategic plans
* Collaborates with relevant stakeholders to optimize facilities within assigned region(s) and continuously create value for the client.

**Service Delivery Management**

* Monitor work order progress and ensure tasks are completed within established timelines.
* Work with Account Governance Teams to maintain accurate records of work orders and associated costs.
* Streamline and manage work order processes to optimize efficiency.
* Prioritize and assign work orders based on urgency and impact on facility operations.
* Accountable for meeting all service obligations for the assigned region(s)
* Oversees the delivery of all service obligations
* Accountable for meeting established metrics/key performance indicators.  Leads the operations team in the development and implementation of action plans to remediate gaps, where applicable, to ensure objectives are met.
* Accountable for ensuring compliance to all legislated, corporate and industry-related requirements and guidelines including but not limited to environmental, health and safety, and building standard requirements

**Risk Management, Emergency Preparedness and Business Continuity Planning and Execution**
  
  

* Accountable for safeguarding the client against emergencies and risks by ensuring emergency preparedness, risk management, disaster recovery and business continuity plans are developed and that relevant stakeholders are trained to ensure proper execution
* Oversight and engagement in Emergency Management

**Regulatory Compliance**
  
  

* Accountable for ensuring all regulatory compliance requirements have been met and all related documentation are created and maintained
* Ensure compliance with corporate and legislated policies, procedures, practices and guidelines related to environmental, building code and issues by applying cursory knowledge of legislation related to these areas

**Project Management**
  
  

* Accountable for on-time, on-budget and quality delivery of facility management projects for the assigned region(s)
* Collaborates with clients and internal stakeholders to identify project opportunities and priorities, develop and implement projects
* Oversees the development and execution of project plans for portfolios within assigned region(s)

**Procurement**
  
  

* With Support from BGIS Strategic Sourcing and Vendor Management Leadership – follow BGIS Vendor Performance and Relationship Management Program protocols
* Collaborates with Procurement and Supply Chain Administration teams to source and qualify vendors, source and procure goods and services.

**Continuous Improvement**
  
  

* Collaborates with stakeholders and contributes to efficiency gains   through activities including but not limited to identifying and implementing best practices; reviewing, refining and/or developing, implementing processes, technologies and sustainable practices, and leveraging self-perform wherever possible.  Implements related enhancements for the assigned region(s)

**Leadership and Recognition**
  
  

* Accountable for employee-oriented activities including but not limited to employee engagement, development and performance management, hiring and retention, compensation recommendations
* Employee Satisfaction Scores and employee recognition (development and implementation of action plans to improve ESAT scores)
* Day to day support and team oversight/management

**Collaboration with BGIS Self Perform Teams delivering Best Quality Services to Buildings**
  
  

* Work in collaboration with BGIS teams in Janitorial, Project Management and TechnicalServices or any other areas where work is directly performed by BGIS to maximize efficiency and the best customer service in the buildings / portfolios
* Work together with these teams to ensure work is completed

**Technology to Support your Success.**
  
  

* Leverage technology such as work order system, vendor monitoring tools, BAS and CMMS scheduling tools to deliver effective service to clients.
* Mentor staff in vendor management and the effective use of technology for vendor relationships.
* Provide guidance to team members on the effective use of technology for financial management and career progression.
* Other duties as assigned

****KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS****

* Community college diploma preferably in business administration
* More than 10 years of facility management work experience
* Highly skilled at account management
* Highly skilled at facility operations management
* Highly skilled at client relationship management with demonstrated ability in building and managing relationships with client representatives at the senior management level
* Highly skilled at managing service delivery and meeting service delivery obligations
* Skilled at managing budgets
* Fully developed communication, influence, persuasion and negotiation skills
* High degree of client service orientation and sense of urgency
* Highly skilled at leading and engaging a team of individuals
* Skilled at vendor management
* Highly skilled at emergency management, emergency preparedness and business continuity planning and execution
* Possesses a sustainability mindset and seeks to incorporate sustainable practices within assigned portfolio where possible
* Expert level knowledge of health and safety requirements. Possesses a high degree of safety mindset
* Maintains current knowledge of and highly skilled at implementing facility management services best practices
* Expert level knowledge of current building standards and requirements
* Possesses a continuous improvement and quality mindset along with a desire to continuously seek and incorporate innovative practices and technologies in order to deliver value to the client

**Licenses and/or Professional Accreditation**
One or more of the following would be considered an asset:
  
  

* Certified Facility Manager from International Facility Management Association
* Certified Property Manager from Institute of Real Estate Management
* Facility Management Administrator Designation from Building Owners and Managers Institute
* Real Property Administrator Designation from Building Owners and Managers Institute

Title: Senior Manager, Specialty Operations (Remote)
Description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Senior Manager of Specialty Operations to support the operational execution of our new specialty product launch. This role will be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day execution of specialty distribution, specialty pharmacy, and patient support operations for a rare disease product, with an initial focus on the successful commercialization of the new product launch. The role will also collaborate closely with Account Managers, Field Reimbursement Managers, and other internal stakeholders to resolve complex issues, improve processes, and ensure a seamless patient and provider experience.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Specialty Distribution Partner Management:**

* Support day-to-day operational execution across specialty pharmacy and specialty distribution services, ensuring coordination with internal teams and timely escalation of operational barriers.Partner with vendor program managers across specialty pharmacy and specialty distribution services to support operational activities, monitor open issues, and facilitate timely issue resolution and follow-up actions.

* Monitor and maintain operational performance standards with specialty distribution partners, ensuring alignment with agreed-upon service levels, KPIs, and regulatory requirements.

* Coordinate resolution of operational barriers involving prescription processing, medical benefit reimbursement, buy-and-bill, institutional procurement, billing and claims, and alignment of product delivery with treatment scheduling, engaging appropriate functional experts as needed. Create and manage various channel/SD/SP communications and documents

* Work closely with the Channel Operations team to monitor/maintain optimal inventory levels.

* Support the maintenance, implementation, and periodic review of established business rules and operational procedures with specialty distribution partners.

* Contribute to development of product and channel specific contract strategies

  
  

**Collaboration with Internal Stakeholders:**

* Coordinate operational activities across the vendor program manager, Access Strategy, Patient Services, Trade & Distribution, Data & Analytics, and field leadership.

* Maintain documented responsibilities and handoffs, and route strategic, policy, and customer-facing decisions to the accountable function. Work cross-functionally with Market Access on product access issues and Medical team on resource development and pull-through.

* Develop relationships and work closely with the Patient Services team and/or Field Reimbursement Managers to help resolve patient/ provider access issues.

* Provide regular updates regarding partner performance, patient access issues, and any operational challenges, continuously evolving/challenging our support model with learnings related to medical/pharmacy benefit coverage learnings

* Collaborate with the team to continuously improve patient services and operational processes, including reviewing and optimizing workflows to enhance the overall customer experience.

  
  

**Issue Investigation & Resolution:**

* Take ownership of investigating operational issues and work with internal and external teams to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.

* Address challenges related to patient enrollment, medication distribution, insurance verification, or other issues impacting pharmacy operations.

* Escalate critical issues as needed and ensure effective communication with all relevant parties to resolve problems quickly and efficiently.

  
  

**Reporting & Data Analysis:**

* Identify appropriate metrics and tracking to ensure the right execution and success; analyze procedure volume, trends and growth for the specialty channel.

* Compile operational metrics, document performance trends, and provide reporting support for management reviews and business update meetings. Provide regular reports on operational performance, issue resolution, and process improvements to the Director of Specialty Operations.

* Analyze specialty reporting and work with data and analytics team to create patient, provider, physician, pharmacy and payer data dashboards in order to help improve processes

* Monitor specialty distributor/pharmacy data (ie; Time to First Fill, Conversion Rate, Gap days and Adherence)

  
  

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Participate in regular process improvement initiatives aimed at optimizing specialty distribution network operations and enhancing the patient experience.

* Provide input into the development and refinement of training materials, operational procedures, and best practices for working with specialty pharmacy partners.

  
  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelors degree from an accredited four-year college or university.

* Minimum 3–5 years of relevant pharmaceutical industry experience, including hands-on management of specialty partner operations, patient services, and complex access workflows. Demonstrated experience coordinating hub, specialty pharmacy, and specialty distribution services and managing vendor performance is required.

* Experience with medical benefit therapies, institutional delivery, and launch implementation is preferred.

* Experience evaluating data sources for insights, specifically specialty distribution and patient services data.

* Strong communication skills, including the ability to communicate the data management subject matter to a non-technical/unfamiliar internal customer.

* Pharmacy experience preferred

**Competencies**  
**Accountability for Results -** Stay focused on key strategic objectives, be accountable for high standards of performance, and take an active role in leading change.
  
**Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving -** Make decisions considering the long-term impact to customers, patients, employees, and the business.
  
**Patient & Customer Centricity -** Maintain an ongoing focus on the needs of our customers and/or key stakeholders.
  
**Impactful Communication -** Communicate with logic, clarity, and respect. Influence at all levels to achieve the best results for Otsuka.
  
**Respectful Collaboration -** Seek and value others’ perspectives and strive for diverse partnerships to enhance work toward common goals.
  
**Empowered Development -** Play an active role in professional development as a business imperative.

Title: Digitalisation & Technology Manager
Description:
**Company Description**

Six Construct, a subsidiary of the BESIX Group, is the largest Belgian construction company operating in the Middle East. The company combines the efforts of a highly skilled workforce, along with strategic planning and innovative use of technology to overcome the most complex business challenges. Six Construct is a multi-services company that operates in the construction of commercial and residential buildings, sport and leisure facilities, infrastructure and marine-related projects. The company currently employs a workforce of approximately 4,000 in the Middle East, and a total of 10,000 worldwide.

 **Job Description**

**Why This Role Matters**

We are seeking a forward-thinking **Digital & Technology Manager** to drive the digital transformation agenda across our business. This role will be responsible for identifying, evaluating, and implementing innovative technologies that improve operational efficiency, project delivery, collaboration, and data-driven decision-making.

The successful candidate will play a key role in shaping our digital strategy, fostering a culture of innovation, and ensuring the effective adoption of emerging technologies, including AI, automation, advanced analytics, digital platforms, and construction technologies. The role will work closely with business leaders, operations teams, project teams, and external technology partners to create measurable business value.

**What You'll Drive**

* Shape the digital journey of the new construction company, defining how technology and data can support the company from start-up through its first project and subsequent growth.
* Embed digitalisation from Day 1, ensuring new processes are designed digitally rather than reproducing traditional construction processes and legacy ways of working.
* Continuously scout and evaluate modern technologies that could improve productivity, quality, collaboration, speed of delivery and decision-making, including AI, automation, mobile solutions, reality capture, BIM, data analytics and emerging construction technologies.
* Translate innovation into practical use cases, working directly with project and functional teams to identify pain points, test solutions and demonstrate measurable operational value.
* Build a culture of experimentation, enabling rapid pilots and proof-of-concepts while quickly stopping initiatives that do not demonstrate sufficient value.
* Create a connected digital environment, avoiding fragmented applications and information silos and ensuring that data can progressively become a business asset.
* Establish a scalable technology foundation capable of supporting the first project and evolving as the new Construction Company grows, without creating unnecessary complexity or legacy constraints.
* Ensure security and confidentiality by design, making these requirements an integral part of technology selection and digital processes rather than an obstacle to innovation. Confidentiality and control of information are foundational principles of the new Construction Company.
* Connect business, construction and technology, acting as the interface between management, project teams, technical functions, technology providers and specialist partners.

  
**Qualifications**

**You're a Great Fit If You Have**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
* Proven experience leading digital transformation, innovation, or technology-driven business improvement initiatives.
* Experience implementing digital platforms, automation tools, AI solutions, analytics platforms, or enterprise technologies.
* Strong understanding of change management and technology adoption.
* Demonstrated ability to bridge business needs and technology solutions.
* Experience within construction, engineering, infrastructure, industrial, manufacturing, energy, logistics, or other project-based industries is preferred but not mandatory.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Passion for innovation, emerging technologies, and continuous improvement.

**Preferred**

* Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI
* Automation and Digital Workflows
* Data Analytics and Business Intelligence (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
* BIM and Digital Construction Technologies
* Common Data Environments (ACC, BIM 360, ProjectWise, etc.)
* Digital Twins, IoT, Reality Capture, or Smart Infrastructure Solutions
* Cloud-based collaboration and enterprise platforms

  
**Additional Information**

**What Success Looks Like**

* Digital principles are embedded into the company's operating model from day one.

Title: Group Operational Asset Lifecycle Manager
Description:
Job description:
  
  

**Group Operational Asset Lifecycle Manager**

We are a leading independent telecoms infrastructure company, with one of the most extensive tower portfolios across Africa and the Middle East. Our business model promotes tower infrastructure sharing and enables mobile network operators (MNOs) to deliver mobile connectivity more quickly, reliably, cost-effectively and with a lower carbon footprint. In turn, this supports the expansion and quality of mobile connectivity, driving sustainable development in our markets.

**What we do**

We build, acquire, lease-up and operate telecommunications towers that can accommodate and power the needs of multiple tenants. Our tenants are major mobile network operators (MNOs), and we serve them across nine high-growth markets: eight in Africa and Oman in the Middle East. Our purpose, mission and sustainable business strategy are underpinned by our values of integrity, partnership and excellence.

**Overview**

Reporting into the Operations & Performance Engineering function, you will develop, govern and improve Group operational asset lifecycle strategies for telecommunications infrastructure assets. You will help ensure strong operational performance, reliability, safety, QHSE compliance and long-term value across the asset portfolio.

Working with Engineering, Operations, Finance, Procurement, IT and Maintenance Partners, you will lead lifecycle planning, asset performance optimisation, change governance, capital investment planning and asset information management. You will use data-led decision-making and digital asset management to improve lifecycle costs, governance and engineering standards across the Group.

**Location:**
UAE or South Africa
  
**Travel:**
Approximately 6–12 times per year

**Role responsibilities**

As Group Operational Asset Lifecycle Manager, you will be responsible for:

* Developing Group lifecycle and governance strategies for power systems, shelters and associated infrastructure.
* Preparing and implementing long-term asset replacement, refurbishment and renewal plans.
* Establishing and governing asset refurbishment programmes across operating companies.
* Improving preventive, predictive and condition-based maintenance strategies to strengthen reliability and extend asset life.
* Optimising total cost of ownership, return on invested capital and asset utilisation through effective lifecycle investment decisions.
* Owning the Group Asset Change Governance process for engineering modifications, integrations, transfers, refurbishments, relocations and disposals.
* Establishing and improving the Group Asset Governance Framework, including asset ownership, approval authorities, engineering acceptance and retirement controls.
* Developing the annual maintenance CAPEX investment programme and prioritising work according to asset condition, criticality and operational risk.
* Monitoring and reporting asset health, reliability, utilisation and effectiveness, using analytics to identify improvement opportunities.
* Governing asset information standards and data quality across Group systems, including asset master data, serialisation, configuration records and technical documentation.

**Requirements for the role**

To succeed in the role, you will have:

* A degree in Engineering, Business, Asset Management or a related technical discipline.
* 7–10 years’ experience in telecommunications infrastructure or another asset-intensive industry.
* At least five years’ experience leading asset management, asset governance or engineering lifecycle management in a multi-site environment.
* Experience with enterprise asset management (EAM), lifecycle costing, asset master data governance and engineering change control.
* Experience in digital asset management, asset analytics and using data to inform lifecycle decisions.
* A background in telecommunications infrastructure, power systems or utilities.

**Desired skills and qualifications**

* ISO 55001 Asset Management qualification or experience applying its principles.
* IAM Certificate or Diploma.
* Certified Asset Management Assessor (CAMA) qualification.
* Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP) qualification.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 qualification.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt.

**Benefits**

* Competitive basic salary
* Discretionary bonus
* Health insurance
* Life insurance

Title: IT Operations Manager
Description:
**Job Description**

The Texas General Land Office is seeking a Manager VII (IT Operations Manager) within the Information Technology Services Department of the agency.

Performs highly advanced managerial work administering the daily operations and activities of the Information Technology Services (ITS) Cloud Operations function. The Cloud Operations Manager leads staff responsible for the agency's cloud, infrastructure, and technology operations and ensures services support GLO programs reliably, securely, and efficiently.

Work involves establishing goals, priorities, guidelines, procedures, and service standards; directing staff performance and development; coordinating daily operations and modernization initiatives; evaluating service performance and operational risk; developing and monitoring budget requests and expenditures; and recommending improvements. The position coordinates with ITS teams, security and governance partners, vendors, and business stakeholders to align services and resources with agency needs.

**Our Mission:**

The Texas General Land Office primarily serves the schoolchildren, veterans, and the environment of Texas. The agency does so by preserving our history, maximizing state revenue through innovative administration, and through the prudent stewardship of state lands and natural resources.

**What Your Contributions to the GLO Will be:**

* People Leadership & Team Management: Directly supervises and supports individual contributors by setting expectations, assigning and prioritizing work, monitoring performance, providing coaching and feedback, and supporting professional development. Builds a cohesive, accountable team environment; addresses performance issues; and ensures staff have the skills, tools, and resources needed to meet operational objectives.
* Operational Execution & Team Delivery: Executes established strategies and plans by coordinating day-to-day team activities, managing priorities and schedules, tracking progress against goals, and resolving operational issues. Ensures work is completed accurately, on time, and in alignment with agency policies, standards, and service expectations.
* Cloud Strategy & Infrastructure Modernization: Leads planning and modernization of the agency's cloud and infrastructure environments. Sets priorities for cloud readiness, migration, platform lifecycle, capacity, and technical debt reduction. Coordinates with technology teams and business stakeholders to align work with agency needs.
* Infrastructure Reliability, Continuity & Disaster Recovery: Oversees the reliability and availability of infrastructure services, including continuity and disaster recovery planning and testing. Directs work to improve backup, recovery, monitoring, capacity, and service resilience, and tracks recovery objectives for critical systems.
* Security, Risk & Compliance: Coordinates with security and governance partners to reduce operational risk and support compliance. Oversees implementation of approved controls for access management, secure configuration, network protection, logging, vulnerability remediation, and audit response across infrastructure services.
* Budget, Procurement & Vendor Oversight: Monitors budgets, procurement, contracts, and vendor performance for CloudOps services. Evaluates resource needs and technology options, monitors expenditures, and recommends investments that support agency priorities and operational efficiency.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, information systems, engineering, business administration, or a related field; relevant education and experience may be considered in combination.
* At least eight (8) years of progressively responsible experience in information technology operations, infrastructure, cloud services, systems administration, or a closely related field.
* At least three (3) years of experience supervising or leading technical staff, including assigning work, setting expectations, monitoring performance, and supporting staff development.
* Experience coordinating technology operations or modernization work across teams, assessing service risks, and communicating status and recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.
* Experience supporting infrastructure reliability, security controls, service continuity, or disaster recovery in an enterprise environment.

**Location Requirement:**
This position is based in Austin, TX. Candidates must be currently located in the Austin area or willing to relocate at their own expense. Relocation assistance is not provided.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Ten or more years of progressively responsible experience in IT operations, cloud or infrastructure services, or technology service delivery, including several years in a management role.
* Experience in a state agency, public-sector, or similarly regulated environment, including familiarity with security, audit, procurement, and records requirements.
* Experience with cloud adoption and migration, hybrid infrastructure, identity and access management, enterprise networking, backup and recovery, and monitoring or observability.
* Experience managing operating budgets, service contracts, vendors, and technology lifecycle planning.
* Experience with IT service management, change control, incident response, and service performance measures.

**Physical Requirements:**

This position requires the employee to primarily perform sedentary office work; however, mobility (moving around the worksite) is routinely required to carry out some duties. This position requires extensive computer, telephone and client/ customer contact and communication. It requires the ability to move and position oneself as needed for filing and similar routine office duties. The job also requires normal cognitive abilities requiring the ability to learn, recall, and apply certain practices and policies. It requires the stamina to maintain attention to detail despite interruptions. Ability to read printed materials and computer screens. The individual must be able to move and transport records, documents, boxes, and all related information and materials, weighing up to 20 pounds when required.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* Free Parking
* Defined Retirement Benefit Plan Optional 401(k) and 457 accounts
* Medical Insurance - State pays 100% of the health plan premium for eligible full-time employees and 50% of the premium for their eligible dependents. The State pays 50% of the eligible part-time employees' premium and 25% for eligible dependents.

Go to www.texasskillstowork.com to translate your military work experience and training courses into civilian job terms, qualifications, and skill sets. Also, you can compare this position to military occupations (MOS) at the Texas State Auditor's Office by pasting this link into your browser:
