Title: Program Manager - Hardware/NPI
Description:
**About Eagle Wireless**
Eagle Wireless is building the connective tissue of the physical world.
  
  
Every connected car, every industrial sensor, every IoT device that needs to talk to the cloud reliably and securely — that’s where we come in. We design and deliver cellular modules and connectivity solutions that automotive, and IoT companies trust to work for years, in the field, without compromise.
  
  
Our teams span North America, Europe, and APAC, giving you the chance to collaborate with world-class engineers and go-to-market experts solving hard problems at global scale — from cybersecurity and supply chain resilience to regulatory compliance across dozens of markets.
  
  
If you want your work to matter in a world that’s rapidly connecting everything, and you want to do it alongside people obsessed with getting the hard stuff right, Eagle Wireless is where that happens.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Eagle Wireless is seeking a Program Manager to own and drive customer programs through a phase-gate hardware development process — from initial engagement and design through EVT, DVT, PVT, qualification, certification, and ramp to mass production. This role requires hands-on experience managing an engineered hardware product (e.g., a cellular/wireless module, networking device, or IoT end device) through phase-gate NPI to manufacturing release, and comfort coordinating across engineering, supply chain, quality, and external manufacturing partners.
  
  
**Key Duties & Responsibilities**

* Manage customer-facing programs end-to-end: requirements intake, design and engineering coordination, qualification/testing, certification, and transition to volume manufacturing.
* Own program timelines and deliverables, tracking milestones through phase-gate NPI stages (e.g., EVT, DVT, PVT) to mass production, and flagging/resolving risks before they impact schedule.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customer accounts, managing expectations and communicating status, risks, and changes clearly and proactively.
* Coordinate cross-functionally with engineering, supply chain, quality, and manufacturing (including contract manufacturing partners) to ensure readiness at each program gate.
* Lead and support phase-gate reviews across the NPI process — including PRD sign-off, design reviews (PDR/CDR), DFM/DFT review, pilot build coordination, and manufacturing readiness assessments.
* Manage BOM, ECO, and documentation control processes in coordination with engineering and supply chain teams.
* Track and help drive regulatory and carrier certification requirements (e.g., FCC, PTCRB, carrier certification) to support program milestones.
* Support manufacturing transfer and cutover activities, including coordination between design/engineering sites and manufacturing partners.
* Prepare and present program status reports, timelines, and risk assessments to internal leadership and customers.
* Identify and drive process improvements within the PMO to improve program predictability and delivery.

**Qualifications/Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience in program or project management, including 2+ years specifically managing hardware products through phase-gate NPI (EVT/DVT/PVT or equivalent).
* Demonstrated experience managing an engineered hardware product — such as a cellular/wireless module, networking device, or IoT end device — through a phase-gate development cycle to manufacturing release, from concept/design through qualification and into volume production.
* Experience working with contract manufacturers or external manufacturing partners.
* Strong understanding of phase-gate/stage-gate NPI processes (EVT/DVT/PVT or equivalent), BOM/ECO management, DFx (DFM/DFT/DFA), and manufacturing readiness gates.
* Excellent cross-functional coordination skills, with the ability to work across engineering, supply chain, quality, and manufacturing teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting program status to customers and leadership.
* Proficiency with program/project tracking tools (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet, Jira/Confluence, or similar) and standard office/productivity software.
* Experience in the cellular/IoT module, networking/telecom equipment, automotive electronics, or wireless communications industry.
* Familiarity with regulatory and carrier certification processes
* Experience with ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite) for BOM, inventory, and production tracking.
* Experience managing programs across multiple manufacturing sites or geographies.

**Our work environment is collaborative, and we offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, which includes medical/dental/vision, generous PTO and paid parental leave programs.**
**Eagle Wireless recognizes the importance of forming inclusive teams to foster an environment where creative solutions are made for our clients, and all have the opportunity to thrive and succeed. We encourage candidates from a variety of backgrounds to apply to be a part of our team.**

4040 Fox Street Apartments is seeking an experienced, proactive, and hands-on Facilities Manager to oversee the maintenance, operation, and overall upkeep of our luxury apartment community.

The Facilities Manager is responsible for ensuring that all building systems, apartment homes, common areas, amenities, and grounds are properly maintained and operating efficiently. This position combines technical maintenance expertise with team leadership, preventative maintenance planning, vendor coordination, and day-to-day facilities management.

The ideal candidate is a strong problem solver who takes ownership of the property's physical condition, anticipates maintenance needs, and works closely with the General Manager to ensure the community consistently meets our standards for safety, appearance, functionality, and resident satisfaction.

While this is a management position, it is also a hands-on role requiring active participation in maintenance operations, repairs, inspections, and troubleshooting.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Facilities Operations & Building Maintenance**

* Oversee the daily maintenance and operation of the property's building systems, apartment homes, common areas, amenities, parking garage, and grounds.
* Ensure all plumbing, electrical, HVAC, mechanical, and other building systems are operating safely and efficiently.
* Diagnose and assist with resolving complex maintenance issues, equipment failures, and recurring building problems.
* Perform hands-on maintenance and repairs as needed to support daily operations.
* Oversee the upkeep and functionality of the pool deck, fitness center, sky deck, lounges, coworking spaces, elevators, garage equipment, and other amenities.
* Conduct regular property inspections to identify maintenance concerns, safety hazards, and areas requiring attention.
* Coordinate necessary repairs and maintenance for elevators, access control systems, garage doors, life-safety systems, and other specialized building equipment through qualified vendors.
* Ensure the property maintains a clean, safe, functional, and attractive environment for residents and visitors.

**Preventative Maintenance & Building Systems**

* Develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive preventative maintenance program for building equipment, systems, and facilities.
* Establish and monitor routine inspection and maintenance schedules.
* Maintain records of equipment servicing, repairs, warranties, inspections, and vendor maintenance.
* Monitor the performance and condition of building systems and recommend repairs, replacements, or improvements when necessary.
* Identify potential equipment failures and take proactive measures to minimize downtime and costly repairs.
* Coordinate required inspections, testing, and maintenance of fire protection, life-safety, elevator, and other regulated building systems.
* Ensure maintenance operations follow applicable safety standards, manufacturer requirements, and local regulations.

**Maintenance Team Leadership**

* Supervise, train, and support maintenance personnel in their daily responsibilities.
* Assign, prioritize, and monitor maintenance work orders and preventative maintenance tasks.
* Ensure maintenance requests are completed accurately, professionally, and within established timeframes.
* Provide technical guidance and assistance with troubleshooting and complex repairs.
* Monitor employee performance, productivity, and quality of work.
* Assist the General Manager with maintenance staffing needs, scheduling, training, and performance evaluations.
* Promote a positive, accountable, and team-oriented work environment.
* Ensure maintenance personnel follow proper safety procedures and property policies.

**Vendor & Contractor Management**

* Coordinate and oversee outside contractors, service providers, and maintenance vendors.
* Obtain quotes and assist with evaluating pricing, service proposals, and repair recommendations.
* Schedule and supervise vendor work to ensure projects are completed properly and with minimal disruption to residents.
* Monitor vendor performance and follow up on outstanding repairs or service issues.
* Assist in managing manufacturer warranties, equipment defects, and warranty-related repairs.
* Maintain accurate documentation of vendor work, service agreements, and completed projects.
* Work with the General Manager to identify cost-effective solutions without compromising quality or safety.

**Apartment Turnovers & Resident Service**

* Oversee apartment turnover procedures to ensure vacant units are prepared for new residents in a timely manner.
* Coordinate maintenance repairs, inspections, and make-ready schedules.
* Perform final inspections to ensure apartments meet the property's quality standards.
* Monitor resident maintenance requests and ensure timely resolution.
* Address escalated or recurring maintenance concerns and communicate appropriate solutions.
* Maintain a professional, courteous, and service-focused approach when interacting with residents.
* Work closely with the leasing and management teams to coordinate move-ins, move-outs, and apartment readiness.

**Budgeting, Inventory & Operational Planning**

* Assist the General Manager in developing and managing the maintenance and facilities operating budget.
* Monitor maintenance expenses, repair costs, supplies, and vendor services.
* Maintain appropriate inventory levels of maintenance materials, tools, equipment, and replacement parts.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce unnecessary expenses, and extend equipment life.
* Recommend capital improvements, major repairs, and equipment replacements based on property needs.
* Review maintenance-related expenses and provide input on purchasing decisions.
* Maintain organized records of work orders, inspections, equipment servicing, and maintenance projects.

**Safety, Compliance & Emergency Response**

* Ensure maintenance activities comply with applicable building codes, safety regulations, and property policies.
* Monitor building safety conditions and promptly address potential hazards.
* Coordinate emergency repairs and respond to urgent building maintenance issues.
* Maintain emergency response procedures for equipment failures, water leaks, power outages, and other property-related incidents.
* Participate in and coordinate after-hours emergency maintenance coverage.
* Work with the General Manager and appropriate vendors to resolve building emergencies and minimize disruption to residents.
* Ensure maintenance personnel receive appropriate safety training and use required protective equipment.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in multifamily residential, commercial building, or facilities maintenance.
* Previous supervisory or maintenance leadership experience preferred.
* Strong technical knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, mechanical systems, and general building maintenance.
* Experience overseeing preventative maintenance programs and building equipment.
* Familiarity with commercial building systems, including elevators, access controls, garage equipment, fire protection, and life-safety systems.
* EPA Section 608 certification preferred or required when applicable to assigned HVAC work.
* Strong organizational, leadership, troubleshooting, and decision-making skills.
* Experience coordinating vendors, contractors, and service agreements.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, respond to emergencies, and work independently.
* Strong communication skills and a commitment to resident satisfaction.
* Experience with maintenance management software and property management systems preferred.
* Ability to balance hands-on maintenance responsibilities with supervisory and administrative duties.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds independently, with assistance or equipment for heavier loads.
* Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, climb ladders, and perform hands-on maintenance work.
* Ability to inspect mechanical rooms, equipment areas, parking garages, and other building facilities.
* Ability to work indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.
* Ability to respond to property emergencies outside normal business hours when necessary.

**What We're Looking For**

We are looking for a Facilities Manager who takes ownership of the property and approaches maintenance with a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset. The ideal candidate is someone who can lead a team while remaining actively involved in day-to-day operations, identify potential issues before they escalate, and maintain the high standards expected of a luxury residential community.

This individual should be dependable, organized, technically knowledgeable, and committed to maintaining a safe, attractive, and well-functioning property while providing exceptional service to our residents.

Pay: From $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* Facilities maintenance: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

Title: Sr. Manager, Business Strategy & Analytics
Description:
There has never been a more exciting time to join Chicago Fire FC.  
  
As one of Major League Soccer's original clubs, Chicago Fire FC is in the midst of an exciting era fueled by tremendous investment, ambition, and growth. With a new $100M state-of-the-art Endeavor Health Performance Center now open, new offices in Chicago's iconic Wrigley Building, and plans underway for a privately-funded $750M+ soccer-specific stadium set to open in 2028 in the heart of Chicago, the Club is building the future of soccer in one of the world's great sports cities.

Joining Chicago Fire FC today means joining an organization on the rise. Our growth creates once-in-a-lifetime opportunities for ambitious professionals to generate meaningful impact and help shape the future of our Club. Whether on the pitch working match day or in the front office, every team member plays a role in building something incredibly special.

At Chicago Fire FC, our mission is to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago through world-class experiences and a relentless pursuit of excellence. We are guided by our core values: Integrity, Respect, Innovation, Accountability, and a commitment to Never Settle.

If you're looking for a place where your work will matter, your ideas will be heard, and your career can grow alongside one of the most ambitious projects in professional sports, we'd love to hear from you.

**Job Overview:**

Chicago Fire Football Club is seeking a Senior Manager, Business Strategy & Analytics to help lead the day-to-day operations and execution of the Club's Business Strategy & Analytics function. This role will report to the Senior Director, Marketing and serve as a key partner across the organization, working closely with Ticketing, Corporate Partnerships, Soccer Business and Marketing to translate business priorities into actionable strategies, analytics, models and data-driven solutions.

This individual will operate as a player-coach, balancing team leadership and project management with hands-on analytical work. They will work closely with team members across Business Strategy & Analytics, providing mentorship and technical guidance, stepping into complex analytics and modeling projects when needed and ensuring the team’s work delivers meaningful business impact.

**Job Responsibilities:**

*Team Operations & Mentorship*

* Lead the day-to-day operations of the Business Strategy & Analytics team, establishing clear priorities, responsibilities, timelines and expectations.
* Mentor and develop team members across Business Strategy & Analytics, providing guidance on analytical approaches, modeling, problem solving, project execution and stakeholder management.
* Serve as a senior technical and analytical resource for the team, helping troubleshoot challenges, review methodologies and approaches and improve the quality of team outputs.
* Foster a collaborative, solutions-oriented environment that encourages knowledge sharing, accountability and continued development.
* Balance team leadership responsibilities with hands-on participation in priority analytics, modeling and data initiatives.

*Business Analytics & Modeling*

* Conduct and support analyses that address key business opportunities across Ticketing, Corporate Partnerships, Soccer Business and Marketing.
* Develop and support predictive models and advanced analyses for ticket demand and single-match forecasting, member renewal and retention, fan behavior, customer lifetime value, lead scoring, segmentation and revenue forecasting.
* Partner with team analysts on complex modeling and analytical projects, providing methodological guidance, reviewing approaches and assumptions and stepping in with hands-on support when needed.
* Translate complex data and model outputs into clear insights, recommendations and business actions for stakeholders and leadership.
* Build and support dashboards, reporting and KPI frameworks that improve visibility into business performance and enable better decision making.
* Identify opportunities to move the organization beyond reporting toward more predictive, proactive and insight-driven decision making.

*Data & Technical Enablement*

* Develop a strong understanding of the Club’s data ecosystem and work closely with Data Engineering and CRM to ensure data is accessible, reliable and effectively utilized.
* Work directly with data using tools such as SQL, Python, BI platforms and other analytical technologies to conduct analyses, develop models and support priority projects.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship across data modeling, analytics, visualization, CRM and data management based on individual team needs and areas of expertise.
* Partner with Data Engineering on data architecture, integrations, warehouse management, data quality and governance initiatives, providing business and analytical context to technical decisions.
* Partner with CRM to support effective segmentation, lead management, fan profile enhancement, campaign measurement and activation of fan data.
Identify opportunities to improve the team’s tools, methodologies, automation and overall technical capabilities.  

*Strategy, Prioritization & Cross-Functional Delivery*

* Partner with the Senior Director, Marketing and leaders across the Club to translate strategic priorities and business needs into actionable BSA initiatives.
* Serve as a strategic and analytical partner to stakeholders, helping determine how data, analytics, modeling and technology can support better decision making.
* Own the intake and prioritization of BSA initiatives, determining the appropriate analytical or technical approach, while balancing business impact, strategic alignment, urgency and team capacity.
* Lead complex, cross-functional analytics and data projects, establishing clear ownership, scope, timelines and measures of success.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve processes, analytical methodologies, automation, self-service capabilities and broader organizational adoption of data and insights.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience in business strategy, analytics, business intelligence, data science, consulting or a related field, with demonstrated progression in responsibility.
* Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to analyze complex datasets, identify meaningful insights and translate data into actionable business strategies.
* Hands-on experience with SQL and/or Python and the ability to independently work with data to conduct analyses, develop models and solve business problems.
* Experience developing or supporting predictive models, forecasting, segmentation, statistical analyses or other advanced analytical methodologies.
* Experience with data visualization and business intelligence tools (Sigma) and demonstrated ability to develop effective dashboards, reporting and analytical outputs.
* Familiarity with modern data environments, including data warehouses and data management best practices. Experience with Snowflake or comparable platforms is preferred.
* Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms, ideally Salesforce and/or Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and an understanding of how customer and fan data can be activated to support business objectives.
* Proven experience leading complex, data-driven projects involving multiple stakeholders from problem definition through implementation.
* Must display a strong work ethic and desire to build a career in professional sports.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with frequently changing priorities.
* High degree of adaptability and comfort taking on unfamiliar or loosely defined assignments.
* Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and a willingness to take ownership well beyond a traditional job description.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment and maintain strict confidentiality while working on sensitive business matters.
* Ability to work flexible hours, including but not limited to evenings, weekends, and holidays.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in business analytics, data analytics, business administration, strategy, finance, economics, data science or a related field.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop analysts or other technical team members, including reviewing work, providing methodological guidance and helping others solve complex problems.
* Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to balance hands-on analytical work with multiple concurrent team and organizational priorities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical concepts, analytical findings, and model outputs for non-technical audiences.
* Strong business acumen and relationship-building skills, with the ability to understand organizational objectives and work collaboratively with stakeholders and leaders to identify opportunities where data and analytics can drive impact.
* Experience in sports, entertainment or fast-paced environment is preferred but not required.

* This role offers a salary range of $75,000.00 - $85,000.00
* Final salary is determined by carefully considering the applicant's background, experience, and qualifications. Base pay may vary significantly based on geographic location, job-specific knowledge, skills, and overall experience. This role is classified as full-time, exempt.

Description:

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
  
  
Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
  
  
2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
**$200M+ in ARR**
, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.
  
  
We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
  
  
Joining Legora means three things.
  
  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
  
  
If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
  
  
****About The Role****
The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the center of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced, strategic Engagement Manager to join our growing team and help a large portfolio of law firms and corporate legal teams fundamentally change the way they work with Legora.
  
  
This is a role for someone who has managed a high-volume portfolio through a one-to-many model, and who knows that transformation across a large portfolio of clients has to be designed, automated and measured. You will drive adoption, technical health and commercial outcomes of your portfolio end-to-end by leveraging systems and technology while reserving high-touch interactions for the most impactful moments.
  
  
You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption program at Legora, helping clients realize measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work.
  
  
****What You'll Do****
You'll own the post-sale motion end-to-end for a large portfolio of law firms and corporate legal teams across our EMEA scaled portfolio. Specifically, you will:
  
  

* Improve the one-to-many adoption playbook: the tech-led onboarding, enablement, and change-management motions and target outcomes for how our scaled customers adopt Legora and transform the way they work.
* Execute against that playbook, sequencing automated touchpoints and interventions from initial rollout to firm-wide adoption, and adapting as the client's needs and Legora's capabilities evolve.
* Facilitate strategic touchpoints with your highest stakes accounts, while using one-to-many enablement to surface high-impact opportunities and guide the rest of the portfolio toward maximum value from Legora.
* Drive sustained value through a programmatic operating cadence: templated success plans, one-to-many enablement, scaled training and digital value reviews.
* Manage the health of the portfolio by monitoring adoption and utilization signals in our internal systems to proactively flag and act on risks and growth opportunities.
* Own the commercials for the scaled program end-to-end by running renewal and expansion as repeatable motions informed by exquisite portfolio hygiene, forecasting, and data utilization.
* Orchestrate engagement across cross-functional teams (Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Product Marketing, Support) to accelerate client success, maintaining end-to-end portfolio context and coordination.
* Translate scaled customer feedback into action by collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, and Product Marketing to inform roadmap, positioning, and enablement, and to represent the voice of the scaled segment.

****What We Offer:****
You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation at scale has to be designed, automated and measured. You're proactive, systems-minded and comfortable making tradeoffs about where to intervene and where to let technology do the work. You take pride in being the reason customers adopt, grow and succeed.
  
  
**We're Looking For:**

* A scaled customer success, renewal management, or customer education background, with a demonstrated track record of designing and delivering programs that serve large customer bases through a one-to-many model.
* Experience building repeatable adoption playbooks and educational programs and delivering them at scale across digital channels.
* 3+ years for Manager, 5+ years for Senior Manager, in scaled or digital customer success, customer operations, account management, or a related field, ideally with exposure to high-growth B2B AI verticals or Legal Tech. Leveling will depend on specific experience and fit for the segment.
* A track record of driving adoption, retention and expansion with a high-volume portfolio of clients, without individual coverage of every account.
* Ownership of a commercial number: you have carried GRR and NRR for a portfolio and run renewal and expansion yourself as repeatable motions, hitting the thresholds by leveraging data and automation.
* Technical fluency and systems thinking: you're comfortable configuring and deploying tooling (CS and CRM platforms, AI agents, LMS, data visualization platforms) to deliver outcomes.

Title: Head of Project Execution, C&I Energy
Description:
**About The Role**

We are looking for an experienced Head of Project Execution to lead project execution for Yellow Door Energy's commercial and industrial (C&I) portfolio across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman and Qatar. The role will ideally based in Saudi Arabia but we may consider Dubai.

Reporting to the Group COO, you will lead engineering and project management for our core C&I project portfolio across solar PV, BESS and grid-connected energy solutions. Your accountability will run from pre-construction design through construction and commissioning to handover to Operations & Maintenance. You will make sure projects are technically robust, safely delivered, commercially disciplined and aligned with approved investment assumptions.

This is a senior leadership role that operates at both strategic and technical level. It suits someone who combines proven C&I execution leadership with deep technical knowledge of solar PV, BESS, electrical infrastructure and grid connection. You will build and lead a high-performing regional team and set the standards, governance and ways of working that shape how YDE engineers and delivers its projects.

**What You'll Deliver & Own**

**Team and execution leadership**

* Lead and develop the regional Execution team across engineering and project management, setting clear priorities, standards and accountabilities aligned with Group and country objectives.
* Build team capability through coaching, performance management, succession planning and recruitment as the portfolio grows.
* Lead senior engagement with clients, EPC contractors, consultants, suppliers and delivery partners, resolving material technical and execution issues.
* Work closely with Development, Commercial, Technical, Procurement and PMO, Finance, Legal, O&M and QHSSE to ensure execution requirements are reflected in project decisions and commitments.
* Embed consistent project governance, reporting, lessons learned and continuous improvement across the regional portfolio.

**Engineering, grid and pre-construction assurance**

* Provide technical leadership across pre-construction and detailed engineering, including design reviews, constructability, site suitability and optimisation.
* Lead or oversee technical negotiations with clients and EPC contractors, ensuring technical requirements are properly reflected in tender packages, EPC agreements and technical appendices. Support commercial negotiations where needed.
* Oversee grid connection and Grid Code compliance across LV, MV and HV systems, including SEC, SERA and SASO requirements and other applicable standards.
* Guide major equipment specification and selection, covering PV modules, inverters, BESS, transformers, switchgear, protection, cables, tracking systems and monitoring solutions.
* Ensure energy yield and performance assessments, including P50/P90 analysis and uncertainty evaluation, are robust and correctly reflected in project assumptions.

**Project delivery, construction and handover**

* Oversee delivery against investment committee-approved scope, budget, schedule and technical assumptions, intervening early where risk or variance emerges.
* Direct contractor and supplier performance, including technical coordination, design implementation, site progress, issue resolution and change management.
* Ensure effective QA/QC across factory acceptance testing, site inspections, mechanical completion, commissioning, PAC, FAC and end-of-warranty activities.
* Ensure as-built documentation, testing records, punch-list closure and handover requirements are complete for transition to O&M.
* Promote strong QHSSE performance and visible safety leadership across all execution activities.

**What You Must Bring**

* A bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.
* 10+ years' relevant experience in solar PV, renewable energy or power infrastructure, including at least 5 years in a senior management or leadership role within technical consulting, EPC, project execution, engineering or asset management.
* A track record of leading multidisciplinary engineering and project delivery teams across development, construction, commissioning and handover.
* Substantial experience in EPC contracting and negotiation, contractor management, technical due diligence and delivery governance for complex energy projects.
* Deep technical understanding of solar PV, BESS, grid connection and LV/MV/HV electrical infrastructure, including protection and major equipment selection.
* Sound knowledge of GCC grid and regulatory requirements, including experience working with local utilities and applicable Grid Codes.
* Commercial and contractual judgement to resolve complex technical, contractual and delivery issues.
* Experience working effectively in a multinational, matrix environment with multiple internal and external stakeholders.

**Strong Advantage**

* Registration with the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE).
* Hands-on familiarity with PVsyst and related design or simulation tools such as SolarGIS, AutoCAD, SketchUp, PVcase or HOMER.
* Experience across C&I, hybrid and/or utility-scale renewable energy projects.
* Exposure to M&A, project acquisition or technical due diligence.

**You'll Thrive Here If...**

* You are equally comfortable in leadership discussions and in a detailed design or grid review.
* You can challenge designs, assumptions and delivery approaches while keeping relationships constructive.
* You build teams with clear expectations and accountability, and you invest in developing people.
* You spot execution risks early and resolve them with sound technical and commercial judgement.
* You look for ways to raise standards, strengthen governance and turn lessons learned into better delivery across a growing portfolio.

**Why Join Us?**

You will lead the execution of C&I renewable energy projects across four markets, working across solar PV, BESS and increasingly complex grid-connected energy solutions.

The role offers real influence over how YDE's projects are engineered and delivered. You will build the regional team, set delivery standards and work closely with YDE's regional leadership and Development, Commercial, Technical, Finance, Legal and Operations teams.

**About Yellow Door Energy**

Yellow Door Energy is the leading sustainable energy partner for commercial and industrial businesses across the Middle East and Africa. We deliver sustainable energy solutions through power purchase agreements and solar leases, helping businesses reduce energy costs, improve power reliability and lower carbon emissions.

Our solutions include solar PV, battery energy storage systems, hybrid energy and energy efficiency. Our shareholders include Actis, Mitsui & Co, TAEF and the International Finance Corporation.

**Apply Now!**

If you are an experienced renewable energy execution leader with deep technical knowledge of solar PV, BESS and grid-connected systems, and a track record of building teams that deliver safe, high-quality projects, we'd love to hear from you.

**Let's lead the charge in sustainable energy solutions together.**

Equal Employment Opportunities – It is the policy of Northampton County to provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all persons regardless of race, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, sex, gender identity, gender expression, age, genetic information, disability, or any other status protected by the Pennsylvania Human Relations Act, Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, the Age Discrimination in Employment Act (ADEA), and the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and any other state, federal, or local law.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**GENERAL PURPOSE**
  
The 911 Training Manager position is responsible for providing initial and ongoing education for the public safety answering point (PSAP) for Northampton County.
  
  
**SUPERVISION RECEIVED**  
This position reports directly to the Deputy Director for 911 Operations.
  
  
**SUPERVISION EXERCISED**  
This position is responsible for supervision over the following classifications: Dispatch Shift Supervisor and Telecommunicator during training. May directly supervise Dispatch Shift Supervisor and Telecommunicator positions in conjunction with the Deputy Director for 911 Operations, Quality Assurance Manager for 911, and the Operations Manager for 911.
  
  
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES OF THE POSITION**  
Trains and certifies new public safety answering point (PSAP) staff as call takers and Telecommunicators.
  
  
Provides training in the operation of Call Handling Equipment (CHE).
  
  
Provides training and certification for the Public Safety Suite products utilized by Northampton County.
  
  
Provides training with Computer Aided Dispatch (CAD) products to support the CAD system.
  
  
Provides training with PSAP equipment used for dispatching.
  
  
Oversees and manages the PSAP Certified Training Officer program.
  
  
Coordinates with local PSAPs to recruit Public Safety Telecommunicators (PSTs).
  
  
Prepares, maintains, and submits required PEMA reports for state mandated and continuing education courses, and prepares state audits.
  
  
Coordinates with management to establish a set of Quality Assurance/Quality Improvement (QAQI) metrics within Association of Public-Safety Communications Officials/National Emergency Number Association (APCO/NENA) American National Standards Institute (ANSI) standards.
  
  
Provides professional growth and continuing education courses for the PSAP.
  
Responsible for training new employees, conducting in-service training, and all required training certifications as assigned.
  
  
Responsible for tracking Certification Dates for all personnel.
  
  
Participates in the Quality Assurance Program, including but not limited to, issues that arise which may need to be addressed through individual training, or modifications to the training program as a whole.
  
  
Assists with all accreditation programs, including but not limited to, Commission on Accreditation of Law Enforcement Agencies (CALEA), and Fire/Police/EMS accreditation programs.
  
  
Assists the Deputy Director of 911 Operations with general budgetary matters, and the daily budgetary process including the preparation, maintenance, and execution of records on budget transfers, and other documentation.
  
  
Provides input and assistance to the Deputy Director of 911 Operations in project and policy development within its area of responsibility.
  
  
Responsible for compliance with National Crime Information Center (NCIC) and Commonwealth Law Enforcement Assistance Network (CLEAN) regulations and training.
  
  
Assists in the hiring and onboarding process for new employees.
  
  
Assists in the personnel evaluation program.
  
  
Assists with Call-Incident Reviews as assigned.
  
  
Assists with general office management.
  
  
Functions on floor as Dispatch Shift Supervisor and/or Telecommunicator, as needed.
  
  
As assigned, may serve in the absence of the Deputy Director for 911 Operations, Operations Manager for 911, and Quality Assurance Manager for 911.
  
  
Performs functions of the Operations Manager for 911 and Quality Assurance Manager, as assigned.
  
  
Responds for major public safety incidents on a 24-hour basis, and is on call for assigned shift, as needed.
  
  
Must be available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for emergencies, as needed. Works non-business hours during drills, training, exercises, non-emergency events, and emergency events. Will periodically be required to be available during evening and night hours as emergency situations or management requirements dictate. Serves as Emergency Operations Center (EOC) Staff and may respond to incidents outside of the PSAP or EOC for planned and events and emergencies, as needed.
  
  
*\*An employee assigned to this title shall perform a majority, but may not perform all, of the duties listed in this job description. Conversely, minor level duties performed on the job may not be listed. The duties listed above are intended only as illustrations of the various types of work that may be performed. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related or a logical assignment to the position.*  
  
**REQUIRED MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**  
  
**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE** – Completion of a high school or general equivalency diploma; **AND**
  
  
At least three (3) years of full time, professional work experience as a Telecommunicator and at least (2) years in a supervisory capacity such as Dispatch Shift Supervisor or Certified Training Officer (CTO); **AND**
  
  
Employee assigned to this title will be required to possess and maintain a valid and current motor vehicle operator’s license. Must have an acceptable driving record.
  
  
**CERTIFICATION/LICENSE** – Public Safety certifications preferred, but not required: Act 2, Act 120, National/State fire academy, EMT, Paramedic, Supervisor Pennsylvania Emergency Management Agency (PEMA) certification, Basic PEMA certification, Emergency Dispatch Quality Assurance (ED-Q) certification from the Internal Academy of Emergency Dispatch, and/or Association of Public-Safety Communications Officials (APCO) Instructor Certification.
  
  
**OTHER REQUIREMENTS** – Employee assigned to this title will periodically be required to be available during evening and night hours as emergency situations or management requirements dictate. Must be available to attend evening meetings of public safety agency organizations. May be required to travel to attend off-site meetings.
  
  
Must successfully complete criminal history investigation in accordance with departmental policy.
  
  
**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES**  
Thorough knowledge of the standard operating procedures (SOP) and the goals and administrative policies for the 911 Operations Center.
  
  
Familiarity with the duties of all other dispatch and administrative staff positions at the Northampton County 911 Operations Center.
  
  
Ability to effectively communicate verbally and in writing. Clear speech with good (corrected) vision and hearing. Ability to discern color images on a video monitor.
  
  
Ability to read, write, speak, understand and communicate in English to perform the duties of this position. Bilingual capabilities are a plus.
  
  
Extensive knowledge of Public Safety Communications operations and procedures.
  
  
Knowledge of the specialized software used to answer and process emergency calls for service related to law enforcement, fire, and emergency medical operations.
  
  
Knowledge of supervisory practices including classroom management.
  
  
Effective time management skills, and ability to work independently.
  
  
Ability to assess training needs, organize course content, and coordinate courses at various locations involving multiple outside resources.
  
  
Possession and maintenance of requisite certifications related to public safety communications or education.
  
  
Ability to effectively instruct a group of students in a classroom setting of various sizes and demographics.
  
  
Ability to logically organize tasks and records.
  
  
Ability to maintain and track certification records for personnel.
  
  
Ability to sit and stand for extended periods of time.
  
  
Ability to use normal office productivity software as well as any specialized software programs that may be in use.
  
  
Ability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings and weekends, to support the needs of the PSAPs. Ability to attend quarterly PEMA meetings, and 911 industry and professional conferences as needed.
  
  
Ability to network and plan with area emergency communication centers to provide cost effective training by coordinating training programs and resources.
  
  
**TOOLS AND EQUIPMENT**  
Telephone, personal computer (including word processing and spreadsheet software), calculator, writing implements, fax machine, copy machine, paper shredder, and communications equipment.
  
  
**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**  
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to walk, sit, talk or hear.
  
  
The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to twenty-five (25) pounds.
  
  
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
  
**WORK ENVIRONMENT**  
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job
  
  
The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet.
  
  
**SELECTION GUIDELINES**  
Formal application, rating of education and experience, interview, and reference check as well as job related tests may be required.

Title: Corporate Transformation Manager
Description:
We are looking for a Corporate Transformation Manager to join our growing team! In this role, you will accelerate value creation from existing initiatives via strategic problem-solving to remove roadblocks/establish enablers and define incremental initiatives to bridge value gap.
  
  
**As a Corporate Transformation Manager, your duties and responsibilities will include:**

* Initiative accelerants

+ Identify gaps between existing transformation initiatives and budget / long-range plan targets
+ Diagnose major roadblocks to initiatives, find root causes and design plans to address

* Cross-departmental Initiative Enablers

+ Partner with initiative managers to understand success factors and critical enablers
+ Identify and establish cross-initiative, organization-level enablers (e.g., change management, analytics)

* Incremental Initiatives

+ Identify opportunities, over and above current initiatives, to realize and surpass annual targets
+ Validate, quantify, and define implementation plan before handing over execution to an initiative lead

* Program strategic review

+ Risk assessment of the overall value creation plan
+ Proactively identify ways to continuously improve existing transformation program and to mitigate its risks

* Executive communication

+ Prepare comprehensive reports in coordination with the rest of the Transformation team and presentations summarizing the status of transformation initiatives, including key milestones, achievements, and challenges.
+ Present findings to senior leadership and stakeholders, providing actionable insights and recommendations for improvement.

**Company Description**

**Financial**

* Accountable for the optimization and performance of a transport operation with an annual operating budget.

Title: Team Lead, Office Services & Facilities
Director of Business Technology
Description:
Liteline Corporation is a privately held Canadian commercial lighting manufacturer with more than 160 employees, selling across Canada and the United States. We are adding a Director of Business Technology to our leadership team, a senior, hands-on role with ownership of technology across the business.

The role has two halves. The first is the job every growing company needs: keep our technology running, secure and recoverable across roughly 130 computers, Microsoft 365, our server cluster and our network. The second is newer. Our own people, from the three Co-Presidents to staff in Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service, now build software tools with AI assistants. The Director of Business Technology will give that work a professional backbone: version control, permissions, backups and fast recovery.

This is an enabling role as much as a technical one. We want our people to keep building quickly. The person in this position will make sure what they build is safe, recoverable and well looked after, without slowing anyone down.

This is a build role. Liteline’s people are already creating their own tools with AI. We are looking for a leader who can keep the core IT environment solid, put the right platforms and guardrails under home-built software, and teach non-programmers to work safely.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Keep Things Running**

* Own day-to-day IT across the business: computers, email, servers, networking, security and backups.
* Run Microsoft 365, including sign-in, multi-factor authentication (MFA), user access and licensing.
* Look after our on-premises server cluster, storage and network infrastructure.
* Oversee security monitoring and incident response together with our security monitoring partner.
* Maintain tested backups and the ability to restore systems and data quickly.
* Lead the help desk and set the service standards the business is held to.

**Own the Platforms**

* Set up and run, hands-on, the platforms our home-built tools live on.
* Own Liteline’s company GitHub organization, where code is saved with full history, including structure, permissions, single sign-on (SSO) and branch protection.
* Administer hosted databases (Supabase / Postgres), including access control, backups and recovery.
* Manage website and application hosting (Netlify), including deployments, domains and environments.
* Maintain a clear inventory of the tools in use, who owns each one and where it runs.

**Govern and Teach**

* Decide what AI assistants can access and set sensible guardrails for company data and credentials.
* Set light, practical rules that protect the business without getting in the way of the people building.
* Decide which home-built tools are business-critical and what level of protection each one needs.
* Run and rehearse restores so that recovery is proven, not assumed.
* Teach staff who are not programmers to work safely, for example explaining version control to someone in purchasing.
* Run training, enablement and “lunch and learn” sessions across the business.

**Team and Partners**

* Lead two on-site IT staff.
* Manage our outside partners for managed services, security monitoring and backup.
* Own the technology budget, licensing and vendor relationships, and bring forward stronger options as the market moves.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader who is equally comfortable running core IT and building platforms that sit under modern, AI-assisted development.

The successful candidate will understand infrastructure, identity and security, and will also understand how software is built, saved, deployed and recovered. Just as importantly, you will be able to explain those ideas in plain language to people who have never written code and help them adopt habits that last.

**Strong candidates will bring:**

* Hands-on experience setting up or administering a GitHub organization, including SSO and branch protection.
* Experience running a Microsoft Power Platform Centre of Excellence, citizen-developer or low-code programme.
* Hands-on experience running Supabase, Postgres, Netlify, Vercel or similar platforms.
* Solid Microsoft 365, identity, MFA, endpoint and security fundamentals.
* A track record of training and enabling non-technical staff, such as “lunch and learn” or enablement programmes.
* Experience building a function or process from scratch at a growing company.
* Clear communication and sound judgment about when rules help and when they get in the way.

There is no single path to this role. You might be:

* An IT lead at a 100-to-500-person manufacturer or distributor who personally ran a Power Platform governance programme, a low-code programme or the company’s GitHub organization.
* A developer or DevOps engineer who moved into an IT management role at a small or mid-sized company.
* A solutions architect or senior consultant at a managed services provider (MSP) serving small and mid-sized businesses, ready to go in-house.
* The “first IT hire” at a startup who set up sign-in, devices and GitHub from scratch, then moved to a mid-sized company.
* Experience in mid-sized manufacturing, distribution or wholesale is helpful but not required.

**REPORTING AND WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**

This position reports to the VP of Operations.

You will work closely with Liteline’s three Co-Presidents, who are technically capable and build their own tools, and with Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service. You will be a partner to the people building, not a gatekeeper.

**LOCATION AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT**

This position is based at Liteline's Richmond Hill head office and is on-site five days per week with regular presence at our distribution facilities.

The successful candidate should expect to be highly engaged with the business and to spend real time understanding how departments and facilities actually operate.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

This is a rare chance to shape how an established Canadian manufacturer builds and runs its technology at a moment when AI is changing who can create software.

Liteline is privately held, decisions are made without layers of approval, and good ideas get backed. Our leaders build with technology themselves and value this work. The Director of Business Technology will define the platforms, guardrails and habits that let the whole company build with confidence.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

Liteline offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and life insurance following three months of service, and a group RRSP with partial company match.

To request accommodation, please contact Human Resources with the position title in the subject line.*

Title: Carrier Certification Manager
Description:
**About Eagle Wireless**
Eagle Wireless is building the connective tissue of the physical world.
  
  
Every connected car, every industrial sensor, every IoT device that needs to talk to the cloud reliably and securely — that’s where we come in. We design and deliver cellular modules and connectivity solutions that automotive, and IoT companies trust to work for years, in the field, without compromise.
  
  
Our teams span North America, Europe, and APAC, giving you the chance to collaborate with world-class engineers and go-to-market experts solving hard problems at global scale — from cybersecurity and supply chain resilience to regulatory compliance across dozens of markets.
  
  
If you want your work to matter in a world that’s rapidly connecting everything, and you want to do it alongside people obsessed with getting the hard stuff right, Eagle Wireless is where that happens.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Carrier Certification Manager will own Eagle's end-to-end carrier certification program across the US and Canada. This includes managing active certification projects, building and maintaining carrier relationships, and working cross-functionally with product, engineering, and sales to ensure Eagle's modules achieve and maintain certification across all major networks. This role is essential to Eagle's product commercialization timeline and go-to-market readiness.
  
  
**Key Requirements**

* Manage active carrier certification programs across AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile (US), and Telus, Rogers, Bell (Canada), ensuring on-time completion.
* Serve as Eagle's primary point of contact with carrier certification teams and labs; build and maintain trusted relationships with carrier ecosystem managers.
* Coordinate pre-certification activities: lab selection, test plan development, sample preparation, and firmware readiness in collaboration with engineering and product teams.
* Own the certification project tracker and communicate progress, risks, and timelines to product management and executive leadership.
* Manage certification costs, budgets, and vendor relationships (third-party test labs, certification bodies).
* Oversee PTCRB, GCF, FCC/IC, and ISED submissions that feed into carrier certification eligibility.
* Monitor carrier certification policy changes, new requirements, and network evolution (e.g., 5G Standalone, Network Slicing) and proactively update Eagle's certification strategy.
* Support the sales team by clearly communicating certification status and timelines for customer RFQs and design-in decisions.
* Develop and maintain certification documentation, including test reports and compliance records.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in carrier certification, regulatory compliance, or technical program management within the wireless, module, or device ecosystem.
* Direct experience managing AT&T, Verizon, or T-Mobile certification processes; Canadian carrier experience is a plus.
* Understanding of PTCRB, GCF, FCC/IC certification frameworks and their interplay with carrier certification.
* Strong project management skills; ability to run multiple certification programs in parallel.
* Excellent cross-functional communication skills with engineering, product, and sales stakeholders.
* Experience with cellular module certification specifically (as opposed to device/handset only).
* Familiarity with 5G NR certification requirements and how they differ from LTE.
* Knowledge of ISED (Canada), FirstNet, and MVNO certification requirements.
* Experience working with third-party test labs.
* Flexible to attend occasional early-morning or evening calls to coordinate with teams in Asia (UTC+8).
* Willing to travel occasionally to carrier or third-party laboratories to provide on-site support as needed.

**What We Offer**
**Our work environment is collaborative, and we offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, which includes medical/dental/vision, generous PTO and paid parental leave programs.**
**Eagle Wireless recognizes the importance of forming inclusive teams to foster an environment where creative solutions are made for our clients, and all have the opportunity to thrive and succeed. We encourage candidates from a variety of backgrounds to apply to be a part of our team.**

The Metadata and Localization Lead is responsible for the accuracy, consistency, maintenance and operational readiness of program metadata across Blue Ant Media's distribution platforms, alongside the coordination of localization operations.
  
This replacement role oversees metadata management, recurring program copy and FAST artwork requirements, and the operational coordination of dubbing, subtitling and metadata translation projects. * Excellent organizational, coordination and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workflows and competing deadlines.

Description:
We Are
  
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Own and maintain the integrated schedule and critical path across multiple Memory Interface IP development and release workstreams, from project kickoff and architecture through design closure, verification, customer delivery, and production readiness. Model dependency chains deeply enough to quantify the impact of slips and pull-ins, distinguish paths with float from those without it, and update the plan weekly using current engineering data.
* Drive the weekly project cadence by synthesizing inputs from architecture, RTL, design verification, analog and mixed-signal design, physical design, packaging, software, infrastructure, product engineering, and post-silicon teams into a single view of program health, emerging concerns, and required actions.
* Track verification convergence and engineering maturity as leading indicators. Monitor feature readiness, RTL closure, bug discovery and closure trends, regression health, coverage, design maturity, and block-level readiness. Recognize when convergence is stalling and drive a recovery plan before downstream milestones or customer commitments are affected.
* Analyze schedule scenarios and coordinate recovery plans. Work with engineering leads to understand technical constraints, resource limitations, and available float; quantify the impact of changes; develop practical options; and track agreed recovery actions to closure.
* Manage external partner and customer dependencies by owning delivery calendars, tracking execution plans and acceptance criteria, aligning technical dependencies, and supporting schedule negotiations with a clear understanding of downstream technical, commercial, and resource impacts.
* Lead cross-functional risk, issue, and decision management. Convert technical uncertainty into clear options, owners, dates, and decision points. Ensure risks, assumptions, and trade-offs are visible early and resolved at the appropriate level.
* Provide concise project insight to executives and customers. Distill complex engineering information into evidence-based updates that distinguish signal from noise, quantify schedule and delivery impact, and clearly identify the actions or decisions needed.

A Day In The Life
  
  
You start the morning reviewing verification-convergence dashboards and regression results, spotting a block where bug-closure velocity has slowed. You bring the DV lead and RTL owner together for a focused sync, clarify the cause, and align on a recovery plan before the weekly project review.
  
  
In that review, you walk leadership through an updated critical path that reflects an internal delivery shift, quantify the downstream impact on release timing and customer commitments, and identify the decisions needed to protect the plan. Later, you follow-up with R&D on the strategy to take to resolve the issue, then finish the day preparing a concise executive summary and following up on owners and due dates from the project review.
  
  
What You'll Need
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Applied Science, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience, with 8+ years of relevant experience in semiconductor, silicon IP, SoC, ASIC, or complex hardware development.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex semiconductor or silicon IP programs across multiple engineering disciplines and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong working knowledge of semiconductor development lifecycles and the relationships among architecture, RTL, verification, analog and mixed-signal design, physical design, software, infrastructure, and productization.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain integrated schedules with meaningful dependency and critical-path modeling, including float analysis, milestone confidence, and the downstream effects of schedule changes.
* Experience using engineering evidence such as feature readiness, bug trends, regression results, coverage, design closure, and delivery health to assess schedule risk and drive corrective action.
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex technical and program information, develop practical options, and recommend a course of action.
* Strong communication and influence skills, including the ability to gain cooperation across engineering teams, customers, suppliers, and external partners and to present crisp status and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Experience with project and program management tools and data-driven reporting. Familiarity with Jira, schedule-management tools, dashboards, and engineering lifecycle metrics is preferred.
* Knowledge of quality-management processes and the ability to navigate Linux environments are considered assets.

Who You Are
  
  
This is not a status-reporting role. You will connect a broad set of engineering workstreams into a coherent, dependency-driven plan, identify the real critical path week to week, and drive the cross-functional actions and decisions that keep complex Memory Interface IP projects on track. The work spans concurrent development efforts with significant interdependencies across engineering disciplines, customers, external partners, and development infrastructure.
  
  
Working with general direction, you will apply strong semiconductor-development knowledge and program-management judgment to analyze issues, recommend practical solutions, and gain cooperation across teams. Success requires attention to engineering detail, disciplined follow-through, and the ability to turn complex technical inputs into clear priorities, ownership, and delivery commitments.
  
  
The Team You'll Be Part Of
  
  
Our engineering teams develop advanced Memory Interface IP that enables customers to build high-performance, differentiated SoCs. We work at the intersection of architecture, analog and mixed-signal design, RTL, verification, physical design, software, infrastructure, and customer deployment. The programs are technically complex, globally distributed, and tightly connected to customer and business commitments.
  
  
We value people who combine advanced technical judgment with clear communication, disciplined execution, and the willingness to work through details without losing sight of the broader outcome. In this role, you will help shape how complex semiconductor programs are planned and delivered, strengthen execution practices across teams, and work alongside talented engineers solving consequential problems at scale.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

The successful applicant for this position will play a crucial role in our mission, supported by our multicultural, customer-centric global team, with opportunities for professional development.

**National Grid is hiring a Head of US Operational Technology role which operates under a hybrid working model and is open to candidates based at our Waltham, MA, Syracuse, NY, and Brooklyn, NY.**

**This is a hybrid role. Employees are expected to work from their assigned office or another approved work location outside the home at least three days per week. Additional in-person attendance may be required based on role, team, and business needs.**

### **Job Purpose**

The Head of U.S. Operational Technology (OT) is a senior leadership role accountable for the safe, reliable, resilient, secure and supportable operation of the technology environments that underpin real-time electric transmission, electric distribution and gas distribution operations across Massachusetts and New York. The role reports to the VP, Head of IT&D Electric and works in close partnership with Electric and Gas Operations, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Architecture, Regulatory, Capital Delivery and other enterprise technology leaders.

The role leads a multidisciplinary organization responsible for 24x7 operational support and lifecycle stewardship of OT applications and infrastructure. The scope includes Energy Management Systems (EMS), Gas Management System (GMS), Advanced Distribution Management Systems (ADMS), Distributed Energy Resource Management Systems (DERMS), SCADA-related capabilities and the supporting network, compute, storage, database, integration and recovery environments. It also includes designated technology supporting LNG operations, physical security systems, substation controllers and substation access points.

You’ll join an established team, building on its existing strengths to deliver meaningful outcomes. Working collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders, you’ll help shape priorities, improve ways of working, and support the team’s continued development and success.

The Head of OT leads directors responsible for application and infrastructure domains and is a key partner to control center, operations, regulatory and executive stakeholders. The role requires experienced, visible leadership during significant events; disciplined governance; strong technical judgment; and the ability to convert technical risk into clear business decisions.

### **Key Accountabilities**

**Safe, Reliable and Resilient Operations**

* Own the availability, resilience, performance, and recoverability of the OT estate.
* Establish clear 24x7 operational accountability, escalation, and decision-making.
* Lead technology response to major incidents and operational events.
* Maintain and test business continuity, disaster recovery, and recovery capabilities.
* Ensure readiness for storms, grid emergencies, outages, and critical operational events.
* Drive continuous improvement through incident analysis and root-cause elimination.

**Cybersecurity, Safety, Compliance and Risk**

* Ensure readiness and compliance with applicable regulatory and cybersecurity requirements.
* Embed safety, cyber, compliance, and risk considerations into technology decisions.
* Maintain auditable controls, remediation plans, and risk management processes.
* Provide transparent reporting on operational, technology, and compliance risks.
* Support regulatory filings, rate cases, and investment planning.

**Technology Strategy and Lifecycle Stewardship**

* Own OT technology roadmaps aligned to business, regulatory, and investment priorities.
* Proactively manage technology obsolescence and lifecycle risk.
* Drive risk-based management of patching, upgrades, vulnerabilities, capacity, and technical debt.
* Establish standards for integration, automation, observability, and platform management.
* Enable trusted operational data, analytics, and AI capabilities.

**Portfolio Prioritization and Investment Leadership**

* Own OT demand, capacity, and prioritization across operations and capital programs.
* Lead transparent prioritization and resource trade-off decisions.
* Maintain credible operational and capital forecasts.
* Translate technology investments into measurable business outcomes.
* Ensure effective governance, intake, and decision-making processes.

**Enabling Capital Delivery and Operational Acceptance**

* Align OT resources to the highest-priority initiatives.
* Represent operational requirements throughout delivery and implementation.
* Ensure operational readiness before service acceptance.
* Identify and manage cross-program dependencies and risks.
* Enable smooth transition from project delivery to steady-state operations.

**Team Leadership, Capability and Culture**

* Lead and develop senior leaders across OT applications and infrastructure.
* Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Establish role clarity across internal teams, partners, and suppliers.
* Build workforce capability, succession plans, and organizational resilience.
* Ensure teams are trained and prepared to meet operational and compliance obligations.
* Strengthen collaboration across OT, IT&D, Operations, Cybersecurity, Engineering, and Capital Delivery.

**Stakeholder, Executive and Vendor Leadership**

* Build trusted partnerships with operational and business leaders.
* Provide clear, data-driven reporting to executives and governance forums.
* Lead strategic supplier performance, accountability, and risk management.
* Challenge decisions that increase operational risk or reduce delivery credibility.
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical operational and technology decisions.

### **Qualifications**

* Senior leadership experience within utility OT, critical infrastructure, or another highly regulated 24x7 operating environment.
* Demonstrated accountability for mission-critical services, operational risk, incident management, and service performance.
* Deep expertise in one or more OT domains (EMS, ADMS, DERMS, GMS, SCADA, OMS) with the ability to lead across a broader technology landscape.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams spanning applications, infrastructure, networks, integration, databases, and operational support.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity, resilience, and regulatory frameworks, including NERC CIP and TSA requirements.
* Proven track record supporting large-scale transformation while maintaining operational stability.
* Experience managing strategic vendors, managed services, and system integrators.
* Strong financial, workforce, and portfolio management capabilities.
* Excellent executive communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent relevant experience.
