Title: Director — BAU (Business-As-Usual), Payroll & SaaS Operations
Description:
**We're Hiring**

**Director — BAU (Business-As-Usual), Payroll & SaaS Operations**

*Re-engineer a global payroll operation: platform-led, offshore-first, automated, advisory.*

**Department:**
Payroll & SaaS

**Reports To:**
Initially the Group CEO; transitioning to the Business Unit Managing Director

**Location:**
Dubai, UAE (onsite preferred); hybrid considered for the right candidate. Travel required.

**About Mercans**

Mercans is a global workforce solutions company. Through technology-led payroll and SaaS services, we help organizations pay and manage their people across borders — compliantly and at scale. We are re-engineering how our global payroll operation runs, and this role leads that transformation.

**The Opportunity**

**This is a hands-on transformation role, not a back-office management one.**
We are looking for a leader to re-engineer Mercans' managed-payroll operation into a country-agnostic, offshore-first, product-led model — one where country knowledge lives in the platform and a central compliance center of excellence rather than in individuals, where automation and AI remove manual work, and where customers own and control their data and execution through self-service. The goal is a standardized run-cycle where any consultant can run any payroll anywhere, and an operation that partners with clients strategically rather than just processing their payroll.

**This is a hands-on, grass-roots role.**
You will learn the product deeply, get close to clients and the operation, resolve issues at the grass-root level, and lead by doing rather than delegating. You will report initially to the Group CEO and, in due course, to the Business Unit Managing Director.

**What You'll Own**

Your mission is to deliver a new operating model. You will:

1. **Build a country-agnostic operating model**
   — codify country rules and knowledge into the platform and a central compliance center of excellence, with one standardized run-cycle and no single-expert dependency.
2. **Build an offshore-first, fungible workforce**
   — cross-trained and “2-deep” in every country, delivering high productivity at scale.
3. **Put customers in control**
   — self-service and data ownership through the product, and a strategic, advisory relationship instead of support ping-pong.
4. **Automate relentlessly**
   — automate manual and country-variable steps, deploy AI as a knowledge layer, and use anomaly detection for visibility and quality.
5. **Run a leaner, focused delivery core**
   with disciplined quality and performance governance.
6. **Migrate all clients onto a single platform**
   to eliminate manual processes and enable people to move freely between clients.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Country-Agnostic, Platform-Led Operating Model**

* Relocate country knowledge out of individuals into the platform (codified rules, wage-type catalogs, formulas) and a central compliance center of excellence.
* Establish one standardized, country-agnostic run-cycle so any consultant can run any payroll anywhere, eliminating single-expert dependency.
* Migrate all clients onto a single platform to remove manual processes and enable free movement of people between clients.

**Offshore-First, Fungible Workforce**

* Make offshore the primary delivery model; cross-train so no client depends on a single person and every country is “2-deep.”
* Drive consultant productivity toward best-in-class levels at scale.

**Customer Experience, Self-Service & Data Ownership**

* Give customers ownership and control of their data, timelines, and execution through self-service.
* Shift client engagement from tactical execution to a strategic, advisory partnership, and drive changes to customer data toward zero for compliance.

**Automation & AI**

* Automate every manual and country-variable step (statutory reports, integrations, bank files, and more) using a deliberate map → automate → internalize approach.
* Deploy AI as an on-demand knowledge layer and anomaly-detection tooling for visibility and quality.

**Scope, Quality & Performance Governance**

* Run a leaner, focused managed-payroll delivery core with clear scope discipline.
* Stand up a business-assurance / QA function with process audits, SLA monitoring, a regional RAG on stability, scalability, and resilience, and a disciplined review, coaching, and appraisal cadence.

**How You'll Work — Hands-On & Grass-Roots**

* Learn the product and the operation first-hand, stay close to clients, and resolve issues at root cause rather than delegating.

**What You'll Bring**

* **Hands-on and grass-roots by nature —**
  you learn the product deeply, get close to clients and operations, and resolve issues at root-cause level rather than delegating.
* **Operating-model transformation —**
  proven design and delivery of a standardized, offshore-first, platform-led payroll/operations model that removes country-knowledge and single-expert dependency.
* **Automation and AI expertise —**
  process standardization, product adoption, automation, and applied AI (including agentic AI) to eliminate manual work.
* **A customer-advisory and self-service orientation —**
  you move clients to self-service and strategic partnership, delivering an unparalleled client experience.
* **Operations leadership at scale —**
  10+ years in global payroll outsourcing or SaaS operations, including multi-regional and offshore delivery leadership.
* **Technology and compliance fluency —**
  deep understanding of payroll/SaaS platforms, config-driven operations, integrations, and multi-country payroll compliance.
* **Leadership and resilience —**
  proven ability to coach teams, influence stakeholders at all levels, and stay composed under pressure.
* **Education —**
  Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations Management, or a related field; MBA preferred.

**What Success Looks Like**

In your first 12–18 months, success means:

* A standardized, country-agnostic run-cycle is live — any consultant can run any payroll anywhere, with no single-expert dependency.
* Delivery is offshore-first and “2-deep,” with strong consultant productivity.
* Customers self-serve and own their data, and the relationship is strategic and advisory — with excellent CSAT and retention.
* Manual and country-variable steps are automated, and clients are migrated onto a single platform.
* The delivery core is leaner and well-governed, with clean compliance and strong quality assurance.

**Why Mercans**

* Lead a genuine transformation of a global operation at the center of how the world pays its people.
* A real mandate to re-engineer the model — this is a role for a builder, not a caretaker.
* A global, fast-moving, technology-led environment with a direct line to senior leadership.
* Competitive compensation aligned to the seniority and impact of the role.

**How to Apply**

To apply, please submit your CV and a short note outlining an operation you have transformed through the Mercans careers portal. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

*Mercans is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce.*

RBC's AI-Driven Software Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC) program is scaling across Technology & Operations through a franchise model. You will be accountable for moving each L3 from kickoff to steady state on time: entry gates passed, 12-week adoption plan on track, and Central teams delivering what each L3 needs.

You will plan and sequence the rollout, coordinate L3 Leads and Central teams (Change & Learning, Platform, Benefits & Baseline), run the gate and waiver process with Technology ESG, and give decision-makers accurate, timely information. You must be comfortable in a high-visibility environment and able to hold direct conversations with Senior Director-level AI-DLC Leads about unmet gates.

**WHAT WILL YOU DO?**

* Rollout Planning: Own the end-to-end L3 franchise rollout plan: sequencing, milestones, dependencies and calendar, from kickoff through steady state.
* Entry Gates & Waivers: Drive each L3 through the five entry gates (roles staffed, readiness assessed, plan signed, platform ready, champion layer active) with L3 Leads and Technology ESG. Run the waiver process with a gap, closing date and owner, surface expiring waivers early, and allow no silent renewals.
* Adoption & Readiness: Support each L3 through the 12-week adoption plan and readiness assessment, including white-glove or self-serve triage. Flag drift against handbook milestones and agree corrective actions with the Lead.
* Central Team Coordination: Coordinate dependencies between L3s and Central teams (Live Programs, Change & Learning, Platform, Benefits & Baseline), and hold each team to its commitments. Resolve cross-L3 conflicts and capacity gaps, or take them to the right forum.
* Forums & L3 Front Door: Run franchise forums, kickoffs, training and certification milestones, office hours and Demo Days. Route L3 questions to the right Central team, log them by topic, and track response times.

* Escalation: Escalate off-track L3s or Central dependencies to the Delivery & Exec Lead and Technology ESG with context and a recommended path, and follow through to resolution. Work with the Program Manager to triage working-level issues.
* Continuous Improvement: Capture feedback from L3 Leads, orchestrators and Change Champions, and analyze recurring questions, gate failures and blockers. Keep the handbook, templates and checklists current, and share lessons from early franchises.

* Prior experience supporting AI, Agile, or SDLC transformation programs, or familiarity with AI-Native SDLC concepts.
* Experience with a franchise, federated, hub-and-spoke or center-of-excellence rollout model.
* Experience with change management, training rollout or adoption programs.

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. Bring your construction industry knowledge and technology leadership experience to NAC, where you’ll have the opportunity to shape our technology strategy, modernize business systems, and drive meaningful business transformation.

North America Construction (NAC) is looking for a business-minded technology leader who understands the demands of a construction or project-based environment and can translate technology into practical business improvements.

Reporting to the VP, Corporate Services, you will lead NAC’s technology strategy, manage a small internal technology team, and oversee external providers. Working closely with executive leadership and teams across finance, operations, estimating, HR, equipment, and projects, you will improve business systems, decision-making, productivity, and the employee experience.

### **Position Responsibilities:**

**Technology Strategy & Governance**

* Maintain a technology and transformation roadmap aligned with corporate priorities and business objectives.
* Establish technology governance, standards, policies and decision-making processes.
* Manage budgets and investment plans, assess emerging technologies, and develop and present business cases to executive leadership.

**Enterprise Applications**

* Provide strategic direction for NAC’s enterprise applications, including ERP platforms, Jonas Construction Software, Procore, Primavera P6, Concur, HR systems, equipment and fleet systems, and future applications.
* Lead or oversee enterprise system implementations, integrations, modernization and enhancements, including requirements definition, vendor management, implementation planning, change management and user adoption. Ensure systems are effectively integrated, aligned with business processes, and support operational efficiency and NAC's evolving business needs.

**Data & Analytics**

* Lead data governance, stewardship, business intelligence and reporting capabilities, including Power BI, executive dashboards, consistent KPIs, and data warehouse and reporting architecture.
* Ensure teams have access to reliable, timely and actionable information to support operational, financial and strategic decision-making.

**Digital Workplace, Automation & AI**

* Lead digital workplace strategy, governance, and adoption across Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, Teams, Power Platform, and Copilot.
* Lead the planning, governance and adoption of AI and emerging technologies, including Microsoft Copilot, workflow automation, knowledge management and collaboration tools. Identify opportunities to improve productivity and business efficiency through effective implementation, change management and employee adoption.

**Business Transformation & Process Improvement**

* Partner with business leaders to identify, prioritize and lead company-wide transformation initiatives and technology-enabled process improvements.
* Lead initiatives to simplify workflows, reduce manual and administrative effort, and improve productivity and operational effectiveness. Work with business leaders to establish, measure, and evaluate the benefits and outcomes of these initiatives.

**Technology Operations, Cybersecurity & Team Leadership**

* Provide strategic oversight of technology operations, infrastructure planning, managed service providers, service levels, cybersecurity, technology risk, business continuity and disaster recovery. Ensure technology services are secure, reliable and aligned with business needs and NAC's growth.
* Lead and manage NAC's internal technology team, establishing priorities, delegating responsibilities, coaching and developing team members, and ensuring effective coordination with external service providers.
* Ensure NAC has the appropriate resources, expertise, governance and controls to support its technology environment. Maintain overall accountability for technology performance, service delivery, operational reliability and risk management, whether delivered internally or through external providers.

### **Qualifications:**

* Post-secondary degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline preferred. Equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience will be considered.
* Relevant professional certifications in project management, business analysis, IT service management, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture or organizational change management are considered assets.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in technology leadership, business systems, enterprise applications, digital transformation or business technology, with increasing responsibility for strategy, delivery and organizational outcomes.
* Demonstrated experience leading technology functions, internal teams, external service providers and enterprise-wide initiatives.
* Experience in construction, engineering, infrastructure, manufacturing or other project-based organizations strongly preferred.
* Proven experience developing and executing enterprise technology strategies, roadmaps, governance frameworks and investment plans aligned with business objectives.
* Demonstrated experience leading ERP implementations, enterprise application modernization, system integrations and business systems optimization.
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, data management, business intelligence, analytics and executive reporting.
* Experience leading enterprise business intelligence, data visualization and analytics platforms, such as Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, Domo or comparable solutions. Demonstrated ability to establish enterprise reporting frameworks, executive dashboards, consistent KPIs and data governance practices that support operational, financial and strategic decision-making.
* Demonstrated success leading technology-enabled business transformation, process improvement and organizational change initiatives, with a focus on measurable business outcomes.
* Experience overseeing IT operations, infrastructure, cybersecurity, technology risk management, business continuity and disaster recovery planning.
* Familiarity with AI, automation, Microsoft Copilot and emerging technologies, including their practical business applications, governance considerations and organizational adoption.
* Strong business acumen and financial awareness, with the ability to develop business cases, evaluate technology investments and assess their business value.
* Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management and change leadership skills, including the ability to translate complex technology concepts into practical business recommendations and outcomes.

**By the end of your first 24 months, you will have:**

* Established and implemented a clear enterprise technology and business transformation roadmap aligned with NAC's corporate priorities.
* Strengthened technology governance, investment planning and executive decision-making, while building strong business-wide relationships.
* Improved the effectiveness, integration and adoption of key enterprise applications and advanced the modernization of NAC's business systems.
* Expanded adoption of Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform and Copilot, supported by appropriate governance and employee adoption.
* Strengthened company-wide reporting, analytics, data governance and executive visibility into business performance.
* Identified and delivered meaningful improvements through automation, workflow redesign and technology-enabled process transformation.
* Strengthened cybersecurity, technology risk management, business continuity, disaster recovery and overall operational reliability.
* Established a well-managed technology function with clear accountability, effective external partnerships and the capabilities required to support NAC's future growth.

  
  

**NAC Offers:**

* Employee & Family Assistance Program
* Excellent company matched pension plan
* Registered Retirement Savings Plans

* Friendly working environment
* Numerous team activities and various company events

Title: Manager, Educational Technology
Description:
Reporting to the Director, Academic Quality and Teaching Innovation, the Manager, Educational Technology provides leadership and oversight vis-à-vis the SLATE (Sheridan's Teaching and Learning Environment) environment as well as broader educational technology strategy.

The incumbent is accountable for all operational aspects of SLATE, which operates for all Sheridan users on a continuous 24x7x365 basis. In this capacity the incumbent provides leadership for the administration, design, development, training, and support functions associated with SLATE as well as other integrated learning technologies, e-learning and digital innovation. This includes any internal integrations to Sheridan's infrastructure including but not limited to student information systems (SIS), HR systems, authentication services and other leveraged systems.

This position collaborates pan-institutionally to engage a wide range of key partners at Sheridan, i.e. Academic Division, IT, OTR, as it relates to planning, strategy, and operationalization of educational technologies, including but not limited to SLATE. The position engages and contributes to provincial and sector educational technology bodies. Further, the role is a key interface with educational technology vendors to ensure the provisioned tools are meeting the broader educational and pedagogical needs of the Sheridan teaching and learning community.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Managing system administration for SLATE and associated learning technologies, leading teams to improve the experience of faculty, students, and employees.
* Plans and assesses upgrades, patches, and pilots of new features; oversees the e-learning design and digital innovation teams; and advises the Director on the development and review of programs and services.
* Evaluating emerging technologies and, with the Director, builds business cases for adopting them, while managing the life cycle of learning technologies from onboarding to retirement.
* Managing major cross-College projects, supports budget and strategic planning, maintains policies, documentation, and usage statistics, and is accountable for timely, accurate communications.
* Managing vendor, sector, and internal partnerships through negotiating contracts, master agreements, SLAs, and End User License Agreements (EULA)s for all contracted services, including cloud-based services, and administers breach procedures such as responses to service disruptions.
* Maintaining relationships with account managers and other vendor representatives, stays apprised of product and service roadmaps, and leads vendor crisis management when service is disrupted or degraded.
* Providing leadership, strategic direction, and supervision to SLATE staff and other digital learning teams, ensuring adequate coverage, prompt response to user support requests, and proper escalation of issues to internal resources or vendors, with all issues documented and tracked to resolution.
* Hiring, supervising, coaching, and managing staff performance in compliance with the Collective Agreement, keeps certifications and training current, and recommends professional development aligned with Sheridan’s strategic vision, while fostering a safe, respectful, and inclusive work environment.
* Accountable for resource stewardship and compliance with Sheridan policies, legislation, and agreements, including Health and Safety, Human Rights, AODA, Acceptable Use, and WHMIS, as well as the secure management of records and confidential information under Sheridan’s Records and Information Management Policy.
* Ensuring the delivery of standard and ad hoc instructions and information on the use of learning technologies, including SLATE procedures, and prepares reports and presentations on SLATE, pilot projects, and other educational technologies for decision-making groups.
* Serves on committees and cross-organizational teams that need expertise in teaching and learning technology or input on SLATE implementation for other Sheridan initiatives, and represents the portfolio’s interests on institutional working groups such as legal, privacy, and web governance.
* Leads project teams, analyzing requirements, developing plans, scheduling resources, and tracking and reporting on deliverables to senior leadership.
* Performing additional responsibilities, projects and initiatives, as required.

**About You**

You have a sound understanding of the **post-secondary education landscape**, including the challenges, emerging trends and issues shaping the sector, and can translate this knowledge into forward-thinking academic leadership.

You are deeply committed to **academic excellence and student success** and are passionate about creating high-quality learning experiences that prepare students to thrive in their studies, careers and communities.

You are an **exceptional communicator** with strong verbal, written and **presentation skills**, and can communicate complex ideas clearly and effectively with a variety of audiences.

You are a **collaborative and inclusive leader** with exceptional **relationship-building and interpersonal skills**. You inspire trust, engage others and build strong relationships that enable teams and individuals to succeed.

You have strong **organizational and managerial skills** and the ability to **multi-task, prioritize and manage multiple complex and competing demands**, while maintaining focus on broader strategic and operational priorities.

You exercise sound **judgement**, and your strong **problem-solving and conflict resolution skills**, coupled with your openness to new ways of thinking, allow you to navigate complex challenges and develop creative solutions that advance organizational goals.

You demonstrate a strong understanding of **cultural diversity** and the varied experiences and needs of diverse populations and are committed to creating learning and working environments where individuals feel **welcomed, respected and supported**.

You demonstrate a strong commitment to **equity, diversity, inclusion and belonging** and to fostering an educational and employment environment that removes barriers and creates equitable opportunities for individuals to participate, contribute and succeed.

**The ideal candidate will also possess the following qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in educational technology, online learning, education or related field;
* 7 years of experience as a senior practitioner, technical advisor, consultant or supervisor with progressive experience in learning and educational technologies (software and hardware) (equivalencies to be considered)
* Operational knowledge of IT infrastructure which interface with learning and educational technologies
* Familiarity with cloud-based computing, enterprise applications and vendor management
* Knowledge of computers, computer technology, education, educational technology from a conceptual to an applied level.
* Teaching experience (preferred)
* Project management experience
* Experience managing staff and building a successful team environment
* Experience managing staff in unionized environments
* Ability to communicate clearly in writing and present appropriately to academic audiences
* Effective negotiation skills with others including vendor partner management
* ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library), Foundations, AODA training (desired)

**Who We Are:**

Every member of the Sheridan community is passionate about the transformational role we play in people’s lives. Our strategic plan, Sheridan 2027: Forging the Future (https://www.sheridancollege.ca/sheridan2027), charts a path towards a new ground-breaking model of higher education that reshapes post-secondary education and better prepares students for the future. We are committed to demonstrably advancing equity, diversity, and inclusivity. Diversity is our strength and fuels our commitment to excellence. Across our campuses, we’re making meaningful strides towards developing an equitable and inclusive community.

To learn more, please visit: Why Work at Sheridan

**Other Details**

We are seeking a leader with entrepreneurial mindset and business-focused Head of Siemens RUGGEDCOM. You will lead a global team of product managers, product owners, and developers while collaborating closely with portfolio management, sales, operations, finance, and regional business leaders. Portfolio Strategy & Business Leadership

* Drive and execute the long-term multi-year growth strategy for the RUGGEDCOM portfolio, aligned with Siemens business objectives.

* Drive accountability for annual strategy development, operating plans, and portfolio investment decisions.
* Identify and pursue growth opportunities through new markets, applications, technologies, partnerships, and acquisitions.

* Establish and maintain market-leading product roadmaps informed by customer needs, technology trends, and competitive analysis.
* Align investments and resources across the portfolio to maximize business value and customer impact based on long-term strategy.

* Customer and Market Leadership

* Represent RUGGEDCOM at executive customer engagements, industry forums, and strategic business reviews.
* Translate market intelligence, competitive dynamics, and emerging technologies into actionable portfolio opportunities.

* Influence and partner with R&D leadership to align product development priorities with business objectives.

* Develop business cases and investment proposals, managing key portfolio KPIs (revenue, margin, growth, market share, product vitality, and customer satisfaction) while ensuring optimized product costing.

* 15+ years of experience in industrial technology, networking, telecommunications, automation, software, or adjacent domains, anchored by expertise in communications infrastructure, automation systems, or cybersecurity.
* 10+ years of leadership experience spanning Product Management, Product Lifecycle Management, Portfolio Management, or General Management.
* Proven track record of leading product portfolios to drive sustained business growth across multi-market environments.
* Expertise in shaping winning product strategies and driving high-impact technology roadmaps from conception to market success.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and align executive stakeholders.
* Strong financial and business acumen.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep understanding of the competitive landscape within industrial networking and customer challenges.
* Experience supporting critical infrastructure industries including utilities, transportation, mining, oil & gas, and defense.
* Knowledge of utility communications, IEC 61850, cybersecurity, industrial Ethernet, or mission-critical networking technologies.
* Track record of successfully leading organizational transformation and portfolio modernization initiatives.
* Strategic Vision & Product Leadership: Shaping long-term product strategies, technology roadmaps, and portfolio growth.
* People Leadership & Talent Development: Building, coaching, and inspiring high-performing global teams.
* Executive Presence & Collaboration: Navigating complex stakeholder networks and driving cross-functional alignment.
* Commercial Acumen & Customer Focus: Maximizing business value, market impact, and customer-centric innovation.

* Deliver above-market portfolio growth and increased profitability.
* Strengthen and scale the PLM organization to power future growth by streamlining portfolio lifecycles and optimizing resource allocation.
* Accelerate new product introductions and portfolio modernization.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

Under the direction of the General Manager and Account Executive and in close partnership with the Strategic Account Managers, the Managing Director, Services is responsible for accelerating services growth across the FSG client base. This leader identifies, shapes, and advances consulting-led opportunities spanning Management Consulting and IT Services, including managed services and capabilities across Security, Data and Analytics, Cloud, Networking, Infrastructure, and adjacent technology domains. The role brings a management consulting approach to client discovery, executive alignment, solution development, pursuit leadership, and commercial strategy, connecting client business priorities to measurable outcomes and executable services engagements. Account Executive and Strategic Account Managers retain account ownership, while this role leads the services strategy and selling motion in partnership with them.

**Services Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth**

* Develop and execute account-level services growth strategies in partnership with the General Manager, Account Executives, and Strategic Account Managers.

* Identify, qualify, shape, and advance Management Consulting and IT Services opportunities within existing clients and selected prospects.

* Create demand by connecting client business priorities, operational challenges, risk exposure, and transformation goals to relevant consulting and technology services.

* Lead complex, multi-workstream services pursuits from early discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.

* Meet or exceed assigned bookings, revenue, gross profit, and pipeline objectives.

**Executive Client Engagement & Consultative Selling**

* Build trusted relationships with senior business and technology leaders, including C-suite executives, transformation leaders, security leaders, data leaders, infrastructure leaders, and procurement stakeholders.

**Management Consulting & IT Services Portfolio Leadership**

* Drive sales across IT Services, including managed services and project-based services in Security, Data and Analytics, Cloud, Networking, Infrastructure, and related technology domains.

* Lead the development of proposals, statements of work, presentations, business cases, and executive-level recommendations in collaboration with solution and delivery leaders.

* Ensure proposed scope, assumptions, outcomes, staffing model, pricing, timeline, and delivery approach are aligned before client commitment.

* Partner with account leadership, legal, finance, operations, and delivery teams on pricing, risk review, contracting, and negotiation.

* Partner with Account Executives and Strategic Account Managers to coordinate client messaging, coverage, opportunity ownership, and executive engagement.

* Collaborate with marketing and practice leaders on campaigns, events, thought leadership, and market-facing programs that generate services demand.

* Engage strategic technology and services partners when their capabilities strengthen the client solution and improve the probability of winning.

* Escalate commercial, resourcing, solution, or delivery risks early and drive cross-functional resolution.

**Performance Management & Business Reporting**

* Maintain accurate opportunity data, pipeline stages, forecasts, activity, and pursuit plans in the company CRM and related operating tools.

* Report services pipeline, bookings, revenue outlook, pursuit health, conversion rates, and account penetration to leadership.

* Use win/loss analysis, client feedback, delivery outcomes, and market intelligence to improve positioning and sales execution.

* Provide visibility into capability gaps, investment needs, competitive threats, and emerging client demand.

* Executive Client Engagement & Consultative Discovery (25%)

* Pursuit Leadership, Solution Development & Commercial Strategy (25%)

* Pipeline Management, Forecasting & Performance Reporting (15%)

* Cross-Functional, Practice & Partner Collaboration (10%)

**REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, technology, engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

* 10+ years of experience in management consulting, technology consulting, professional services, managed services, or complex B2B services sales.

* Demonstrated success leading consulting or technology-services selling efforts, including executive discovery, opportunity shaping, proposal development, commercial negotiation, and closing.

* Experience in a management consulting environment or consulting-led services organization, with direct responsibility for originating or expanding client engagements strongly preferred.

* Experience partnering with account executives or client partners in a matrixed account model, with clear role alignment and shared revenue objectives.

* Strong executive presence and ability to communicate business value, financial impact, operating risk, and transformation outcomes to senior stakeholders.

* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including business-case development, pricing, margin, utilization, contract risk, and services delivery economics.

* Ability to create structure in ambiguous client situations and convert broad needs into actionable pursuits and well-defined engagements.

* Exceptional written, presentation, negotiation, facilitation, and relationship-building skills.

**The Perks**

Title: Senior Program Manager, Strategy and Expansion, MEATR DSP Strategy, Planning and Expansion
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Customers want what they need in minutes, not days. Join Amazon's Last Mile team in the Middle East, Africa and Turkey to shape how our fastest delivery services, including Amazon Now and Amazon Rush, grow and run for customers, delivery associates, Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) and Amazon.  
  
As Senior Program Manager, you will own and lead the strategic programmes that set how our Speed last mile network runs across the region. At the core is flexible capacity: designing models that let DSP capacity move up and down with demand, setting how they fit into annual and weekly planning, and getting Operations, Finance, People teams and DSP partners behind them. Your portfolio may also cover partner commercials, compliance and training, and it will change as priorities change.  
  
Many problems won't arrive well defined. You will frame them, find the ones worth solving, align senior stakeholders on a path forward and build mechanisms that make the answers scale across countries. You will also help shape the team's wider strategy and roadmap.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Set the strategy: own the multi-year capacity and growth plan for Quick Commerce and Speed, and the region's input to annual planning.
* Plan capacity: within the regional plan, build short, mid and long range plans that match DSP and delivery associate supply to demand by hour, day and season.
* Build flexible capacity: design, launch and scale flexible models alongside the fixed DSP network, with the operating, commercial and compliance framework to run them.
* Grow the channel: launch new cities, stores and countries with capacity ready before go-live.
* Improve efficiency: raise utilisation and lower cost per delivery without moving cost onto DSPs or associates.
* Build partner economics: shape DSP commercial models with Finance that work at every volume level, and lead the trade-off decisions.
* Look after delivery associates: design fair, safe, compliant schedules and lead the regional response to labour rule changes.
* Align and lead change: bring Operations, Finance, People, Legal, Tech and DSPs behind one plan, and run readiness and approvals.
* Build mechanisms: set planning tool requirements with Tech, and the metrics, guardrails and reviews that run the channel, using automation and AI.
* Lead and write: influence senior leaders, mentor PMs and analysts, and write documents that drive decisions.

  
A day in the life  
You start with yesterday's Quick Commerce and Speed performance: where capacity matched demand, where routes ran short or associates sat idle, and what it cost. Mid-morning, you join the weekly planning review to agree where flexible capacity steps in next week. You then meet a DSP owner to test a new flexible model against their margin and their associates' hours. After lunch, you work with Finance and Legal on the case for scaling it to a second country. You end the day writing for senior leaders: what the pilot showed, what you recommend and what you need from them.  
  
About the team  
This is a new role reporting to the Senior Manager, Strategy and Expansion, MEATr DSP. Quick Commerce and Speed, including Amazon Now and Amazon Rush, are delivered by DSPs, and flexible capacity is a lead theme in the region's 2027 plan. You will own Speed capacity and flexible capacity programmes across the region, planning inside the regional capacity plan and working with the Network Optimisation team, who own rate cards. You will mentor PMs and analysts and write planning papers reviewed at Director and VP level.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. Title: Director, Information Technology
Description:
IOA is on the forefront of revolutionary healthcare models, reshaping the way people can age in place. Our innovative models transform lives, enhance communities, and save healthcare systems millions of dollars. Rather than focusing on archaic outdated design, we strive to consistently question the “status-quo” and create new and more innovative ways to help aging adults and adults with disabilities maintain their quality of life.
  
  
With over 23 programs, we offer multiple ways to aid seniors maintain their health, well-being, independence and participation in the community, fulfilling our mission.
  
  
Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, the Director of Information Technology leads day-to-day IT operations and ensures reliable, secure, and responsive technology services across Institute on Aging. The role manages the organization’s managed service provider (MSP), oversees Microsoft 365 and core infrastructure, and coordinates cybersecurity operations and end-user support. Working within the technology direction and priorities established by the CTO, the Director translates those priorities into practical operating plans and service improvements.
  
  
The successful candidate combines hands-on technical judgment with effective vendor management, team leadership, and a strong customer service orientation. The Director leads internal IT staff and external providers, establishes clear accountability for service delivery, and partners with colleagues to support office-based, remote, and field employees. Title: Senior Director, Software & Services Strategy
Description:
**Job Description**
===================

The Senior Director, Software & Services Strategy will report directly to the VP, Strategy, Power and serve as the enterprise strategist and business architect for the convergence of software, controls, industrial data, artificial intelligence, and lifecycle services across the Power Segment.

The role will help Power evolve from a model centered primarily on equipment control, software products, and event-based service delivery toward an integrated growth system that uses proprietary industrial context, trusted intelligence, validated action, and service execution to improve customer availability, reliability, productivity, operating economics, and lifecycle value.

This leader will not replace the operating accountability of Services or Software & Controls Solutions. Instead, the leader will own the strategic seams between them: the integrated thesis, value-pool choices, business architecture, new commercial and contract models, ecosystem strategy, cross-business governance, and incubation of the first scalable integrated offers.

  
  

**Why the Role Is Needed**
==========================

Power’s Services business represents a foundational long-term profit pool. Software & Controls Solutions is smaller today from a P&L perspective but has significant growth ambitions and provides capabilities that can reshape the future economics and differentiation of Services. The critical strategic question is therefore broader than how to grow software as a standalone business.

* The most important future customer outcomes span organizational boundaries and cannot be captured by Services, Software & Controls Solutions, Engineering, or Digital Technology acting independently.

* Industrial software firms, systems integrators, hyperscalers, OEMs, and AI-native entrants are increasingly competing to own the customer’s data context, workflow layer, decision interface, and transformation agenda.

* GE Vernova’s differentiated starting point is its installed base, controls authority, equipment and fleet knowledge, service history, customer relationships, and ability to translate insight into safe, validated action.

* Without coordinated leadership, fragmented investment, unclear commercial credit, competing roadmaps, and slow cross-business decisions could prevent Power from converting those assets into durable growth.

Title: Program Controls Advisory Services Manager
Description:
When you care deeply about the work you do, it’s rewarding to see it through from concept to completion. We partner with clients to provide both program management and construction management to strategize, plan, and implement projects that drive organizations forward. From hospitals and airports to university campuses, mass transit systems, water treatment facilities, mines, and wind farms, we've successfully managed thousands of projects.

Joining our team, turning visionary ideas into reality, will shape your future—and the future of your community.

We are strategizing, planning, and implementing projects that help clients achieve their organization’s objectives. Join our award-winning program management team and bring transformational project solutions to life.

Your Opportunity

Stantec is seeking qualified candidates for a Program Controls Advisory Services Manager position. The individual serves as a senior advisor to major capital programs, providing strategic Program Controls leadership during program mobilization, execution, transformation and periods of performance challenge.

The role operates at the intersection of client needs, Program Management and Program Controls, translating client objectives into practical governance, processes, systems, reporting and decision-making frameworks. Unlike a traditional Program Controls Manager focused on day-to-day delivery for one program, this role is deployed where specialized leadership, independent perspective or intervention is required.

The position establishes new controls organizations, assesses and strengthens existing programs, resolves complex delivery issues, improves underperforming controls environments and supports program leadership in restoring confidence, integration and predictability. It also acts as a trusted bridge among the client, PMO, delivery partners, consultants, contractors and internal controls teams.

This position requires prior experience working on an integrated program team with strong knowledge and hands-on experience in developing baseline project budgets and schedules; monitoring and tracking the progress of project work relative to established budgets and schedules; preparation of project budget and schedule status reports and presentations; working with Program/Project Managers to proactively identify project budget and schedule problems and implement corrective actions; and preparation of cost accruals, estimates to complete and estimates at completion.

Qualified candidates understand the process of administering the non-technical elements of large projects that are tied together for the successful delivery of a program. They are comfortable developing and maintaining procedures that help streamline project controls processes and provide mentorship to other project controls specialists and team members. They possess emotional intelligence and prioritize establishing and maintaining trusting relationships and close partnerships with Program/Project Managers, other team members and supporting them in serving the client and meeting established goals to achieve success

Your Key Responsibilities

Program Mobilization and Setup

* Advise clients and program leadership on fit-for-purpose Program Controls operating models for major capital programs.
* Develop governance frameworks for cost, schedule, risk, change, forecasting, funding, performance measurement and reporting.
* Establish integrated WBS, CBS, OBS, control accounts, coding structures, baselines, calendars, reporting cycles, roles, responsibilities and approval authorities.
* Develop Program Controls Plans, procedures, SOPs, workflows, responsibility matrices and reporting standards.
* Evaluate and recommend PMIS, scheduling, cost, risk and business-intelligence solutions, including Primavera P6, Primavera Unifier, e-Builder, Power BI and enterprise ERP platforms.
* Create scalable controls that mature across planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning and closeout.

Program Controls Advisory

* Serve as a senior advisor to Program Directors, Program Managers, PMO leaders and client executives on program performance and controls strategy.
* Independently assess whether controls are producing reliable information that management can use with confidence.
* Translate complex controls data into executive-level insight on current status, forecast direction, changes, risks and required decisions.
* Challenge ineffective practices and recommend practical improvements aligned with program maturity, complexity, risk profile, contracting strategy and delivery model.

Program Intervention and Issue Resolution

* Rapidly assess controls maturity and identify root causes of performance issues.
* Evaluate schedule quality, cost performance, forecast reliability, risk exposure, change governance, funding alignment and reporting effectiveness.
* Identify breakdowns among cost, schedule, risk, change, funding, contracts and program decision-making.
* Develop and lead targeted recovery and corrective-action plans with clear owners, milestones and performance indicators.
* Resolve unclear ownership, inconsistent processes, disconnected data, reporting gaps and ineffective functional interfaces.
* Stabilize underperforming controls environments and remain engaged long enough to embed sustainable improvements.

Client Services and Client Advocacy

* Serve as a trusted advisor between the client and the program delivery organization.
* Understand client objectives, funding constraints, governance requirements, risk tolerance and performance expectations.
* Translate client needs into clear, actionable requirements for the PMO and delivery teams.
* Facilitate difficult conversations involving performance, forecast changes, schedule delays, risk exposure, funding constraints and delivery challenges.
* Provide an objective perspective where client expectations and delivery realities are not aligned.
* Build trust through transparent, data-driven advice while maintaining productive stakeholder relationships.

Program Performance and Integration

Promote an integrated management environment in which Scope -> Schedule -> Cost -> Funding -> Risk -> Change -> Forecast -> Decision operate as a connected system.

* Ensure cost forecasts reflect schedule progression, approved changes and known risks.
* Ensure schedule forecasts consider procurement, funding, contractor capacity and delivery constraints.
* Connect quantified risk exposure with contingency and management reserve strategies.
* Improve consistency between project-level and program-level reporting.
* Develop forward-looking indicators that identify emerging issues before they become significant performance problems.

Governance and Program Assurance

* Conduct health checks and maturity assessments of Program Controls organizations.
* Assess compliance with procedures and governance expectations, including gaps between documented and actual practices.
* Establish escalation thresholds, decision rights and approval authorities.
* Support executive governance forums with concise, decision-oriented performance information.
* Review data quality and reporting reliability before information is elevated to client executives.
* Support independent program reviews, recovery initiatives and performance-improvement efforts.

Leadership and Capability Building

* Mentor Program Controls Managers and professionals across cost, schedule, risk, change, forecasting and reporting disciplines.
* Coach program leadership on using controls information for timely decisions.
* Establish clear interfaces among PMO leadership, controls functions, delivery teams and clients.
* Build collaborative multidisciplinary teams and reduce functional silos.
* Develop repeatable standards, frameworks, templates and leading practices for deployment across programs.
* Plan knowledge transfer so improvements remain with the program after the advisory engagement ends.

Typical Engagements

* A new multi-year capital program needs its controls organization established.
* A PMO is being formed, reorganized or transitioned.
* A client needs an independent assessment of Program Controls.
* Forecasts or schedules are not credible, consistent or decision-ready.
* Projects report differently, preventing program-level visibility.
* Risk, contingency, funding and change are disconnected from cost and schedule.
* Leadership does not trust dashboards or performance reporting.
* Systems are fragmented, overly complex or underutilized.
* Client and Program Management expectations have become misaligned.
* A program requires stabilization, turnaround, recovery or knowledge transfer.

The successful candidate should:

* Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Have the demonstrated ability to encourage and facilitate collaboration and cooperation amongst diverse team members
* Schedule and lead coordination meetings
* Work in a manner to ensure personal safety and that of fellow employees by following company health and safety guidelines and policies.
* Consistently adhere to Company processes and policies including business conduct, cyber-security, safety and personal conduct.

It is expected the successful candidate will have the following qualifications:

* Combination of a degree from an accredited institution in an applicable field or documented experience specific to program controls
* BA/BS Engineering, Construction Management, Business, Finance, Project Management or a related discipline.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is preferred
* Additional certifications, PgMP, PMI-SP, PMI-RMP, PMI-CP, CPA, CCM, PE, FE, or similar certifications is preferred
* A minimum of 15 years’ progressive experience supporting complex capital programs, including substantial Program/Project Controls leadership experience infrastructure/buildings/utility/water programs is required
* Familiarity with various project delivery methods, including Design Bid Build, Progressive Design Build, CMAR, and Design Build.
* Demonstrated success establishing, transforming or leading Program Controls functions on major infrastructure or capital programs.
* Strong knowledge of cost management, forecasting, scheduling, risk and opportunity management, change management, funding and cash-flow planning, performance reporting, PMIS/ERP environments and program assurance.
* Experience in the municipal sector in areas of public works, utilities, transportation, and industry and on multi-sector programs is preferred
* Experience in owner, PMCM, consultant, contractor or integrated delivery environments and advising senior client leadership.
* Must be able to demonstrate good interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
* Must demonstrate organizational skills and ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously.

Title: System Director of Technology Operations and Governance

Description:
Sila is a financial technology company providing the infrastructure that businesses need to build and operate modern financial products.

The company specializes in payment APIs, ACH transfers, instant settlement, digital wallets, virtual accounts, identity verification, and fraud prevention.

Through its technology platform and network of banking and financial services partners, Sila helps fintech companies integrate money movement capabilities into their applications without having to build complex financial infrastructure from scratch.

Its business requires close coordination across technology, banking operations, compliance, customer support, and financial services partnerships. Reliable operations and strong internal processes are essential to maintaining the quality and consistency of its platform.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Managing Director of Operations to oversee business operations and help strengthen the systems, processes, and organizational structure supporting the company's financial technology platform.

This is a senior leadership role for someone who understands fintech operations and the demands of managing payment-related services in a highly connected financial environment.

You'll work closely with executive leadership, engineering, banking operations, compliance, and customer-facing teams to improve operational performance and ensure that business priorities are carried out effectively.

We're looking for someone who can balance strategic planning with practical execution. That means understanding payment workflows, banking partner relationships, operational costs, service reliability, and the financial impact of business decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Oversee daily business operations and establish consistent operating standards across the organization's financial technology and payment services.

Work with executive leadership to develop operational strategies, business priorities, and long-term organizational plans.

Coordinate payment operations involving ACH transfers, instant settlement, digital wallets, virtual accounts, and related financial services.

Strengthen operational procedures for transaction monitoring, payment reconciliation, exception handling, and service delivery.

Work closely with banking partners and external financial institutions to support reliable payment operations and effective business coordination.

Partner with finance leadership to review operating budgets, resource allocation, cash flow requirements, and departmental financial performance.

Evaluate operational expenses, service delivery costs, vendor agreements, and technology investments to identify opportunities for greater efficiency.

Collaborate with compliance and risk management teams to strengthen operational controls, customer onboarding procedures, and fraud prevention processes.

Work with engineering and product teams to improve internal workflows, platform reliability, and the delivery of new financial technology capabilities.

Establish performance metrics covering operational efficiency, transaction processing, service quality, customer support, and business performance.

Lead cross-functional teams, develop management capabilities, and establish clear accountability across operational functions.

Present operational results, financial assessments, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.

Qualifications and Experience

Candidates should bring **15 to 20 years of professional experience** in business operations, financial services, fintech, banking operations, or corporate management.

A minimum of **8 to 12 years of management experience** is preferred, including responsibility for senior teams, operational departments, or complex business functions.

Strong knowledge of payment processing, financial technology operations, banking infrastructure, and business process management is essential.

Experience with ACH payments, electronic funds transfers, digital banking, embedded finance, or payment platforms would be particularly valuable.

A solid understanding of financial planning, operating budgets, cost management, revenue performance, and operational risk is required.

Experience managing banking relationships, technology vendors, compliance processes, and cross-functional business initiatives is highly desirable.

Candidates should demonstrate strong leadership, analytical judgment, problem-solving ability, and executive communication skills.

A bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field is preferred. An MBA or relevant advanced qualification would be an advantage.

Title: Director, Project Management
Description:
Everest Clinical Research (“Everest”) is a full-service contract research organization (CRO) providing a broad range of expertise-based clinical research services to worldwide pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device industries. We serve some of the best-known companies and work with many of the most advanced drugs, biologics, and medical devices in development today.

Everest has been an independent CRO since 2004 with a strong foundation as a statistical and data management center of excellence. Building on this foundation, Everest has successfully developed and established itself as a full-service CRO. Everest’s Corporate headquarters are located in Ontario, Canada and US headquarters in New Jersey, USA, with additional physical offices in Asia and Europe.

Everest is known in the industry for its high-quality deliverables, superior customer service, and flexibility in meeting clients’ needs. A dynamic organization with an entrepreneurial origin, Everest continues to experience exceptional growth and great success.

Quality is our backbone, customer-focus is our tradition, flexibility is our strength…that’s us…that’s Everest.

To drive continued success in this exciting clinical research field, we are seeking a committed, skilled, and customer-focused individual to join our winning team as a **Director, Project Management** for our Toronto/Markham, Ontario, Canada on-site location, or remotely from a home-based office anywhere in Canada in accordance with our Work from Home policy.

**Director, Project Management:**

This leadership role will oversee the project planning, communication, and execution of clinical research and development services offered by Everest. Direct reports include all levels and roles within the Project Management department, including Associate Directors, Senior Managers, Managers, Senior Project Managers, Project Managers, Associate Project Managers and Project Coordinators. In-direct reports/subordinates are those Project Managers who are assigned to the tasks on the client studies and projects overseen by the Director of Project Management (matrixed organization).

**JOB ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

* Plan and implement new client service delivery requests within client portfolio; support evolution of existing client portfolio, providing holistic biometrics and full services (including clinical operations) project deliveries across multiple clinical development programs.
* Strategically align the efforts of functional area directors and managers in project planning, identification of tasks and deliverables, and assessment of resource needs and utilization for existing and new clients/sponsors.
* Perform project and portfolio performance tracking for responsible projects using strategic planning and project tracking methods and tools. Conduct regular project progress reviews with internal teams for assigned portfolios, and facilitate conduct of Everest and Client governance meetings to optimize partnership expectations and performance.
* Check and ensure that responsible projects carried out at Everest are properly tracked and managed according to Everest’s quality, operational and financial budget standards. Support solution and budget development for complex and unique projects and scope to address client requirements.
* Provide leadership, training, mentorship, and management oversight of project management staff. This may include mentorship and training of team members to deliver project management services for specific client portfolios, or mentorship and career development of individuals in a line management capacity.
* In consultation with the senior Project Management leadership, review new Project Management Applicants and recommend hires for interview processing.
* In consultation with the senior Project Management leadership, further develop and establish policies and Standard Operating Procedures in project management for assurance of quality deliverables. Continue to support the development, update, and review of governing documents and WIs for the department.
* Initiate, drive, and support project management departmental process and technology improvement initiatives. Lead and contribute to developing reusable project management templates and training materials that can be used to improve effectiveness and efficiency of project delivery by other team members.
* Through the periodic project/portfolio review meetings, effectively identify issues such as lack of planning, lack of resources, poor team performance, or other external factors negatively impacting the ongoing projects, and bring the issues and solutions to the attention of the functional area directors and managers. Work with the functional area directors and managers to jointly ensure smooth project starting up, continuation, and successful completion.
* In consultation with Everest functional leaders and senior project management leadership, interact with clients for strategic partnership governance activities, which includes but is not limited to project pipeline and delivery planning, measuring performance metrics for the portfolio, identifying new project/service opportunities within the existing portfolio, implementing performance improvement and innovation initiatives, and obtaining key information to aid in the projection of resource requirements and project management purposes.
* Manage all project management aspects of assigned Phase I -IV clinical trials and in accordance with ICH guidelines, FDA, Health Canada, EMA, and other applicable regulatory and legal requirements.
* Lead cross-functional project teams. Manage the planning, implementation, conduct, and reporting of assigned projects within the established timelines and budgets, and with the quality and requirements necessary for regulatory approvals.
* Proactively track and manage project tasks against timelines and hours spent/budgets, alert management when there are risks of having major deviations. Proactively track and manage the financial status against budget and reconcile expenses across sub-streams of activities.
* Function as senior level facilitator of problem solving and conflict resolution, and act as a 2nd level escalation resource.
* Conduct “lessons learned” meetings with project team members to learn from failures and prevent same from future projects.
* Contribute and/or participate in the performance evaluation of staff who performed under the responsible projects.
* When required, this position may assist the organization in responding to and preparing for RFI and RFPs, and subsequently leading and participating in bid defense meetings, defining work scopes and budgets, and leading contract administration activities.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* B.Sc. or M.Sc. in life sciences or health related field.
* A minimum of 18 years of experience in clinical research and development within a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, institutional, or CRO setting.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop others within functional area.
* Demonstrated understanding of cross-functional processes including clinical operations, statistics, data management, pharmacovigilance, subject randomization and drug supply management, data monitoring and adjudication committees, regulatory affairs, and medical writing.
* Knowledge and understanding of ICH guidelines, FDA, Health Canada, and EMA regulations.
* Ability to define scopes and estimate budgets, plan and manage projects, including resource requirements and utilization, hours spent vs. budgets, key deliverables and timelines.
* Demonstrated leadership abilities, including setting goals for others and driving to achieve them in accordance with allocated resources, timelines, and budgets.
* Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills. Demonstrated strong negotiation and presentation skills.
* Strong ability in problem-solving, including conflict resolution.

  

**Benefits & Compensation:**

We offer a robust benefits package to support your health, well-being, and growth, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, life & AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability, tuition reimbursement, fitness reimbursement, employee assistance program (EAP), a pension plan, generous paid time off and sick leave, and the opportunity to earn a performance based bonus.

To find out more about Everest Clinical Research and to review other opportunities, please visit our website at www.everestclinical.com (http://www.ecrscorp.com).

Title: Call Center Operations Manager
Description:
**About BlinkRx:**

BlinkRx is rebuilding how Americans access life-changing medicines. Today, only one in five prescriptions for new branded therapies are ever filled. The problem isn't the medicine. It's insurance barriers, affordability challenges, fragmented pharmacy experiences, and inadequate support that keep patients from starting and staying on treatment. Our mission is to change that.

We built RxOS, the first AI-powered prescription operating system. RxOS connects the largest network of doctors, patients, pharmacies, payers, and pharmaceutical manufacturers, intelligently orchestrating every step to guarantee a seamless prescription journey for every script.

Our teams solve complex, high-stakes problems at the intersection of artificial intelligence, healthcare operations, logistics, payments, and regulation. The impact is transformative: BlinkRx more than doubles the rate at which patients take their medications and lowers their out-of-pocket expenses by hundreds of dollars every month.

BlinkRx created and leads a rapidly growing $80+ billion category, with exceptional momentum:

* **Built for scale:**
  Over the past decade, we have invested nearly $1 billion in building the technology and operational platform required to serve patients at scale.
* **Proven growth and economics:**
  We have grown 100% annually for the past five years, are profitable, and support more than 60 pharmaceutical brands.
* **Trusted with category-defining programs:**
  Our technology powers a leading pharmaceutical manufacturer’s direct-to-patient platform for its GLP-1 portfolio, providing the infrastructure to expand patient access as demand for these therapies grows.

We are a dynamic team of technologists and industry experts seeking to build a generational company that delivers a genuine step change in American health.

**The Role:**
The Patient Services Operations team is at the forefront of the company mission to bring affordable prices and deliver the best possible experience for all of our customers. As a Call Center Operations Manager, you won't just oversee a team — you'll set the pace, raise the bar, and build a culture where grit and customer obsession are the standard, not the exception. This is a high-intensity, high-impact role. You'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution: designing systems that scale, coaching talent that sticks, and using data to drive relentless improvement. When things break — and in a fast-growing company, things break — you'll be the one who figures it out and moves the team forward. You'll collaborate across product, engineering, pharmacy, and business leadership to translate the voice of the customer into real operational and product changes. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage from a distance.

***This is a full-time, on-site position based in our Pittsburgh (Robinson Twp.) office.***

**What you’ll do:**

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of customer service reps and team leads — holding the bar high while investing in each person's growth.
* Drive a performance culture built on accountability, candid feedback, and real development — not just annual reviews.
* Create an environment where people do their best work, feel ownership over outcomes, and genuinely care about the patients they serve.

**Operational Management**

* Own the day-to-day: ensure timely, high-quality resolution of customer issues across all channels (phone, email, chat) — at speed and at scale.
* Tackle complex, ambiguous escalations head-on with sound judgment and customer-first instincts.
* Build and enforce policies, processes, and SLAs that are rigorous but human — protecting the customer experience while enabling a fast-moving team.
* Stay ahead of capacity: monitor workload, adjust staffing, and anticipate surges before they become fires.

**Performance Monitoring & Reporting**

* Own the metrics that matter — CSAT, NPS, FCR, response time, resolution time — and use them to tell a story, not just report numbers.
* Surface trends in customer behavior and pain points; turn those insights into action with product, engineering, and operations.
* Implement Quality Assurance programs that raise the floor on service quality, every week.

**Process Improvement**

* Relentlessly question the status quo: identify friction in workflows, eliminate steps that slow agents down, and reduce customer effort at every touchpoint.
* Lead improvement initiatives end-to-end — design, pilot, measure, iterate.
* Bring the customer's voice to cross-functional teams, ensuring it shapes product decisions and business strategy.

**Technology & Tools**

* Evaluate, implement, and optimize CRM, ticketing, and support tooling — with a bias toward automation and efficiency.
* Partner with engineering and vendor teams to push system enhancements that keep our support infrastructure ahead of our growth curve.
* Treat data integrity as non-negotiable: if the data isn't clean, the decisions aren't sound.

**A successful applicant will fit the following criteria:**

We want someone who runs toward hard things. You'll thrive here if:

* You have 5+ years of leadership experience in fast-paced, high-volume customer service or call center environments.
* You have 2+ years in customer service, healthcare, pharmacy, or a related field — you understand the stakes when a patient can't get their medication.
* You're a builder of teams and systems — not just a manager of tasks.
* You use data instinctively: you know which metrics to watch, how to find the story in the numbers, and how to translate insights into action.
* You thrive in ambiguity. When priorities shift (and they will), you recalibrate fast and keep the team grounded.
* You communicate with clarity and conviction — up, down, and across the org — and you do it with respect and patience.
* You have a low ego and a high standard. You'll do whatever it takes, including jumping on the phones when the team needs it.
* Spanish bilingual is preferred — for supporting diverse customers and teams.
* You have a bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, or equivalent real-world experience.

**Why Join Us:**
It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population.  At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year.  Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
